The State Secretary replied that responsibility lies with the municipality of Haarlem and the operator, that a 2014 Labour Inspectorate visit found no violations, and that a GGD emergency inspection, an improvement plan and an independent investigation are underway, with results promised for November.
The personnel policy of the Heemskerk women's shelter is primarily a matter for the employer and the municipality of Haarlem.
Het personeelsbeleid van de vrouwenopvang Heemskerk is primair een zaak van de werkgever en de gemeente Haarlem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked whether the government offered hemp-cultivation equipment seized under the Opium Act on a public auction site, and whether it is wrong that businesses cannot sell the same goods. The minister answered that he disagrees the listing was a mistake, refers to earlier answers for the remaining questions, and says re-use cannot be excluded but the legal test is whether the seller knew or had serious reason to suspect professional cultivation use.
I refer you to my answers to the written questions from Member Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over een tbs-er die vanuit zijn kliniek via internet contact heeft kunnen leggen met jonge vrouwen

An MP asked whether a tbs patient convicted of multiple sex offences was able to contact young women online from his clinic, and how this was possible. The State Secretary confirmed the contacts may have occurred during the resocialisation phase when internet access was permitted under conditions, and said the facility has been asked for a report to decide whether policy needs adjusting.
The relevant FPK has been asked to prepare a report on the circumstances and the stay of the person concerned.
De betreffende FPK is verzocht om een verslag op te maken van de omstandigheden en het verblijf van betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de aanhouding van een PIJ-er voor een roofoverval met dodelijke afloop

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a juvenile PIJ detainee on leave was suspected of a fatal robbery, how the decision to allow leave was made, and how many unauthorised absences occurred. The State Secretary confirmed an arrest but declined substantive comment because the case is before the court, described the risk-assessment process in general terms, announced an investigation into the case, and gave absence statistics with a commitment to answer before a committee meeting.
Given the seriousness of this situation, I am having an investigation carried out into this case.
Gezien de ernst van deze situatie laat ik een onderzoek naar deze casus uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Volp over het bericht dat de politie dagelijks met levensgevaarlijke chemicaliën werkt

MPs Marcouch and Volp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police dismantling illegal drug labs face life-threatening conditions, including work weeks of 60 hours, staffing levels of the LFO team, and whether a safety analysis was done. The Minister confirmed the 2014 Inspectorate re-inspection report, attached it with correspondence, referred to earlier answers for substance, and said a mandatory safety analysis has since been carried out for LFO work.
As requested, I am sending you the report and the accompanying correspondence as an annex to these answers.
Zoals gevraagd doe ik u als bijlage bij deze antwoorden het rapport en de begeleidende correspondentie toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Jacobi en Ypma over het bericht van kindermishandeling in een tehuis voor jongeren met het Prader-Willi syndroom

Three PvdA MPs asked about reports of systematic abuse of residents at a Prader-Willi youth home under enhanced Inspectorate supervision, and whether the home should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ found no evidence of abuse in its visits, that a prosecution was dropped for insufficient evidence, and that the home remains under monitoring with a follow-up inspection pending.
The Northern Netherlands district public prosecution service opened a criminal investigation following complaints by former staff about abuse.
Het arrondissementsparket Noord-Nederland heeft een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar aanleiding van aangiftes door oud-medewerkers over mishandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over winkeliers die straks alcohol mogen gaan schenken

The MP asked whether shops and hospitality businesses may be allowed to sell and serve alcohol in experiments, and how this affects youth protection and enforcement of the minimum age. The State Secretary answered that the Alcohol and Hospitality Act prohibits such mixing of functions, that no experiment provision exists, and that the evaluation of the Act will address enforcement and decentralisation of supervision.
I have not given permission to start a pilot in which the Alcohol and Hospitality Act is violated.
Ik heb geen toestemming gegeven om een pilot te starten waarbij de Drank en Horecawet overtreden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat bewoners in blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuizen tot prostitutie worden aangezet

An MP asked whether residents of women's shelters in Alkmaar and Heemskerk were encouraged into prostitution, whether crimes occurred, and whether other shelters face similar problems. The state secretary replied that Blijf Groep found no indication of prostitution being arranged, no complaint was filed, and no other shelters are known to be affected, while declining to add new measures and promising only a note to parliament.
Blijf Groep states that it had no indication whatsoever of prostitution being arranged or prevented at the mentioned locations.
Blijf Groep geeft aan dat zij overigens geen enkele aanwijzing had voor het laten plegen of voorkómen van prostitutie in de genoemde locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Marcouch over de gewelddadige dood van een vrouw uit Waalwijk

MPs Rebel and Marcouch ask the Minister of Security and Justice how police handled reports and complaints of threats, stalking and domestic violence before a woman from Waalwijk was killed, and whether it was linked to shelter capacity, police capacity or the lack of a protocol. The minister answers that police assess each case, that there is no evidence of cuts to women's shelters, that recruitment and capacity have grown, and that no additional protocol or investigation is needed beyond planned victim-protection implementation.
I therefore do not consider an additional protocol necessary.
Ik acht een aanvullend protocol dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Van Laar en Rebel over het bericht 'Afrikaanse voetballers verhandeld in Azië'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about a BBC report on African footballers trafficked to Asia, including estimates of victims, Dutch signals, and EU/FIFA enforcement. Minister Schippers answered that the report alone gives no basis for judgment, that FIFA is already acting, that FIFA transfer rules and KNVB policy are in place, and that no Dutch intervention is warranted.
Additional research into the numbers is therefore, in my judgment, not necessary.
Aanvullend onderzoek naar aantallen is naar mijn oordeel dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de behandeling van aangiften van zedenmisdrijven door de politie

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether a journalist's rape complaint was handled per the prosecution guideline on sexual abuse, and whether police always have specially trained officers take such reports, plus whether victims' secondary victimisation has been studied. The Minister says the handling followed the guideline except that the report was taken by one certified sex-crimes detective and a team officer due to time pressure, agrees victims should decide on filing, and points to 2010 and 2014 studies and a 2013 study on sexual violence centres, seeing no need for new research.
The handling of the journalist's case followed the said guideline, except for the taking of the report.
De behandeling van de zaak van de journaliste is conform de genoemde aanwijzing verlopen, met uitzondering van het opnemen van de aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over kritiek van de VN op Nederlands toezicht in detentie

An MP asked the state secretary about UN criticism of the Dutch National Preventive Mechanism for detention monitoring, including its relation to the National Ombudsman's earlier criticism and calls for a solid legal basis and political support. The state secretary explained the Netherlands' treaty obligations, noted the UN Subcommittee's advisory visit, and said the report will be sent to parliament in November with a policy response addressing the questions.
The Subcommittee will set out its findings from the visit in a report that will be formally presented to me in November.
Het Subcomité zal haar bevindingen naar aanleiding van het bezoek neerleggen in een rapport dat in november a.s. formeel aan mij zal worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Rebel and Kooiman asked whether the government was wrong to offer hemp-cultivation equipment seized from growers for sale on an auction site, whether such items could still be used for cultivation, and what criteria the Dienst Domeinen applies. The Minister refers to earlier answers to MP Berndsen-Jansen and does not answer the questions on substance, while confirming that the items were offered.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from MP Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat een derde van de jongeren zich nog onvoldoende veilig voelt in jeugdzorginstellingen

MPs Rebel and Ypma asked the state secretary about a report finding that a third of young people in youth care institutions feel insufficiently safe, and about sexual misconduct, online bullying and the role of youth participation. The secretary answered that most youths feel safe, that institutions can act on the report's tips, that sexuality is not yet routinely discussed and reported misconduct is rising, and that further steps will be taken through existing channels.
I do not infer from the report of the Youth Taskforce that sexuality is hardly or never discussed within youth care institutions, but that being able to discuss sexuality is not yet commonplace.

Ik leid uit het rapport van de Jongerentaskforce niet af, dat binnen jeugdzorginstellingen niet of nauwelijks over seksualiteit wordt gepraat, maar wel dat het bespreekbaar zijn van seksualiteit nog geen gemeengoed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Recourt en Rebel over het bericht “Ambtenaren: geen 'bolletjesvluchten' vanaf Eindhoven Airport”

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an internal memo proposed banning flights from Curaçao and Aruba to Eindhoven Airport due to drug-mule smuggling risks, and about controls and responsibilities. The minister answered that the consultation is ongoing and he will inform parliament later on the memo and risks, while noting that Curaçao and Aruba are responsible for their own controls and that inter-ministerial coordination took place.
I cannot yet answer these questions, as consultation with all those involved is still ongoing.
Ik kan op deze vragen nog geen antwoord geven, aangezien het overleg met alle betrokkenen nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Kuiken over de ruim 3.300 alleenstaande kinderen die de afgelopen maanden de Middellandse Zee overstaken

MPs Rebel and Kuiken asked about the over 3,300 unaccompanied children who crossed the Mediterranean in 2015, including monitoring, reception, NGO involvement and EU action against trafficking. The State Secretary acknowledged the vulnerability, pointed to EU directives and shelter arrangements, and to EU migration agenda steps, but did not provide figures on trafficking victims and placed tracing of family members with individual member states.
I am not aware of how many cases involve victims of human trafficking.
Mij is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen het gaat om slachtoffers van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat listige jihadloverboys piepjonge meisjes inpalmen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that jihadist 'loverboys' groom young girls for marriage and travel to the caliphate, asking for numbers, the role of advisory bodies, and the legal tools available. The minister answered that signals exist and some cases involve possible grooming, but declined to give numbers due to ongoing investigations, and described existing criminal law, school support and prevention measures.
The Public Prosecution Service will not make further statements about these ongoing investigations and concrete numbers because of investigative and prosecution interests.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken en concrete aantallen doet het OM geen nadere mededelingen vanwege opsporings- en vervolgingsbelangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over Nederland als grootproducent van neppeuken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the health effects of counterfeit cigarettes, the controls on imported raw tobacco and transit through Dutch ports, and whether counterfeit production should be fought. The State Secretary answered that illegal cigarettes increase accessibility, that current data do not show a rise in domestic production, and that enforcement lies with Customs and the FIOD, with some international cooperation.
Health (VWS) has no task in combating counterfeit cigarettes. This is reserved for Customs and the FIOD.
VWS heeft geen taak op de bestrijding van namaaksigaretten. Dit is voorbehouden aan de Douane en FIOD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Rebel over minderjarigen in voorlopige hechtenis

MPs Recourt and Rebel asked about the high share of detained minors in pre-trial detention in Dutch youth institutions, comparison with other EU states, whether judicial review is adequate, and alternatives such as night detention and forensic foster care. The State Secretary answered that judicial review under the 'suspend unless' principle is adequate, that about 75% of minors in pre-trial detention are suspended, and that alternatives and a pilot are being pursued, without an evaluation of the review itself.
I consider this judicial review sufficient.
Ik acht deze rechterlijke toets afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de preventie- en handhavingplannen voor de Drank- en Horecawet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the many municipalities lacking or having incomplete alcohol prevention and enforcement plans under the Drank- en Horecawet, and what powers the government has to compel them. The State Secretary acknowledged disappointing quality, said he will talk with municipalities, send a letter and commission a congress, but did not identify any binding powers to force compliance.
I will soon be talking with a number of municipal administrators about the results of this study
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met een aantal bestuurders van gemeenten over de resultaten van dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over verwaarloosde kinderen op school

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries of health and education whether they knew of reports that hundreds of children arrive at school hungry and neglected, and what is being done about it. The government answers that municipalities and Veilig Thuis are responsible for responding, that schools should report signals, and that it is promoting integrated cooperation between schools and neighbourhood teams.
Municipalities also have an important role in tackling poverty, one of the possible underlying causes.
Gemeenten hebben ook een belangrijke rol bij het tegengaan van armoedeproblematiek, één van de mogelijk achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over raamprostitutie in Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the closure of Utrecht's street-prostitution windows, possible human trafficking, the regulation bill, and the welfare of sex workers. The minister answered that the Wrp bill will counter displacement, that the municipality (not the prosecutor) based licence withdrawal on police reports, and that outreach support remains available.
The content of this research is not known to me.
De inhoud van dit onderzoek is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht ‘Bank weigert rekening aan sekswerkersclub’

MP Rebel asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether a bank refusing a business account to a sex workers' advocacy club was justified and how government will improve sex workers' access to financial services and tax deductions. The minister answered that banks set their own acceptance policies, that individual cases are not reviewed, and that the NVB will issue an information leaflet while casework is referred to it.
I do not intervene in a bank's assessment of individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling door een bank van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over VGP hogere aantallen drankslachtoffers bij latere cafésluitingen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a study finding more alcohol-related ambulance calls after Amsterdam cafés were allowed to close an hour later, and about whether such extensions are a national trend, whether additional research is needed, and how municipal licensing balances health harm. The State Secretary acknowledged the study, said causes are unclear, deemed additional research unnecessary given Amsterdam's new monitored approach, and committed to raising the topic with the VNG and mayors.
I will therefore put this point on the agenda in the next conversation with the VNG and in my contacts with mayors.
Ik zal dit punt daarom agenderen in het volgende gesprek met de VNG en in mijn contacten met burgemeesters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over digitaal rechercheren bij verdenking van seksueel misbruik van jonge kinderen

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the 2011 recommendation to search for child abuse imagery in sexual abuse cases was followed, and whether digital investigation of suspected sexual abuse of young children depends on the prosecutor's discretion. The Minister says the recommendation required no separate follow-up, that digital investigation is case-by-case under existing legal conditions, and that it is not limited to child pornography offences.
Digital investigation is a broad term covering all police research into various forms of digitally available information.
Digitaal rechercheren is een ruime term die ziet op al het onderzoek dat de politie doet naar verschillende vormen van digitaal beschikbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Rebel en Van der Staaij over de rokende gokker

MPs asked why Holland Casino expanded and made attractive smoking rooms with gambling machines, whether this is lawful and consistent with anti-smoking policy, and whether the government will change it. The government answered that such rooms are lawful under the Tabakswet provided the NVWA's criteria are met, that the offer should not be more attractive than outside the room, and agreed to talk with Holland Casino about a prevention pledge.
Smoking rooms, however, are exempt from the smoking ban, and the way Holland Casino has set up its smoking rooms does not conflict with the rules on this.
Rookruimten zijn echter uitgezonderd van het rookverbod en de manier waarop Holland Casino haar rookruimten heeft ingericht is niet strijdig met de regels daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over het bericht dat Gemeentewiet rendabel kan worden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether Heerlen's municipal cannabis cultivation plan, which projects 26 million euros in revenue, is realistic and whether such municipal cultivation could be profitable and studied for other municipalities. The minister answered that regulation of cultivation is not permitted under international treaties and is not the solution, and declined to speculate on the plan's revenue, while pointing to continued integrated enforcement.
As indicated under question 2, regulation is not permitted and is not a solution to the problem outlined.
Zoals aangegeven onder vraag 2 is regulering niet toegestaan en geen oplossing voor de geschetste problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over minderjarigen die werken in wietplantages

Two MPs (Rebel and Fokke, PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about minors working in cannabis plantations after a TV report, including whether such cases are known, how parents are approached, and whether legalising cannabis cultivation would help. The minister said no cases involving minors in plantations were reported to the Public Prosecution Service in 2014 or 2015, one case in 2013, that police make a child-protection referral, and that legalisation would not solve the problem given export and international law constraints.
I refer to answers 2 and 3 to the parliamentary questions from MPs Oskam and Knops
Ik verwijs naar antwoord 2 en 3 op de Kamervragen van de leden Oskam en Knops
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de strafbaarheid van verhuurders van panden waarin wiet wordt geteeld

MP Rebel asked the Justice Minister whether landlords face a duty to investigate cannabis cultivation in rented property, and whether the MeldpuntVerdacht website's claims about landlord liability and registration are accurate. The minister answered that no general investigation duty exists, that the website's claim that landlords are presumed guilty until proven innocent is plainly wrong, and that registration on the site does not avoid liability, while declining to comment on the website operator's interests.
The sentence on the website stating that a landlord is guilty until proven innocent is therefore plainly incorrect.
De zin op de website waarin staat dat een verhuurder schuldig is totdat deze zijn onschuld bewijst, is dan ook pertinent onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de manier waarop de politie omgaat met vermeend valse aangiftes van seksueel geweld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how police handle suspected false reports of sexual violence, including whether the informal intake conversation deters reporting and whether indicators like delayed or inconsistent statements are treated as signs of false testimony. The minister answered that the police and prosecution aim to reduce unnecessary barriers, that falsity is assessed against investigation results rather than a checklist, that the balance in the prosecution guideline is adequate, and that no further study is planned.
Preventing false reports must not lead to treating a victim in a way that presumes from the outset that the report is false.
Het voorkomen van valse aangiften mag niet leiden tot een bejegening van het slachtoffer waarbij er op voorhand vanuit wordt gegaan dat de aangifte vals is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over problemen met aangiftes met betrekking tot zedendelicten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether prosecution of sexual offences against intellectually disabled victims is hampered by difficulties obtaining usable testimony, and what police can do about it. The Minister answered that specialised police interviewers and psychologists are used, that a police working group will report on guidelines before summer, and that the OM and IGZ are informing care institutions about the scope of criminal law.
As previously promised by the former State Secretary of Security and Justice, your House will be informed of the results of a working group set up by the police.
Zoals eerder toegezegd door de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie 2 zal uw Kamer geïnformeerd worden over de resultaten van een door de politie ingestelde werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat hulpverleners te weinig oog hebben voor het kind bij huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the state secretary whether youth-protection bodies track children who are repeatedly reported as victims of abuse, and why professionals share too little information in domestic violence cases. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis must now record repeat reports and actively follow up on children, that a new handling protocol and a child check in the meldcode are in place, and that information-sharing will be addressed through practical support and step-by-step guidance rather than new legal obligations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over het bericht dat actiegroep "Zij Is Hier" een pand kraakt voor de opvang van kwetsbare en verborgen vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked about a women's shelter set up by activist group Zij Is Hier in a squatted building in Amsterdam Nieuw West, whether abandoned women with insecure residence status can access municipal shelters, and what measures and human rights ambassadors could provide. The state secretary answered that the municipality could not verify the number of occupants, that eight people were later housed in Nieuw West, that Amsterdam shelter options remain available regardless of residence status, and that trained volunteers could be deployed on rights and referral.
At our request, the municipality of Amsterdam sent us a factual account of the report that an activist group had squatted a building in Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft ons op ons verzoek een feitenrelaas doen toekomen over het bericht dat een actiegroep een pand heeft gekraakt in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over een voor het bezit van kinderporno veroordeelde psychiater die werkt met misbruikte patiënten

MPs asked whether a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography continued to treat patients with histories of sexual abuse, and whether the Public Prosecution Service informs the Health Inspectorate about such convictions. The minister confirmed the psychiatrist treated such a patient, that the Inspectorate now refers such cases to the disciplinary judge, and that a revised cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service is being prepared, with a promise to finish it within months.
Following the tightened position, the IGZ and the OM are working intensively on renewing the cooperation protocol.
Naar aanleiding van het aangescherpte standpunt werken de IGZ en het OM intensief aan het vernieuwen van het samenwerkingsprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over de dood van de Rotterdamse Yasmeen Dad

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked the ministers about the death of Yasmeen Dad, who lived in isolation, and whether police had signals of her oppression and what help exists for such women. The minister says criminal investigation limits disclosure, refers to police methods for honour-related violence and to the Rotterdam pilot with community key figures, and does not commit to a new investigation.
Beyond that, no statements can be made because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case.
Voor het overige geldt dat geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over VGP het bericht 'Meer kinderen in het ziekenhuis door drank'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of rising hospital admissions of young teenagers for alcohol, asking about causes, parental responsibility and prevention campaigns. The state secretary answered that overall youth drinking is falling, attributed the rise partly to more parents seeking care, and pointed to the NIX18 campaign, school and sports-club initiatives, and long-term monitoring.
At the end of this year I will receive the results of research into the social costs of alcohol use in the Netherlands, and I will send them to you.
Aan het einde van dit jaar zal ik overigens de resultaten van onderzoek naar maatschappelijke kosten van alcoholgebruik in Nederland ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de opkomst van drunkorexia

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rise of 'drunkorexia' (heavy drinking combined with restricted eating), its health effects, prevalence, prevention activities and available help. The State Secretary answered that there is no specific data or prevention activity on the phenomenon, that no further research or campaigns are planned for now, and that GP and GGZ practice support exist.
For the time being, I see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht 'Gamen tot je niet meer kunt stoppen'

MP Rebel asks the state secretary for health about a report that 4-5% of 13-40 year olds are game-addicted, and about trends, consequences, prevention, developer responsibility, the Game On fund, loneliness and treatment evidence. The state secretary is cautious about the diagnosis, notes rising treatment demand, describes prevention initiatives, declines to fund a cost study, and promises a broader view on addiction treatment later in the year.
I will consider further research and return to it in the vision on addiction care promised during the committee debate, which you can expect around the summer of this year.
Ik zal mij beraden op nader onderzoek en daarop terugkomen in de tijdens het AO-Verslavingszorg toegezegde visie die u rond de zomer van dit jaar kunt verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het opsluiten van terroristen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked about criteria for placing terrorism suspects in a dedicated prison wing, whether such concentration causes radicalisation, and whether resocialisation is tailored. The State Secretary said placement follows Regeling SPOG criteria with periodic review via a multidisciplinary consultation, that individual regimes allow tailored treatment, and that no concrete evidence of radicalisation through grouping is known, while refusing to give exact figures for security reasons.
I cannot provide further information for security reasons.
Verdere mededelingen kan ik om veiligheidsredenen niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Ypma over de gevaren van sociale media voor minder begaafde jongeren

MPs Rebel and Ypma asked about risks social media poses to young people with intellectual disabilities, including data on cyberbullying and abuse, available teaching materials, and whether a dedicated reporting point is needed. The government acknowledges the heightened vulnerability, says data on prevalence for this group cannot be provided, points to a Rutgers/CED project and ongoing talks on filling material gaps, and states that meldknop.nl is the place for reports for everyone.
However, we cannot give you insight into the extent of the problem.
Wij kunnen u echter geen inzicht geven in de omvang van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het strafbaar stellen van “wraakporno”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about legal options against non-consensual distribution of sexual images ('revenge porn') and whether Dutch law has gaps, including civil, copyright and criminal routes. The minister gave a detailed overview of criminal, civil and copyright remedies, acknowledged a gap on copying confidential data, and announced new offences in the upcoming Computercriminaliteit III bill.
For that reason I intend to introduce new criminal offences in the Computer Crime III bill, expected to be submitted to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2015.

Om die reden ben ik voornemens om in het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2015 bij de Tweede Kamer wordt ingediend, nieuwe strafbaarstellingen te introduceren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het misbruik van patiënten door een veroordeelde zedendelinquent

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Health about sexual abuse of patients by care workers, including whether courts impose professional bans on sex offenders and how often the inspectorate receives reports. The government answered that the inspectorate received 133 reports of sexual boundary violations in 2013, that a professional ban by a criminal court has effect beyond the tuchtrecht route, and it committed to a broader disciplinary ban and mandatory certificates of conduct for new staff in some care sectors.
The Minister of Health intends to make a change that would allow a broader ban to be imposed within disciplinary law than the removal of registration for the BIG profession.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport (VWS) is voornemens een wijziging door te voeren waardoor het mogelijk wordt om binnen het tuchtrecht een breder verbod op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat minderjarigen nog steeds alcohol kunnen kopen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a CBL-commissioned mystery-shopper study showing minors can still buy alcohol, and whether the CBL and any conflicts of interest were checked. The State Secretary answered that compliance rose from 54% to 62%, that the ministry's own study will be leading, and that he cannot rule out that supermarkets were forewarned.
I cannot rule that out because I am not responsible for the study that the CBL commissioned.
Ik kan dat niet uitsluiten want ik ga niet over het onderzoek dat het CBL heeft laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de rol van de gemeentelijk coördinator nazorg gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about how municipalities support children of imprisoned mothers, pointing to a Trouw article and a PvdA study, and to commitments made after the Bouwmeester initiative note. The State Secretary answered that a municipal aftercare coordinator should be in place, that most municipalities now share information, and that a factsheet and a new reintegration convenant will be sent to municipalities, with a letter promised before the January 2015 committee meeting.
I can inform the House that this factsheet will still be sent to all municipalities this year with a joint letter from me and my colleague at Health, Welfare and Sport.
Ik kan uw Kamer melden dat deze factsheet dit jaar nog met een gezamenlijke brief van mij en mijn ambtsgenoot van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aan alle gemeenten zal worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de berichten dat kinderen steeds vaker in aanraking komen met e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of children using e-cigarettes and shisha pens at fairs and toy stores, and whether the government would act. The secretary answered that a minimum sales age for nicotine e-cigarettes and strict advertising rules will be introduced with the EU Tobacco Products Directive, that the gateway effect is still unknown pending RIVM and NVWA research, and that municipalities can address fair sales through permit conditions.
In addition, under the new European Tobacco Products Directive, strict rules will apply to the advertising and promotion of e-cigarettes.
Daarnaast zullen, op grond van de nieuwe Europese Tabaksproductenrichtlijn, strenge regels gaan gelden ten aanzien van de reclame en promotie van e-sigaretten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over twee Britten die door Amsterdamse drugs zijn overleden

An MP asked the state secretaries about two British tourists who died after taking heroin sold as cocaine in Amsterdam, and about warning signs and prevention. The government answered that the deaths likely stem from misleading cocaine sales, that no incident data on misleading sales exists, that warning signs were posted for about three weeks without recorded incidents, and that prevention policy will be reviewed after a Trimbos study expected at year end.
I do not have figures on the scale of incidents involving misleading sales.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers met betrekking tot de omvang van incidenten door misleidende verkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het verzwegen leed van afstandsmoeders

An MP asked the State Secretary about the concealed suffering of unmarried mothers forced to give up their children for adoption, including the scale of the practice, church involvement, state oversight of adoption procedures, the case for further research and apology, and support for birth parents searching for family. The State Secretary acknowledged the suffering and estimated about 20,000 adoptions since 1956, but said the church's role cannot be quantified, that the state's knowledge of illegal adoptions is unknown, and that further research is not obviously a government task while pointing to existing reports and subsidised search support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het verhalen van de kosten van het opruimen van drugsafval op de daders

An MP asked whether drug-dumping offenders are rarely traced, whether landowners such as the municipality of Landerd are kept informed of prosecutions, and whether victims should be compensated for cleanup costs. The ministers replied that dumping is not separately registered, landowners can join criminal proceedings as injured parties, and the government opposed a compensation scheme, referring to a parliamentary amendment.
Dumping of drug waste is as such not registered in the operational process systems of the public prosecution service (OM).
Het dumpen van drugsafval wordt als zodanig niet geregistreerd in de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het openbaar ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het gebrek aan betrouwbare gegevens over ‘hennepacties’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the lack of reliable data on police raids on suspected cannabis grow sites, following an Ombudsman report. The minister answered that there is no reason to believe entry warrants are granted too easily, that 6 of 36 complaints about such entries were formally upheld in 2012–2013, and that the police began recording entries where no cannabis grow was found from September 2014.
However, it is good to gain better insight into the number of – viewed afterwards – wrongful cannabis raids.
Wel is het goed om beter inzicht te krijgen in het aantal – achteraf beschouwde – onterechte hennepinvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht ‘Wie belasting betaald, wordt uitgelachen’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice, on behalf of the State Secretary of Finance, about reports that prostitutes in Amsterdam commit tax fraud, the investment in their social position, the opting-in regime and its evaluation, administrative support for self-employed sex workers, bank account access, and rent levels. The government denies the described tax fraud phenomenon apart from one malicious bookkeeper, says the sector's position is being improved, promises an evaluation of the opting-in regime soon, and mostly points to market forces and existing initiatives.
There was indeed a dishonest bookkeeper active in Amsterdam who victimised prostitutes.
Wel is er in Amsterdam een malafide boekhouder actief geweest, waar prostituees het slachtoffer van zijn geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Rebel over de omstandigheden waaronder politiemensen drugslaboratoria en -afval moeten opsporen en opruimen

MPs Marcouch and Rebel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about the working conditions of police and inspectors who detect and clean up drug labs and dumped drug waste, citing a union letter on unsafe conditions, the LFO team's capacity and falling numbers of green BOAs. The minister said the Inspectie SZW will investigate working conditions with no timeline, that LFO capacity has been doubled with new staff expected by 1 January 2015, and that green BOA numbers fluctuate without a structural downward trend.
The Inspectie SZW has since confirmed that it will carry out this investigation.
De Inspectie SZW heeft inmiddels bevestigd dat zij dit onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over terugkeer naar en re-integratie in landen van herkomst voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the Safe Future method for discussing return to countries of origin with trafficking victims should become a standard task of shelters and be implemented nationally, and about falling reporting rates, identification of victims in asylum centres, and whether a study should be done. The government welcomed the method and said the project organisation is mapping rollout, announced a one-year pilot of interview studios in victim shelters, pointed to existing COA and IND training, and declined a dedicated study of victims in asylum centres.
In the autumn of 2014 a one-year pilot of interview studios in shelters for trafficking victims will therefore be started.
In het najaar van 2014 zal daarom voor de duur van een jaar een pilot verhoorstudio’s in opvanglocaties van slachtoffers mensenhandel worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Rebel over de afdoening van strafbare feiten bij festivals

MPs Recourt and Rebel asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the handling of drug possession cases at the Lowlands festival, including criminal records, VOG consequences and the absence of lawyers on site. The Minister answered that 119 drug cases were settled mostly by OM penalty orders, that registration in JDS is legally required with VOG assessed case by case, and that no permanent lawyer presence was deemed necessary since suspects are informed of rights and can call a lawyer.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that 122 cases were settled at the Lowlands festival this year, 119 of them for drug possession.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij meegedeeld dat tijdens het festival Lowlands dit jaar in totaal 122 zaken zijn afgedaan, waarvan 119 zaken wegens drugsbezit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over online drugswinkels

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about online drug shops, their turnover, scale, buyers, and whether they break coffeeshop rules and should be prosecuted more than coffeeshops. The minister said the scale is unknown and hard to measure, that online dealers are not covered by the tolerance policy and will be prosecuted criminally, and pointed to investments in digital investigation and international cooperation.
The precise scale of (the turnover from) drug sales on the internet is in fact not known.
De precieze omvang van de (omzet uit de) verkoop van drugs op internet is namelijk niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Wolbert over het bericht dat zeker 10% van de grotere zwangerschapscomplicaties kan worden voorkomen als zwangere vrouwen niet meer roken

MPs Rebel and Wolbert asked the minister whether smoking during pregnancy could be cut to prevent complications, and about costs, measures, lifestyle warnings and the role of midwives. The minister agreed that smoking reduction matters, pointed to existing programmes and inspectorate action, and declined to add warnings to medicine leaflets citing EU rules and industry views.
The instrument also takes lifestyle aspects into account.
Het instrument houdt ook rekening met leefstijlaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Rebel en Fokke over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Recourt, Rebel and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising organised crime in southern Netherlands, including threats against mayors, drug-related crime, police funding and coordination. The minister answered that threats are handled under the prosecution service's protection directive, that police capacity in the south will be intensified within existing staffing from 1 October 2014 via regional structures, and that no national crime coordinator is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it makes no statements about possible threats against public administrators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Rebel over de sponsoring van provincies en gemeenten door de tabaksindustrie

MPs Fokke and Rebel asked whether municipalities and provinces sponsored by the tobacco industry breach FCTC Article 5.3 and its guidelines, and what the government will do to stop it. The State Secretary answered that the convention binds local authorities but leaves implementation open, that the guidelines are non-binding, that the two campaigns do not stem from tobacco control policy, and that a letter reminding municipalities and provinces of their obligations has been sent.
That said, I consider it important that municipalities and provinces become better acquainted with the obligations arising from the FCTC convention and the Tobacco Act.
Dit neemt niet weg dat ik het belangrijk vind dat gemeenten en provincies beter bekend worden met de verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het FCTC-verdrag en de Tabakswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Van der Steur over het bericht dat smartshops levensgevaarlijke drugs verspreiden

MPs Rebel and Van der Steur asked whether illegal narcotics sold as vitamin pills in smartshops were known, how the NVWA and IGZ supervise smartshops, whether national rules should replace local ordinances, and how drug-testing services and the police fit in. The state secretary answered that the four Amsterdam and Utrecht shops are under examination, that supervision is joint (NVWA, IGZ, police) and mostly complaint-based, and that no additional national rules are considered necessary.
Currently it is being examined further how action can be taken against the four smartshops in Amsterdam and Utrecht.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzocht op welke wijze kan worden opgetreden tegen de vier smartshops in Amsterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over online drugs kopen

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising online drug purchases, risks to users, and enforcement against online drug marketplaces such as Silk Road. The government answered that monitoring and police digital expertise are being expanded, cited recent convictions, and declined to add the topic separately to an EU Justice Council agenda.
In the context of the investigative interest, it is not desirable to make statements about this.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang is het niet wenselijk hierover mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het gedogen van de verkoop van wiet via internet

An MP asked whether coffeeshops may sell cannabis via internet coupons delivered to homes, and how this can be controlled for age, quantities and advertising. The minister answered that such online sales violate the tolerance policy, cannot be supervised, and that existing criteria and the Opium Act give enough means to act.
In the context of the investigative interest, it is not desirable to make statements about this.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang is het niet wenselijk hierover mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat gemeenten niet weten hoe ze kindermishandeling moeten tegengaan

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretaries whether municipalities lack the knowledge and data to prevent child abuse, citing an Ombudsman for Children report. The government answered that most municipalities do hold data, that it will support municipalities with tools, a regulatory change and an updated action plan, while noting that prevention policy is primarily their own responsibility.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for shaping child abuse prevention policy and setting objectives.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om preventiebeleid voor kindermishandeling vorm te geven en doelstellingen te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over ‘Drugslabs steeds gevaarlijker’

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that drug labs are growing larger, more professional and more dangerous, and whether police and justice have enough capacity to tackle them. The Minister confirmed the trend, said the LFO's protective equipment is top-level, declined to earmark police capacity for drugs, and said the LFO's specialist capacity has doubled in recent months.
The starting point is that we do not specifically earmark police capacity.
Het uitgangspunt is dat we politiecapaciteit niet specifiek oormerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over onderzoek naar de regulering van cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a European research report on cannabis regulation, including whether strict laws reduce use, whether international drug treaties need changing, and whether Dutch tolerance policy complies with them. The minister agreed no clear link exists between strict laws and use, said the regulation model is untested, rejected the need to amend the treaties, and defended the Dutch reservation to the UN Single Convention as covering existing tolerance policy.
The Dutch tolerance policy on the sale and possession of cannabis is based on the reservation the Netherlands made to the UN Single Convention on drugs.
Het Nederlandse gedoogbeleid ten aanzien van de verkoop en het aanwezig hebben van cannabis is gebaseerd op het voorbehoud dat Nederland heeft gemaakt bij het VN Sluikhandel Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat het aantal rokers stabiel is, en het gebruik van de e-sigaret stijgt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the share of smokers is stable while e-cigarette use is rising, and about the health risks, quitting effectiveness and timing of a regulatory measure on e-cigarettes. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to RIVM research and a planned minimum age for e-cigarette sales, and said the AMvB on e-cigarette product rules would be sent to the Raad van State soon.
In addition, I have announced that I will introduce a minimum age for the sale of e-cigarettes, as is already the case for tobacco and alcohol.
Daarnaast heb ik aangekondigd een minimumleeftijd in te zullen stellen voor de verkoop van e-sigaretten; zoals dat bij tabak en alcohol al het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over handhaving van de Drank- en Horecawet op Nederlandse campings

An MP asked the state secretary how the Alcohol Act is enforced on campsites, whether a Terschelling campsite's website misleadingly suggested underage drinking was allowed, and how to intensify enforcement before summer. The state secretary said the website claim is incorrect, campsites are generally public spaces where under-18s may not have alcohol, inspectors may enter any place, and he will meet the Terschelling mayor and the public prosecutor on tightening enforcement.
In the very near future I will meet with mayor Bats of Terschelling.
Op zeer korte termijn ga ik in gesprek met burgemeester Bats van Terschelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat Utrechtse raamexploitanten niet ingrepen ondanks berichten over mensenhandel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many Utrecht window-prostitution exploiters were flagged for trafficking, poor supervision and disorder, what victim support was offered after the closures, and why closures did not produce more complaints. The Minister said six permits of five operators were revoked based on police reports and court rulings, that the municipality and police informed sex workers and offered care, but withheld details of the confidential reports and gave no complete victim or investigation figures.
Because of the confidential nature of the administrative reports, I cannot however provide further details on this.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de bestuurlijke rapportages kan ik hier echter geen verdere details over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat THC in beperkte mate een rol speelt bij cannabisverslaving

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a dissertation finding that THC content plays only a limited role in cannabis addiction, and whether this undermines the planned THC cap. The State Secretary replies that the study has limitations, keeps the THC measure based on the Garretsen commission's advice, and sees no need for extra prevention measures beyond existing municipal efforts.
I see no reason to initiate additional measures.
Ik zie geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over mensenhandel en thuisprostitutie

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about trafficking in home-based prostitution, including the extent of the problem, police capacity, prosecution of homeowners who rent houses as brothels, and whether neighbours are deterred from reporting. The Minister answers that trafficking is not present in all illegal home prostitution, cites figures, notes a WODC baseline study is underway, says facilitators can be prosecuted but no cases are known, and denies neighbours fear reporting.
The WODC is currently carrying out a baseline study under the Wrp.
Het WODC voert momenteel een nulmeting uit in het kader van de Wrp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Rebel over jongeren die identiteitskaarten vervalsen om aan alcohol te komen

MPs Oosenbrug and Rebel asked about young people forging or borrowing ID cards to buy alcohol, including whether scanners make forgery easy, whether prosecution occurs, and whether bar owners check authenticity. The minister said the Dutch ID card is hard to forge, that police act on reported cases, and that bars should check security features more carefully, while noting the survey's representativeness is unclear and committing to no new concrete measures.
The NOS report shows that more attention is needed in the hospitality sector here.
Het NOS-bericht laat zien dat hier in de horeca meer aandacht voor moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat Utrechtse raamexploitanten niet ingrepen ondanks berichten over mensenhandel

An MP asked whether Utrecht brothel operators ignored signs of human trafficking, how many victims were suspected, whether closing the windows reduced trafficking and whether trafficking displaced to other municipalities, and what role the Justice department played. The minister replied that licences were withdrawn on the basis of police reports showing trafficking indications, poor supervision and disturbance of public order, that the municipality believes closure reduced trafficking, that some sex workers reportedly moved to other municipalities though figures are unknown, and that several suspects were prosecuted in an integrated approach.
The precise number of possible victims is not known.
Het precieze aantal van mogelijke slachtoffers is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Rebel over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren zich met een gameverslaving melden bij verslavingsklinieken

MPs Bergkamp and Rebel asked about reports that more and younger young people are seeking treatment for gaming addiction, and about causes, recognition, reimbursement and prevention. Minister Schippers confirmed the rise in treatment demand, said existing research is sufficient, noted gaming addiction is not in DSM-5 but is generally reimbursed, and pointed to parental responsibility, existing tools and school-based programmes.
I find this development worrying and will continue to monitor it.
Ik vind deze ontwikkeling zorgelijk en zal deze blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Rebel over handhaving dumping drugsafval in de natuur

MPs Jacobi and Rebel asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about enforcement against dumping of drug waste in nature, including whether existing law is adequate, who pays cleanup costs, enforcement numbers and capacity, and expertise. The minister replied that existing Environmental Management Act provisions suffice, that no new rules are planned, that the polluter should pay with waterproofing funds being explored, and that specialist police expertise (LFO) is available.

Further data on the number of drug waste dumpings and the resulting prosecutions, sentences, and collected fines cannot be generated from the business process systems of the Public Prosecution Service and investigative agencies.

Nadere gegevens over aantallen drugsafvaldumpingen en de daarop volgende strafvervolging/strafoplegging en geïnde geldboetes en/of gevangenisstraffen kunnen niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het OM en de opsporingsinstanties worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de naleving- en handhavingcijfers van het rookverbod in de horeca

Rebel (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about the latest compliance and enforcement figures for the smoking ban in hospitality, including the slight dip in compliance and whether tougher enforcement and a higher minimum age will help. The State Secretary answered that compliance is generally good but lags in cafés and discotheques, that the trend has risen since 2011, and that enforcement has been intensified, with annual reporting to parliament planned.
As I indicated in my letter, I would like to inform the House once a year from now on about all enforcement and compliance regarding the smoking ban in hospitality and the tobacco age limit.
Zoals ik in mijn brief heb aangegeven wil ik de Kamer voortaan graag eenmaal per jaar informeren over alle handhaving en naleving van het rookverbod in de horeca en de leeftijdgrens tabak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de toename van het aantal drugsslachtoffers bij ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister whether rising drug-related emergency room admissions, driven mainly by GHB and XTC use, warrant stronger prevention and whether municipalities have sufficient funds for prevention. The state secretary answered that GHB use is becoming more problematic, described protocols and prevention efforts including a new youth health project from April 2014, and did not commit to new legislative or funding measures.
I am consulting with the Trimbos Institute to determine which additions to or changes in the current preventive approach could be effective.
Ik ben in overleg met het Trimbos instituut om te bepalen welke aanvullingen op of veranderingen in de huidige preventieve aanpak effectief zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over de Taskforce hennep

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a waterbed effect in cannabis crime moving from big cities to rural Brabant, and about the expansion of the Taskforce hennep to all of Brabant and Zeeland. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the expansion reflects a general need for resilience rather than a direct response, and said there is no hard evidence yet of displacement to Belgium, while noting that cooperation with Belgian authorities is being structured.
It is correct that the TaskForce B5 will expand to all of Brabant and Zeeland.
Het klopt dat de TaskForce B5 gaat uitbreiden naar heel Brabant en Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de handhaving van de Drank- en Horecawet voor 16- en 17-jarigen

An MP asked whether municipalities may deviate from the new alcohol age limit of 18 through transitional arrangements tied to public order, and how the government views the enforcement consequences. The state secretary answered that municipalities set enforcement priorities but may not deviate from the statutory age limits or create transitional periods, and that the government trusts local balancing of interests.
However, this does not mean that one may deviate from the age limits as laid down by law, nor that a transitional period may be created for a certain group of young people.
Dit betekent echter niet dat mag worden afgeweken van de leeftijdsgrenzen zoals die bij wet zijn vastgelegd en ook niet dat een overgangsperiode mag worden gecreëerd voor een bepaalde groep jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over regulering van e-sigaretten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the RIVM e-cigarette factsheet, NVWA supervision of e-cigarettes under the Warenwet, enforcement capacity in light of an Audit Office report, and a minimum age of 18 for sales. The State Secretary defended the RIVM/NVWA safety work, explained that NVWA enforcement was limited until 2012, and said a minimum age must be set in law (not by AMvB), with options being mapped.
To create a legal basis, either the Warenwet or the Tabakswet must be amended.
Om een wettelijke basis te creëren, dient of de Warenwet of de Tabakswet te worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over een minimumleeftijd voor de verkoop van e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about the addictive health risks of e-cigarettes, their appealing advertising aimed at youth, and whether a minimum sales age of 18 would be introduced quickly. The state secretary acknowledged the risk findings and said he intends to introduce an 18-year minimum age, with details to follow as soon as possible.
I will inform you as soon as possible about the details of how this will be implemented.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk nader informeren over de invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat de Politie de groei van xtc-labs niet kan bijbenen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked whether police can keep pace with the rapid growth of ecstasy labs, including staffing of the four specialists, overtime, health risks and the APAAN precursor ban. Minister Opstelten answered that lab numbers rose but growth is unclear, that only four specialists handle dismantling with measures planned to ease workload, and that APAAN will become a registered category 1 substance once the EU regulation takes effect.

Due to the specific nature of dismantling laboratories and the required specialist knowledge level, this work is always and exclusively carried out by the specialists of the National Facility for Dismantling Support (LFO) of the national police unit.

Door de specifieke aard van de werkzaamheden bij het ontmantelen van laboratoria en het vereiste specialistische kennisniveau worden deze werkzaamheden altijd en alleen verricht door de specialisten van de Landelijke Faciliteit ondersteuning Ontmantelen (LFO) van de landelijke eenheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat een computervirus kinderpornografie verspreidt

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ransomware 'police virus' that displays child pornography deters victims from reporting, how police distinguish planted from downloaded material, and whether voucher sellers bear responsibility. The minister acknowledged under-reporting is possible, said police can distinguish cases, noted voucher sellers are not assumed involved, and advised antivirus use and online guidance.
For that reason I cannot rule out that the number of people who reported the crime is lower than the number actually affected by this virus.
Ik kan mede daarom niet uitsluiten dat het aantal mensen dat aangifte heeft gedaan lager is dan het aantal mensen dat daadwerkelijk door dit virus getroffen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het Rebel over de opmars van e-sigaretten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the rise of e-cigarettes, the EU tobacco directive's classification, marketing and lobbying by Philip Morris, and possible legal restrictions. The State Secretary responds that the EU framework is not decisive, that Dutch measures such as a minimum age are planned, and that RIVM/NVWA research on additives is ongoing.
I am also looking at other legal options to regulate the e-cigarette. I will inform your House of this as soon as possible.
Ik kijk ook naar andere wettelijke mogelijkheden om de e-sigaret te reguleren. Hierover zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de verplichte verklaring omtrent gedrag voor mensen die met kinderen werken

An MP asked the minister whether people can work in VOG-required jobs before their certificate is issued and what sanctions organisations face for doing so. The state secretary answered that some workers may start without a VOG, that the employer is responsible for checking, that inspectorates enforce the requirement with sanctions such as funding suspension, and that enforcement is for the supervisors.
It happens that people work (temporarily) without a VOG in a role or profession for which a VOG is required.
Het komt voor dat personen (tijdelijk) zonder VOG werkzaam zijn in een functie of beroep waarvoor een VOG verplicht is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Rebel over zwangeren die alcohol blijven drinken

MPs Wolbert and Rebel asked about reports that many pregnant women keep drinking alcohol and how prevention policy reaches lower-educated women, and whether professionals discuss alcohol before conception. The Staatssecretaris answered that no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy is advised, described existing public information, professional guidelines and training, and said the government will not further evaluate this but points to existing channels.
During pregnancy there is no safe amount of alcohol.
Bij zwangerschap bestaat geen veilige hoeveelheid alcohol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat de douane meer designerdrugs en grondstoffen onderschept

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that customs intercepts more designer drugs and precursor chemicals, including how much APAAN was seized in 2011 and 2012 and whether it can be banned. The minister replied that 1,150 kg (2011) and 5,551 kg (2012) of APAAN were seized, that APAAN is not produced or exported from the Netherlands, and that it cannot be placed on the Opium Act list but will fall under chemical-precursor controls once EU regulations take effect.
We are waiting for the relevant EU Regulations to take effect.
Het wachten is op de inwerkingtreding van de betreffende EU Verordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about three Council of State rulings on imposing the alcohol-interlock programme on truck drivers, the status of the exploration of interlocks in lorries, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister confirms the rulings were noted, says the exploration is completed, and promises to inform the Chamber before the 30 January 2014 committee meeting.
I intend to inform you as soon as possible, and at the latest before the scheduled committee meeting of 30 January 2014.
Ik ben voornemens u zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren, doch uiterlijk voor het geplande AO van 30 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over het bericht “Via virtueel Filipijns meisje 1000 kindermisbruikers getraceerd”

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Terre des Hommes data on Dutch people linked to child abuse, traced via a virtual Filipino girl, can be used as evidence, whether virtual minors are protected under Dutch law, and whether police can use decoys. The Minister answered that Europol will analyse the data and pass Dutch cases to police, that virtual minors are not covered by the corruption offence but virtual child pornography is, and that a law change and a Groningen review of the sex offences title are underway.
With the law of 29 November 2009, implementing the Lanzarote Convention, the so-called corruption of minors was made punishable (article 248d Sr).
Met de wet van 29 november 2009 is, ter uitvoering van het Verdrag van Lanzarote, het zogenaamde corrumperen van minderjarigen strafbaar gesteld (artikel 248d Sr).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de mogelijkheid van legalisatie van cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the possibility of legalising cannabis, including the tension between banning cannabis purchase by coffeeshops while tolerating their sales, and the Uruguayan legalisation model. The minister acknowledged the tension in the tolerance policy, said he would report on foreign developments including Uruguay, and stated that drug policy should balance public health with the fight against nuisance and crime.
I will fulfil this commitment shortly and can confirm that, given recent developments, I will also address the situation in Uruguay.
Ik zal op korte termijn deze toezegging gestand doen en kan bevestigen dat ik hierbij, gezien de recente ontwikkelingen, ook zal ingegaan op de situatie in Uruguay.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat grote gemeenten de wietteelt willen reguleren

An MP asked the Justice minister whether a large majority of big municipalities supporting regulated cannabis cultivation would change policy, and which municipalities have concrete plans. The minister says an inventory will be sent before 1 January 2014, that meetings with coffeeshop-municipality mayors were held, and that regulated cultivation is rejected as it is in conflict with international treaties and the Opiumwet.
I have committed to sending your House an inventory of municipal plans and intentions regarding cannabis cultivation before 1 January 2014.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer voor 1 januari 2014 een inventarisatie te sturen van de gemeentelijke plannen en voornemens op het gebied van wietteelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about reports that a drink-driver escaped punishment through the alcohol-lock programme, the Judiciary's use of sentencing guidelines, technical reliability of alcohol locks, and whether the programme evaluation could be brought forward. The government said the judiciary, not the Council for the Judiciary, sets the guidelines, that no case data are kept, that technical faults are rare, and that the evaluation runs to end 2014 with the full period to 2022, and it did not meet the deadline for answering before the budget debate.
Unfortunately, this deadline was not met.
Deze termijn is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat een standaard screening bij vrouwen met een botbreuk in veel gevallen huiselijk geweld kan voorkomen

An MP asked the state secretary whether standard screening of women with fractures could prevent domestic violence, and whether orthopaedic and trauma surgeons are trained to recognise abuse. The secretary acknowledged the Canadian study findings and the mandatory meldcode since July 2013, but left the question of a separate screening protocol to professional bodies and pointed to planned training improvements.
I leave the judgement on whether a separate screening is needed specifically for victims of fractures to the sector and professional organisations.
Ik laat het oordeel of specifiek voor slachtoffers van botbreuken een aparte screening nodig is over aan de branche- en beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat slachtoffers van mensenhandel te weinig vergoed krijgen

An MP asked the minister about reports that victims of human trafficking receive too little compensation in criminal cases, and why few claims are filed or granted. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, cited procedural and emotional barriers, and committed to simplifying compensation procedures, a best-practice guide for judges, specialised trafficking courts, and a national referral mechanism.

I take the recommendations in the report to heart and will incorporate them into the already started improvement process on victim compensation and the national referral mechanism project for victims of human trafficking.

Ik neem de aanbevelingen uit het rapport ter harte en zal deze meenemen in het reeds gestarte verbetertraject rond compensatie van slachtoffers en het project nationaal verwijzingsmechanisme slachtoffers mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat in de Europese Unie honderdduizenden mensen leven als slaven

MP Rebel asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hundreds of thousands of people in the EU live as slaves, the reliability of trafficking estimates, whether open EU borders and EU citizens' access to prostitution work should be regulated, and whether a long-term awareness campaign will be run. The Minister answered that no reliable estimates of victims exist, that Eurostat's registered figures are the most reliable available, that regulation of prostitution and cooperation with Eastern European states and EMPACT are the chosen route, and that several awareness campaigns are already underway.
Reliable estimates of the number of victims of human trafficking do not exist.
Betrouwbare schattingen van het aantal slachtoffers van mensenhandel bestaan niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht inzake een wetenschappelijk experiment met het telen van wiet in Utrecht

The MP Rebel asked the Ministers of Justice and Health about a Utrecht cannabis club and a proposed scientific cannabis-growing experiment, and whether an Opium Act exemption would shield the club from prosecution. The government answered that an application for an exemption from the Social Cannabis Club Domstad is pending, no experiment application has yet been filed, and that an exemption only removes prosecution for the covered conduct while the holder remains liable for conduct outside it.
An exemption means that the acts and conduct covered by the exemption are not prohibited under the Opium Act.
Een ontheffing strekt ertoe dat de handelingen en gedragingen waarop de ontheffing ziet niet verboden zijn op grond van de Opiumwet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen blind zijn voor geweld tegen kinderen

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretary for Health whether hospitals miss many child abuse cases, why hospitals report too little, and about implementing the mandatory child check in emergency departments. The state secretary answered that hospital reports to the AMK have risen sharply, pointed to the new mandatory reporting code and sector norm, and said the inspectorate will enforce compliance and that a baseline measurement and 2015 evaluation of the child check are planned.
In addition, the IGZ supervises the introduction of the child check as a statutory minimum requirement of the reporting code within its regular oversight.
Daarnaast ziet de IGZ toe op invoering van de kindcheck als wettelijke minimumeis van de meldcode bij haar reguliere toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Rebel and Fokke asked the minister of Security and Justice about enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops in Maastricht, including whether the mayor may waive it in daily enforcement. The minister replied that the criterion is part of the national Opium Act guideline, that the local triangle sets enforcement priorities but cannot differentiate buyers by residency, and that he sent the mayor a letter of 30 August 2013.

As I indicated in my letter to the mayor of Maastricht of 30 August 2013, differentiation within the municipality regarding sales to residents, non-residents or certain non-residents does not fit the national framework and the objectives of the coffeeshop policy.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de burgemeester van Maastricht van 30 augustus 2013 heb aangegeven past differentiatie binnen de gemeente met betrekking tot de verkoop aan ingezetenen, niet-ingezetenen of bepaalde niet-ingezetenen niet in het landelijk kader en de doelstellingen van het coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over handhaving door gemeenten van de leeftijdsgrens voor verkoop van alcohol

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities enforcing the new 18-year alcohol sales age would be lax, and how enforcement is being improved. The state secretary agreed enforcement matters, said enforcement varies by municipality with 230-350 inspectors deployed, and pointed to support tools and a communication campaign, though he stressed compliance should not rely on enforcement alone.
My impression is that municipalities approach their task of supervising compliance with the age limits differently.
Mijn beeld is dat de gemeenten hun taak om toe te zien op de naleving van de leeftijdsgrenzen verschillend oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dik-Faber en Rebel over het hergebruik van datadragers van de overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Rebel asked why government destroys reusable phones, tablets and computers instead of reusing them, and whether data safety can be guaranteed for reuse. The state secretary agreed reuse is preferable, cited AIVD security rules and a study due early 2014 into alternatives, and promised to consider them.
Since spring 2013 a study has been running that looks for alternatives.
