The government answers that the net BIV is adequate compensation, rejects defiscalisation based on independent professors' advice, declines to comment on pending cases and on the Landsadvocaat advice, and explains that the BIV is freely disposable income not covered by the exemption.
I cannot comment substantively on pending cases.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk ingaan op lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kouwenhoven over de evaluatie van de gebruikelijkloonregeling voor directeuren-grootaandeelhouders (dga's)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the SEO evaluation of the directors-major-shareholders (dga) usual-wage rule, including estimated lost tax revenue, strategic behaviour and possible reform. The State Secretary answered that the rule is efficient but only partly effective, that a follow-up study will be shared on Prinsjesdag without the cabinet drawing conclusions, and listed prior-consultation figures.
Following the evaluation, a follow-up study has been started. I intend to share the results of this study with your House on Prinsjesdag.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie is een vervolgonderzoek gestart. Ik ben voornemens de resultaten van dit onderzoek op Prinsjesdag met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over het artikel ‘Brussel wil belasting van €2 op goedkope pakketjes uit China’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Commission's plan to scrap the duty exemption for parcels under 150 euro, including the revenue impact and consumer price effects. The government supports the customs reform and a handling fee to fight fraud and level the playing field, though the national gain is limited to a 25% collection fee.
The cabinet is therefore positive about introducing such a handling fee.
Het kabinet is dan ook positief over de introductie van een dergelijke handling fee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over het artikel ’Onderzoek naar frauduleuze invoer e-bikes uit China’

The MP asked whether the government recognises reports of Chinese e-bike parts being imported via Poland and assembled in Portugal to evade anti-dumping duties, and what it will do about lost revenue. The state secretary confirmed Customs knows of such assembly practices, said the Netherlands does not lose revenue since duties accrue to the EU, and said anti-dumping circumvention is a priority in a risk-based control strategy.
So it is not the case that the Dutch treasury loses an amount now that the goods are not imported via the Netherlands.
Het is dus niet zo dat de Nederlandse schatkist een bedrag misloopt nu de goederen niet via Nederland worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Dijk, Grinwis en Kouwenhoven over het belastinglek bij Duitse beleggingsfondsen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a tax leak involving German real estate investment funds, including whether the state can still tax past gains and whether a step-up valuation loophole can be repaired. The State Secretary answered each of the 16 questions, stating that taxing past gains with retroactive effect is not justified and that the loophole will not be repaired.
In this case I currently see insufficient justification for measures to bring untaxed value increases from years before 2025 into the corporate tax base after all, that is, with retroactive effect.

Ik zie in het onderhavige geval vooralsnog onvoldoende rechtvaardiging om maatregelen te nemen die onbelaste waardestijgingen die zien op jaren vóór 2025 alsnog (dat wil zeggen met terugwerkende kracht) in de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de ‘ongelijke toegang tot het Europees Fonds voor Maritieme Zaken, Visserij en Aquacultuur (EMFAF) voor visserijbedrijven met een EU-Vlagregistratie’

An MP asks why fishing firms established in the Netherlands but flagged to other EU states are excluded from Dutch EMFAF fisheries subsidies, and whether the criteria can be changed. The Secretary of State answers that the Dutch programme targets Dutch-flagged vessels by design, that data on foreign-flagged vessels is not available, and declines to change the criteria or to commit to new talks beyond being open to conversation.
The choice was made that the funds are intended for fishing vessels flagged in the Netherlands and not for vessels that form part of a foreign fleet.
De keuze is daarbij gemaakt dat de middelen bestemd zijn voor vissersvaartuigen die Nederlands gevlagd zijn en niet voor vaartuigen die deel uitmaken van een buitenlandse vloot.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Stultiens over de berichtgeving waarin bedrijven in een manifest de regering oproepen met voortvarender beleid te komen ter stimulans van de circulaire economie

MPs Gabriëls and Stultiens asked why the circular economy is lagging despite the 2030 targets, following a business manifesto calling for faster government action. The state secretary acknowledged the urgency, pointed to an updated Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie due after the summer, and listed fiscal measures replacing the withdrawn polymer levy, while largely deferring concrete commitments.
The policy measures the cabinet will take will be included in the previously mentioned update of the NPCE.
De beleidsmaatregelen die het kabinet zal nemen zullen worden opgenomen in de eerder genoemde actualisatie van het NPCE.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Becker over de ANBI-status van Civitas Christiana in verband met de rechterlijke uitspraak over onrechtmatige uitlatingen die Rutgers in verband brengen met pedofilie

MPs Heite and Becker asked whether the ANBI tax-exempt status of Civitas Christiana should be reviewed after a court ruled it had unlawfully linked Rutgers to paedophilia, and whether the ANBI framework is adequate. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents comment on individual institutions, that the public-benefit test is deliberately neutral, that status is revoked only on limited legal grounds such as a final criminal conviction, and that the cabinet will respond to the ANBI evaluation and explore adding criminal offences before summer.
Because the Tax and Customs Administration is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.
Omdat de Belastingdienst gehouden is aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Stultiens over Onderzoek Lucratiefbelangregeling

MPs Idsinga and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about the lucrative interest regime, under which private equity managers' carried interest is taxed in box 2 at a lower rate than box 1, and about its size, administrability and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that the number of affected taxpayers and the revenue effects cannot be precisely determined, that the regime provides legal certainty and fits neighbouring countries, and that alternatives (box 1 taxation, a higher box 2 rate) are being consulted on, with a further measure planned in the Belastingplan 2026.
It is currently not possible to determine how often taxpayers with a lucrative interest use the substantial-interest variant.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk vast te stellen hoe vaak belastingplichtigen met een lucratief belang gebruikmaken van de aanmerkelijkbelangvariant
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Kisteman over het voorkomen dat financieel gezonde bedrijven onnodig failliet gaan en het bieden van maatwerk voor ondernemers met coronabelastingschulden

MPs Van Eijk and Kisteman (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about bankruptcies of financially healthy firms with corona tax debts, the scope for tailored debt settlements, and operational problems with creditors, payment terms and the valuation of settlement offers. The State Secretary answered at length, announcing amendments to the collection guidelines from 1 July 2025 (clarifying hold-out creditors and allowing settlement payments beyond twelve months), while defending the existing rules on creditors, enforcement proceeds and deadlines and promising ongoing monitoring via stand-van-zakenbrieven.
I can now inform the House that two amendments to the Collection Guidelines 2008 have proven feasible from 1 July 2025.
Ik kan uw Kamer inmiddels mededelen dat twee wijzigingen van de Leidraad invordering 2008 (LI 2008) haalbaar zijn gebleken per 1 juli 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de berekeningen van de expat regeling

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance to confirm the budgetary estimates for the expat tax regime amendment, including whether behavioural effects reduce the expected revenue from 1,071 to 216 million euros and how to calculate them. The State Secretary confirms the figures as budgetary revenue rather than costs, explains that behavioural effects lower rather than raise the revenue, and provides a worked calculation (10% effect yields about 194 million euros), but declines to provide the original memos since amendments are not part of the CPB certification process.
There is no estimate memo available, because amendments do not go through the CPB certification process.
Er is geen ramingsmemo beschikbaar, omdat amendementen niet meelopen in het certificeringsproces van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de uitkoop van boeren en de daaropvolgende migratie van bedrijfsbezit naar privé

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary of Finance how often farmers who exit via the voluntary buyout scheme face large tax assessments when business assets such as the farmhouse move to private use, whether this deters exits, and whether a conservation assessment or payment deferral could help. The State Secretary said there are no signals that farmers are deterred, pointed to the broadened reinvestment reserve, said further tax measures were judged of limited effect, and described the existing conservation assessment and payment-deferral options.

I am not aware of any signals that farmers, because of the tax consequences of withdrawing business assets for private use upon cessation, are caught in difficulties when participating in a voluntary termination scheme.

Er zijn mij geen signalen bekend dat agrariërs, vanwege de fiscale gevolgen van het onttrekken van bedrijfsmiddelen naar privé in het kader van de staking van de onderneming, in de knel komen bij deelname aan een vrijwillige beëindigingsregeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de late bekendmaking van de forfaitaire rendementspercentages in Box 3

An MP asked why the 2024 Box 3 forfait return percentages were only published on 7 March 2025, and whether publication could be accelerated. The State Secretary replied that the percentages are set after the year ends by ministerial regulation with retroactive effect, that averages are only available in January, that no legal publication deadline exists, and promised to publish next year's regulation by 1 March 2026.
The law contains no final publication deadline for the ministerial regulation.
In de wet is geen uiterste publicatiedatum opgenomen voor de ministeriële regeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over “de opdracht die de staatssecretaris van Financiën – Fiscaliteit, Belastingdienst en Douane aan de Belastingdienst heeft verstrekt inzake de analyse van de 14 spreadsheets”

MP Ergin asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's analysis of 14 spreadsheets with nationality-based selections, how it will be carried out, who supervises it, whether it will be externally tested, and why 35 postcode-based spreadsheets were excluded. The government answered that the analysis follows the Selectie aan de Poort compensation approach, that the Auditdienst Rijk will independently review it with reporting after summer 2025, and that the 35 postcode spreadsheets are now included after a legal analysis.
In June 2025 the Belastingdienst will deliver the analysis to the Auditdienst Rijk.
In juni 2025 zal de Belastingdienst de analyse aanleveren aan de ADR.
Antwoord op vragen aan van het lid Teunissen over de uitvoer van honden door het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Customs records exports of live animals, including dogs, by destination and exporter, and how many dogs were exported to Israel and whether the Ministry of Defence exported dogs since October 2023. The government answered that Customs holds export declarations but dogs fall under a general animal code, reported 4,435 dogs exported worldwide in 2024 (93 to Israel), found no Defence dog exports, and declined to give exporter or recipient details citing privacy rules.
Due to privacy regulations, Customs unfortunately cannot provide data concerning the exporter or recipient.
Vanwege privacy voorschriften kan de Douane u helaas geen gegevens verstrekken die zien op de exporteur of ontvanger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over de financiële achteruitgang van mensen met een beperking door kabinetsbeleid

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the state secretaries about financial losses for people with disabilities, including higher Wlz own contributions and lower take-home pay for sheltered-work staff from tax changes and an expired CAO. The government says the Wlz increase follows from the minimum wage rise, that the tax changes cause losses of up to about 15 euro per month, and that it is talking with the VNG about financing sheltered work, but that it is not a party to the CAO negotiations.
The cabinet is not a party to the CAO negotiations for the group working at social development companies and therefore takes a cautious stance on the CAO Aan de slag.
Het kabinet is geen partij in de cao-onderhandelingen voor de doelgroep die werkt bij sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven en stelt zich daarom terughoudend op ten aanzien van de cao Aan de slag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over vermogende Nederlanders die dividendbelasting ontwijken via drielandenpuntconstructies

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about wealthy Dutch emigrants using 'three-country-point' constructions to avoid dividend and corporate tax, and whether penalties rather than only back-tax assessments can be imposed. The government explained how the constructions work, said they are hard to count, noted measures taken and a pending evaluation of fiscal residence rules, but did not commit to new steps beyond existing measures and a planned list of constructions in the Spring Memorandum.
How often such a construction has been applied in practice is difficult to establish.
Hoe vaak een dergelijke constructie in de praktijk is toegepast, is lastig vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman en Van Eijk over de BijzonderBeheer Barometer van PwC

Two VVD MPs asked the Economy and Finance ministers about PwC's Bijzonder Beheer Barometer on support for shops, a tax-authority rule requiring all creditors in a debt-restructuring agreement, and the 12-month payment limit. The minister said the Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden had strong demand but no budget for extension, defended the creditor-inclusion rule against unilateral restructurings while noting WHOA flexibility, and rejected longer repayment periods as a general rule while leaving room for exceptions.
I am aiming to send this information to your House in March.
Ik zet er op in deze informatie in maart aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Grinwis over het bericht 'Steeds meer miljonairs verhuizen naar belastingparadijzen'

Two MPs (Dassen and Grinwis) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that wealthy people are moving to tax havens, and whether this undermines support for the tax system and warrants a trailing tax. The State Secretary answered that such fiscally motivated moves are undesirable, that research on emigration figures and the evaluation of residence determinations is ongoing with results promised for spring, and that Dutch efforts continue at OECD and EU level without committing to a national trailing tax yet.
A next step I want to take is to investigate whether reliable figures can be provided on how many people, and with what fiscal interest, emigrate to a country with no or low taxation.

Een volgende stap die ik daarom wil zetten, is onderzoeken of er betrouwbare cijfers zijn te geven over hoeveel personen en met welk fiscaal belang emigreren naar een land met geen of een lage belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Memorandum for the Secretary of the Treasury (VS) inzake de Global Tax Deal

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the January 2025 US presidential memorandum rejecting the OECD global minimum tax deal and threatening countermeasures against foreign tax measures, and about the Dutch and EU response. The minister answered that the Netherlands implemented the Pillar Two rules via the Wet minimumbelasting 2024, that the memorandum gives no detail on countermeasures, and that the Netherlands will coordinate with the EU and other countries without committing to changing the law.
It is unclear which draft bills are meant here. Furthermore, the memorandum gives no insight into the possible design of any countermeasures.
Het is onduidelijk welke conceptwetsvoorstellen hier worden bedoeld. Verder geeft het memorandum geen inzicht in de mogelijke vormgeving van eventuele tegenmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de Brief monitoring van de effecten van de aanpak van belastingontwijking

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the effectiveness of the earnings stripping and additional CFC measures under ATAD1, the consultation practice for the low-tax jurisdiction list, the compliance burden of overlapping anti-avoidance rules, the 2021 CFC income adjustment, the Model B CFC rule, foreign direct investment figures, and pending EU tax directive proposals. The State Secretary answered that effects are hard to measure and not statistically proven, that consultation on the list is only needed for new listings, that overlapping measures were deliberately left without a special offset rule, and provided FDI data and a pointer to a possible confidential briefing on EU tax negotiations.
Your House of Parliament has placed a parliamentary reservation on the BEFIT (corporate tax harmonisation) directive proposal.
Uw Kamer heeft een behandelbehoud gemaakt ten aanzien van het BEFIT (harmonisatie vennootschapsbelasting) richtlijnvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de landgoederenvrijstelling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rise in NSW estate registrations, possible tax-avoidance use, who decides on qualification, enforcement, purpose and evaluation of the scheme, and whether misuse measures will be proposed. The State Secretary reported a steady increase in registered estates, denied signals of tax avoidance, described the qualification and control process, and said the next evaluation is planned for 2033 with no new misuse measures foreseen.
No, there are no known signals at RVO, the Tax Authority or the Ministries of Finance and LVVN that this increase is (partly) due to setting up tax avoidance structures.
Nee, er zijn geen signalen bekend bij de RVO, de Belastingdienst noch de Ministeries van Financiën en LVVN dat deze toename (deels) te wijten is aan het opzetten van fiscale ontwijkingsconstructies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Speciaal verslag ‘Bestrijding van schadelijke belastingregelingen en ontwijking van vennootschapsbelasting’ d.d. 29 november 2024 van de Europese Rekenkamer

MP Van Eijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Court of Auditors' special report on combating harmful tax regimes and corporate tax avoidance, covering its scope, main conclusions, Dutch best practices, the TDRD dispute mechanism and an alternative arbitration committee. The State Secretary answered each question, noting the report targets the European Commission rather than member states, highlighting Dutch practices and stricter-than-minimum ATAD implementation, and stating Dutch support for Commission guidance while promising arbitration committee developments in early 2025.

Question 6: Does the European Court of Auditors identify improvement points for the Netherlands in the report? If so, what are they? Answer 6: The ERK directs its recommendations to the European Commission, and to that extent the ERK identifies no concrete improvement points for the Netherlands.

Vraag 6 Signaleert de Europese Rekenkamer in het rapport verbeterpunten voor Nederland? Zo ja, wat zijn deze verbeterpunten? Antwoord 6 De ERK richt haar aanbevelingen tot de Europese Commissie, en in zoverre signaleert de ERK geen concrete verbeterpunten voor Nederland.

qa: Vragen van de leden Willemse-van der Ploeg en Jonker (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Bejaarde homo’s terug in de kast» (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

CDA MPs asked the health minister about reports of gay elderly residents being pushed back into the closet in care homes, including the extent of negative treatment, institutional anti-discrimination policy, complaint procedures, and the role of elderly organisations. The minister answered that client satisfaction surveys show residents are satisfied, pointed to the Roze Ouderen project, Roze Loper tolerance scans and the complaints act, and promised continued monitoring and further projects without committing to new binding measures.
No specific figures are known about this, but every institution should pay attention to the treatment of clients in their institution.
Hier zijn geen specifieke cijfers over bekend, maar elke instelling dient aandacht te besteden aan de bejegening van de cliënten in hun instelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu van activiteiten in het Waddengebied

An MP asked about the cumulative effects on nature and environment of activities in the Wadden Sea, including salt mining by Frisia, shrinking ebb-tidal deltas, the number of permits, and whether the ministry will coordinate cumulative assessment. The State Secretary answered that permits for Frisia are still pending, that effects will be monitored with a hand-on-the-tap approach, that cumulative effects are assessed by each competent authority, and that no ministry coordination or regional talks are deemed necessary.
I am of the view that the cumulative effects on nature and environment are adequately mapped through the legal instruments described above when assessing new activities.
Ik ben van mening dat de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu door bovenbeschreven wettelijk instrumentarium adequaat in beeld worden gebracht bij het toetsen van nieuwe activiteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de plannen voor de bouw van een nertsenhouderij nabij Stevensbeek

An MP asked the state secretaries whether a mink farm planned near Stevensbeek, close to a school, an orchard and sports fields, was desirable, and whether they would intervene despite a moratorium and an expected health council advice. The government answered that the municipality is responsible for the environmental permit, that it saw no way to intervene in ongoing permit applications, and that the cabinet's policy response to the health council advice would reach parliament by 1 March 2013.
During that debate I indicated that I see no possibilities to intervene in ongoing permit applications and that this is a municipal responsibility.
Tijdens die behandeling heb ik aangegeven geen mogelijkheden te zien om in te grijpen in lopende vergunningaanvragen en dat het hier een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het promoten van het bereiden van houtsnippen voor consumptie

An MP asked the ministers whether the public broadcaster's cooking of woodcock, which is protected in the Netherlands, promotes illegal hunting, and whether trade and import should be banned. The government answered that broadcasters are responsible for their content, that woodcock may legally be hunted and traded if obtained lawfully abroad, and declined to investigate, ban imports or monitor trade.
The Media Act provides that the public broadcaster is itself responsible for the form and content of its programmes.
In de Mediawet is opgenomen dat de publieke omroep zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de vorm en inhoud van zijn programma’s.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de MRSA-bacterie op vleeskuikenboerderijen

An MP asked the health minister and state secretary about MRSA found on broiler farms and in slaughterhouse workers, the NVWA's advice to reduce antibiotic use and change stunning methods, and what measures are planned. The government answered that antibiotic reduction targets and guidance for exposed workers are in place, that further research on ducks and turkeys is commissioned for 2013, and that stunning changes follow EU rules.
That is why measures have been taken against the cause of multi-resistant bacteria.
Daarom zijn er maatregelen ingezet tegen de oorzaak van het voorkomen van multiresistente bacteriën.
qn: Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de wijze waarop de provincie Overijssel voornemens is de EHS te realiseren

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether Overijssel's plan to realise a reduced Ecological Main Structure and drop robust connecting zones breaches the coalition agreement, and what sanctions exist. The government replies that the province is following the agreed herijking procedure, that a robust EHS plus is being defined jointly with provinces by spring 2013, and that it will not order the province to act now, while promising agreements on timing, monitoring and financing.
This is not at issue. At the meeting of 23 November, my predecessor agreed with the provincial executives for rural areas to start a joint process to shape the robust EHS.

Dit is niet aan de orde. In het overleg van 23 november jl. is door mijn voorganger met de gedeputeerden landelijk gebied de afspraak gemaakt om een gezamenlijk traject te starten om de robuuste EHS vorm te geven.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de belangenverstrengeling bij de toelating van bestrijdingsmiddelen en de negatieve gevolgen voor bijen en andere bestuivers

An MP asks the State Secretary about conflicts of interest and independence at the Ctgb, which assesses pesticides, including a former director's move to SETAC, SETAC funding by industry, and methodology used for imidacloprid water-quality standards. The government answers that the Ctgb is an independent body with a sound assessment framework and integrity code, sees no need for new rules on career moves, and will inform Parliament on improvement tracks and raise the transparency motion with the Ctgb.
The Ctgb is an independent administrative body that takes decisions on authorisation independently.
Het Ctgb is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat in onafhankelijkheid besluiten neemt over de toelating.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het recht van ieder kind op natuur

An MP asked the state secretary whether a child's right to nature and a clean environment should be recognised and anchored in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, and what targets the government sets for the 70 percent of Dutch children who rarely visit nature. The state secretary agreed the concern is valid, said the existing children's rights in the UN Convention suffice, and pointed to stimulus measures carried out mainly by local authorities and nature organisations.

The children's rights to protection, life and development, health and recreation as set out in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child provide sufficient guarantees for bringing children into contact with nature.

De rechten van kinderen op bescherming, op leven en ontwikkeling, op gezondheid en op recreatie zoals omschreven in het Internationaal Verdrag inzake de Rechten van het Kind (IVRK), bieden voldoende waarborgen voor het in contact brengen van kinderen met de natuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over het terugvorderen van toegezegde middelen bij de voedingstuinbouwsector

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reclaiming GMO fruit and vegetable subsidies from the horticulture sector, including the environmental measure, and the resulting penalties and effects on accountant opinions. The State Secretary answered that the EU rules require the subsidies to be recovered, that no fine is imposed for not carrying out the programme, and that she sees no room to waive recovery.
European law therefore gives me no room in this situation to waive recovery.
Het Europees recht biedt mij dan ook in deze situatie geen ruimte om af te zien van terugvordering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouw over het terugtrekken van de overheid uit het Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouw asked whether the government's cooperation agreement on the Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel ends on 1 January 2013 and whether the state withdraws, and how that fits a parliamentary motion requiring active continuation. The state secretary confirmed the agreement expires, says the government stays involved via a regiegroep and topsector policy, and promises a 3-year overview and an evaluation around summer 2013.
The government remains directly involved in the sustainability process of the food chain through the Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens.
De overheid blijft via de Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens direct betrokken bij het verduurzamingsproces van de voedselketen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en De Boer betreffende de juridisering van het natuurbeschermingsbeleid

Two MPs (Dijkgraaf and De Boer) asked the state secretary whether she agrees that the Natura 2000 legal framework has juridified nature conservation policy and eroded local support, and what she will do with the article's findings, including on the Boetelerveld buffer zone dispute. The state secretary answered that clear legal boundary conditions are unavoidable but that local stakeholders should weigh options within them, and that she trusts the province to conduct a sound process.
Clear boundary conditions with possible legal consequences are unavoidable.
Duidelijke randvoorwaarden met mogelijk juridische consequenties zijn onontkoombaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de explosieve toename en slacht van paarden in Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary about a sharp rise in horse slaughter, speculative breeding and impulse purchases, weak welfare policy, the rising number of neglect reports and labelling of horsemeat. The state secretary answers that the government lacks an overview of slaughter causes, relies on the Gids voor Goede Praktijken enforced by NVWA and the Inspectorate, promises to inform parliament about impulse purchases in mid-2013, and states that labelling already requires horsemeat to be identified.
For impulse purchases, it was promised during the committee debate on animal shelters of 20 November that you would be informed about impulse purchases of animals around mid-2013.
Voor wat betreft impulsaankopen is in het AO opvang van dieren van 20 november toegezegd om u medio 2013 te informeren over impulsaankopen van dieren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jacobi over de toepassing van de subsidieregeling schaapskuddes

MPs Van Gerven and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the sheep-flock subsidy scheme, including late publication, eligibility safeguards against intensive livestock farms, excluded rare breeds, and delayed payments under the ferry allowance scheme. The state secretary defended the eligibility criteria and the one-off nature of the scheme, said the ferry allowance payments would follow the planned schedule, and gave no individual accommodation.
The subsidy scheme is however limited to flocks of sheep being herded with rare Dutch breeds.
De subsidieregeling is echter beperkt tot gescheperde schaapskuddes met zeldzame Nederlandse rassen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over terugkeer legbatterijeieren in Europa

Thieme (PvdD) asked whether plans to lower import duties on non-EU eggs would bring battery eggs back to Europe, whether consumers can be protected, and whether the Netherlands will push for a ban on imported battery eggs. The minister denied any general duty cut, said trade deals include only limited quota-based tariff reductions and animal welfare commitments, and rejected an import ban as incompatible with WTO rules.
There is therefore no question of a general reduction of import duties on eggs and egg products.
Er is dan ook geen sprake van een algemene verlaging van de invoerheffingen op eieren en ei-producten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vertraging van het convenant gevaccineerd vlees

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the government will not contribute to a fund covering market losses for vaccinated livestock, and about the handling of vaccination and culling policy. The State Secretary refuses a direct financial contribution, citing the policy of not compensating consequential damage, but commits to work on removing EU and OIE trade restrictions on vaccinated animals and to pursue DIVA vaccines.
My decision is by no means a no to the use of vaccination, but it is a no to the intended role of the government in covering the consequential damage.
Mijn besluit is dus geenszins een nee tegen de inzet van vaccinatie, maar wel tegen de beoogde rol voor de overheid bij het afdekken van de gevolgschade.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van herten omwille van de openstelling van een ecoduct

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the state secretary about the culling of deer near the Hierden/A28 ecoduct, questioning who initiated it, its cost, the buffer zone, consistency with animal welfare, and the central government's role. The state secretary answered that the ecoduct was a national-funded MJPO project on provincial initiative, that culling follows the provincial Faunabeheerplan and is unrelated to the ecoduct, and that natural policy is decentralised so the province is responsible.
Because of the decentralisation of nature policy, the province is responsible.
Vanwege de decentralisatie van het natuurbeleid is de provincie verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval'

An MP asked whether RWE's FUREC project producing green hydrogen from household waste counts toward the RED-III binding green hydrogen target, how other EU states handle this, and what the government will do to support such projects and resolve grid connection delays. The minister answered that the project does not qualify as RFNBO because it uses partly biogenic waste rather than renewable electricity, that the government remains in contact with RWE and will keep supporting it, and that grid congestion is being addressed through prioritisation rules and the industry decarbonisation programme.
No. RED-III uses the term 'renewable fuel of non-biological origin' (abbreviated RFNBO in English) for green hydrogen.
Nee. In de RED-III wordt de term «hernieuwbare brandstof van niet-biologische oorsprong» (in het Engels afgekort tot RFNBO) gehanteerd voor groene waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het artikel 'Schuldhulpverlening ziet fors meer bedrijven met geldzorgen'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about rising debt-relief requests from small businesses, including the pilots and the proposed access point and bookkeeping voucher. The minister acknowledges the trend, reports on pilots and an access point due in Q1 2025, rejects the voucher, and points to municipal support.
As soon as those are available, we will send them to the House.
Zodra die beschikbaar zijn zullen we die naar de Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport ACM naar aanleiding van de lage spaarrentes bij banken

A D66 MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the ACM report finding that Dutch bank savings rates lag due to insufficient competition and tacit coordination among large banks. The minister acknowledged the findings, promised follow-up steps such as studies on mandatory standalone savings accounts, transparency requirements, and exploring number portability, while noting limits on enforcement and that IBAN portability is technically complex and costly.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who do not have a payment account with them.
Ik ga onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Astronomische rentes, nul toezicht: kasvoorschotten nekken kleine ondernemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of very high effective interest rates on business cash advances and the lack of supervision by the AFM or DNB, and whether these should be regulated or banned. The minister acknowledges the high rates but argues cash advances meet a real need, relies on a voluntary industry code of conduct and a planned financing hub, and rejects a total ban or rate cap while committing to urge providers to join the code.
It is indeed correct that specific rules and financial supervision are lacking in this business lending market.
Het klopt inderdaad dat specifieke regels en financieel toezicht op deze zakelijke financieringsmarkt ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bedrijven van de toekomst vragen om meer steun van Den Haag’

An MP asks the minister about calls for more government risk-sharing with scale-ups, the progress and funding of the National Technology Strategy, and an amendment on NTS funding. The minister replies that existing instruments (Invest-NL, ROM's, guarantees, procurement guidance) already share risk, that NTS work continues with timelines through 2025, and that funding is uncertain because the Nationaal Groeifonds is being phased out.
At this moment I cannot say what amount is needed for the implementation of the NTS.
Ik kan op dit moment niet zeggen welk bedrag nodig is voor de uitvoering van de NTS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het opschorten van de AI-plannen van Meta na druk toezichthouders

An MP asks the government whether Meta may use users' photos and posts to train AI models under GDPR, DMA and the AI Act, whether its legitimate-interest claim holds, and whether opt-in, collective objection and EU coordination are possible. The minister answers that the assessment of lawfulness lies with the data protection authorities (AP and the Irish DPC), that the DMA may apply, that the government will not intervene in individual cases, and that no joint EU position is being prepared.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether Meta's plans are acceptable, but primarily for the supervisory authority.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of de plannen van Meta acceptabel zijn, maar in de eerste plaats aan de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het toezicht op webwinkels als Temu, AliExpres en Shein

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked the ministers about oversight of Temu, Shein and AliExpress, covering unfair trade practices, dark patterns, product safety, privacy, Chinese ties and BNPL promotion. The minister answered that existing EU and Dutch rules and the ACM, NVWA and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are responsible, pointed to pending EU initiatives such as the fitness check, DSA and product safety regulation, and declined to order investigations or disclose details of internal app measures.
Because of this confidentiality, I cannot go further into these measures.
Door deze vertrouwelijkheid kan ik dan ook niet verder ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat werknemers in een brief stellen dat OpenAI roekeloos is en dat het ontbreekt aan toezicht

An MP asked the ministers whether they are aware of employees' letter calling OpenAI reckless and lacking oversight, how the AI Act's delayed entry into force can be bridged, whether an AI advisory council and an AI factory should be set up, and whether the government will press the European Commission for transparency from OpenAI. The government answered at length that the AI Act is being phased in, that Dutch supervisors (AP's DCA, RDI) are preparing oversight, that an AI advisory council is being explored with results expected this autumn, and that the EU AI Office will oversee general-purpose models and draft codes of practice in dialogue with providers.
I expect to be able to share the outcomes of this study with your House this autumn.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valize over het bericht van Elon Musk op X waarin hij stelt alle apparaten van Apple te zullen weren uit zijn bedrijven wanneer OpenAI geïntegreerd wordt op OS-niveau

MP Valize asked the government about Elon Musk's threat to ban Apple devices from his companies if OpenAI were integrated at OS level, and about the security and privacy risks, DMA/AI Act compliance and safeguards. The minister answered that such integration carries risks that the government would address through procurement conditions, impact assessments and existing regulators, notably the Irish data protection authority, and that Apple had postponed its EU rollout.
Apple has, incidentally, postponed the rollout of the integration of OpenAI's ChatGPT within the EU.
Apple heeft overigens de uitrol van de integratie van ChatGTP van OpenAI binnen de EU uitgesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Rajkowski over de huiverigheid van werkgevers om kunstmatige intelligentie in te zetten

MPs Aartsen and Rajkowski asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch employers' reluctance to deploy AI, including its role in easing labour shortages, comparisons with Poland, Germany and Belgium, and government support. The ministers answered that AI offers productivity gains and labour-shortage relief, pointed to existing programmes (AiNed, ROBUST, NL AIC), and announced an SER advisory request and an exploration of an AI advisory council.
It is expected that a proposal will be sent to your House this autumn.
Naar verwachting wordt dit najaar een voorstel aan uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Van Meetelen over de rellen en racistische leuzen gericht naar kermisexploitanten in Emmeloord

MPs Van Meetelen and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about riots, vandalism and racist chants aimed at fairground operators in Emmeloord, including whether closing hours and costs should fall on the operators, and what prosecution follows. The Minister says municipalities are equipped to handle such disorder, leaves the local measures and prosecution to the mayor and Openbaar Ministerie, and notes that victims can pursue civil claims or request partial restitution of the pitch fee.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide how it follows up on this.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen hoe zij hier opvolging aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Podt en Inge van Dijk over het dreigende vertrek van ASML

MPs Sneller, Podt and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about reports of a secret government operation ('Project Beethoven') to prevent ASML from relocating abroad, the economic stakes, the fourth Growth Fund round, talent attraction and expat policy. The government confirmed Project Beethoven as a sector-support effort, explained the stakes and measures, said the fourth Growth Fund round is paused and will likely be dropped by the new coalition, and outlined talent and migration policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten dat ASML en Boskalis dreigen te vertrekken uit Nederland

MPs Eerdmans asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that ASML and Boskalis threaten to leave the Netherlands, the perceived deterioration of the investment climate, lower returns compared with other countries, the Irish tax model, regulatory burden, and policy predictability. The minister answered that the Dutch business climate is solid but has weakened, pointed to the Strategic Agenda, the Monitor Ondernemingsklimaat, the minimum-tax law and the strengthened impact assessment, and said most of these matters require further study or political decisions.
The Netherlands has a solid business climate, but the art is to maintain this high level and to address bottlenecks timely and effectively.
Nederland beschikt over een solide ondernemingsklimaat, maar de kunst is dit hoge niveau vast te houden en knelpunten tijdig en doeltreffend aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Zeedijk over het Convenant Rijk en regio investeringen in ondernemingsklimaat microchipsector

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Rijk-regio convenant on investments in the microchip sector in the Brainport region, covering signing status, private contributions, talent funding, housing, energy and nitrogen capacity. The minister answered that the convenant is pending parliamentary and provincial approval, that the €1.6bn 2022 package excluded talent funding, and that several details (distribution, private contributions, risk allocation, housing shares) remain to be agreed later.
The agreements in the convenant are, for the central government, subject to approval by the Staten-Generaal.
De afspraken in het convenant zijn voor het Rijk onder voorbehoud van instemming door de Staten-Generaal
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Zeedijk over de Nationale Circulaire Plastic

MPs Olger van Dijk and Zeedijk asked the government about the planned recyclate blending norm for plastics, its EU alignment, competitive effects, recyclate supply and certification. The minister answered that the norm bill is still under review after consultation, that the EU is advancing product-specific recyclate requirements, and that EUR 267 million in subsidies is available, while many questions were deferred to a new cabinet or later regulations.
The decision to be based on this is for the new cabinet.
Het hierop te baseren besluit is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars overstappers belemmeren waardoor de premie onnodig hoog is

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that health insurers hinder switching, keeping premiums unnecessarily high, and about the effects on low-income groups, market oversight and basic-policy complexity. The minister acknowledges the issue, points to NZa information rules and planned exploration of more active notification, says no research into income groups will be commissioned, and notes that investigations by ACM and NZa are independent and confidential.
I will not commission research into the switching behaviour of different income groups.
Ik zal geen onderzoek uitzetten naar het overstapgedrag van verschillende inkomensgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over vervuilende bedrijven die grootaandeelhouders verrijken ten koste van mens en klimaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Milieudefensie report claiming polluting companies enrich major shareholders at the expense of people and climate, and how subsidies, shareholder payouts and possible windfall taxes relate. The minister acknowledges large payouts, rejects the claim that companies enrich shareholders at climate cost, defends subsidies for unprofitable decarbonisation, and declines a sector-specific windfall tax as legally difficult and undesirable.
This is public information that can be found in the annual reports of the individual customised-agreement companies.
Dit is openbare informatie die te vinden is in de jaarverslagen van de individuele maatwerkbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het nieuwsbericht ‘Winkelstraat loopt verder leeg: al 433.000 vierkante meter niet meer gebruikt’

The MP asks the minister about reports of growing vacancy in shopping streets, especially in smaller town centres, and the role of municipalities and the Impuls Winkelgebieden programme. The minister answers that the Corona effect has faded, that municipalities must take local lead, and that the first evaluation is due in 2027.
At the end of November the last decisions will be issued.
Eind november zullen de laatste beschikkingen worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het bericht ‘Van plofkip tot slacht: hoe heilig is het halalkeurmerk in de supermarkt eigenlijk’

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked whether supermarkets selling halal-certified chicken that is actually cheaper plofkip (broiler) meat amount to consumer deception, and whether ACM, NVWA oversight of halal slaughter and the 2012 convenant are adequate. The minister replied that supermarkets' move to BLk1* chicken is a private initiative outside government judgment, that halal certification is a private matter with no government role, and that existing accreditation and inspection frameworks are sufficient, committing to no new action.
The halal certification mark is a private initiative.
Het halal keurmerk betreft een privaat initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathmann over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat

MPs Van Kent and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about recent bankruptcies in shopping streets, worker protection in insolvency, director liability, union access to company information, and takeover safeguards. The government answered that bankruptcies remain historically moderate, that workers' protections are being strengthened through the planned Wovof bill and existing information rights, and that existing company disclosure rules are considered sufficient, with consultation ongoing on the bill.
Work is underway to strengthen the position of employees in bankruptcy, particularly when a company in bankruptcy is taken over (a restart).
Er wordt gewerkt aan versterking van de positie van werknemers in faillissement, in het bijzonder wanneer sprake is van een overname van een onderneming in faillissement (een doorstart).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Bromet, Vedder en Holman over het rondetafelgesprek Wolf van 4 april 2024

MPs from four parties asked the ministers about LIFE and Regional Development Fund subsidy options for wolf coexistence measures raised at a round-table meeting, and whether these had been examined. The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Wachtlijst stroomnet explodeert door energietransitie, jaren wachten op stroom geen uitzondering’ en het artikel ‘Huishoudens, scholen en kleinbedrijf van stroomn

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid congestion, waiting lists for connections, numbers affected, average waiting times, grid outages and economic damage. The minister answered that waiting lists exist mainly for large consumers (about 9,400 connection and 10,000 feed-in requests), that waiting times vary too much by region to average, that ACM set connection-term rules in April 2024, and that exact economic damage is hard to quantify, promising a study before summer.
For large consumption, grid operators do not know what function a building behind an existing or requested connection has, or will have.
Voor grootverbruik geldt dat netbeheerders niet weten welke functie een gebouw – achter een bestaande of aangevraagde aansluiting – heeft, of zal krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het buurtinitiatief grijpt naast de opdrachten voor energiebesparing’

An MP asked whether neighbourhood initiatives tackling energy poverty are being crowded out of municipal tenders by commercial parties, and whether municipalities can use other allocation methods. The minister answered that municipalities have broad discretion to spend the funds (tendering, subsidies, in-house, open house), that tender rules allow weighting of sustainability and social impact, and promised a meeting on sharing best practices under the MVOI manifesto.
No, I do not have that overview.
Nee, dat overzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de TEK-terugbetalingen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether sports association volunteers were adequately warned about repayment of the TEK energy subsidy advance, how subsidy schemes can be made more reliable, and what support sports clubs will get given high energy costs. The minister answered that the repayment risk was communicated repeatedly, that an evaluation of the TEK is being considered in response to Court of Audit and committee questions, and that no additional measures are planned for sports clubs, while offering to talk with the sector if needed.
I am now assessing how best to give substance to this, for example in the form of an evaluation of the TEK.
Ik beoordeel nu op welke wijze het beste hieraan invulling kan worden gegeven in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld een evaluatie van de TEK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Netbeheerder: na 2030 grotere kans op prijspiekendoor stroomtekorten'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about TenneT's warning of possible electricity shortages and price spikes after 2030, linked to coal and gas plant phase-outs, rising demand and limited batteries and flexibility. The minister acknowledged the risks, said coal phase-out and gas plant changes stay, promised a supply-security action plan by year-end, and said the wider energy system agenda will follow after summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Eerdmans over ‘de (cyber)veiligheid van Nederlandse offshore olie- en gasplatforms’

An MP asked about threats to Dutch offshore oil and gas platforms and offshore wind parks, the security measures taken, international cooperation, and cyber risks. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the threat is documented in intelligence reports, outlined sector rules, vital-infrastructure designation, NIS2 and CER implementation, and cooperation with other states, while declining to discuss individual incidents for security reasons.
For security reasons I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk  over het artikel 'Netbeheerders kunnen weinig met prioriteit voor Brainport'

CDA MPs asked whether the minister knew of reports that grid operators could do little with the government's promised priority for the Brainport region, why the November 2023 letter seemed to surprise them, and what the grid response would be. The minister answered that the priority concerns congestion instruments and the regional energy infrastructure plan (MIEK), not individual connection priority which is set by the regulator ACM, and described short-, medium- and long-term actions with TenneT, Enexis and the region.
The priority status of Brainport is not intended to mean that connecting individual companies on the waiting list in the region would automatically get higher priority than in other regions.

Met de prioritaire status van Brainport is niet bedoeld dat het aansluiten van individuele bedrijven die op de wachtlijst staan in de regio per definitie een hogere prioriteit zou krijgen dan in andere regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitzending van Kassa over kermissen die onder druk staan van 20 april 2024

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Kassa broadcast on fairground pressures, including whether the government will convene stakeholders to find support measures for small-town fairs. The minister acknowledges the cultural value of fairs, points to a municipal guidance document, and agrees to explore a short-term consultation with trade bodies and the VNG.
I will have EZK contact the Dutch Fairground Association, the national fairground operators' association and the VNG to establish whether they want a consultation in the short term.

Ik zal vanuit EZK contact laten leggen met De Nederlandse Kermisbond (NKB), de Nationale Bond van Kermisbedrijfhouders (BOVAK) en de VNG om te inventariseren of er vanuit die partijen behoefte is aan een overleg op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Tandarts en andere mkb’ers wacht nog een berg bureaucratie'

MPs Kisteman (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report on mounting bureaucratic burdens on small businesses, including rising compliance costs, reporting obligations and the role of the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says regulatory burden is a political trade-off, points to ongoing sector studies and a programme due in autumn, and defers the choice of a new reduction programme to the next cabinet.

The Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) advises the States General and cabinet and oversees correct, transparent information provision so that the cabinet and States General can decide on regulation on an informed basis.

Het Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) adviseert Staten-Generaal en kabinet en ziet toe op een juiste, transparante informatievoorziening zodat het kabinet en Staten-Generaal onderbouwd kunnen beslissen over regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het opschalen en toepassen van waterstof in de industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about hydrogen use in steel (TSN IJmuiden, Thyssenkrupp Duisburg), the FUREC project at Chemelot, grid congestion and offtake. The minister answered that negotiations with TSN are starting, gave a technical view of Thyssenkrupp's plans without judging their feasibility, and said the ministry is in talks with RWE and OCI but that offtake and grid prioritisation are largely for companies and network operators.
I can well understand this response from RWE.
Ik kan me deze reactie van RWE goed voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over hoge energieprijzen voor de industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about high electricity prices for heavy industry compared with neighbouring countries, which factors besides energy prices drive location choices, and whether support should be conditional. The minister answered that energy prices are a competitive disadvantage, outlined compensation (CEI and IKC-ETS), an infrastructure cost study, and efficiency measures, while noting that other location factors and company-level closure decisions involve many considerations.
We currently see a competitive disadvantage on electricity costs compared with neighbouring countries.
We zien dat er op dit moment sprake is van een concurrentienadeel op elektriciteitskosten ten opzichte van buurlanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat

MPs Van Kent and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about bankruptcies in shopping streets, workers' position in insolvency, the pending Wovof bill, director liability, and union access to company information. The answers were given orally on 12 March 2024, and this written reply refers to those oral answers.
The written questions from MPs Van Kent and Kathmann about the recent bankruptcies in the shopping street were answered through oral questions (2024Z03962) on 12 March 2024.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen ( 2024Z03962 ) op 12 maart 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het verbeteren van het bedrijfsklimaat in de defensiesector

An MP from JA21 asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about banks and pension funds reluctant to finance the defence industry and about regulation hampering defence producers. The government answered that it is consulting banks, pension funds and industry on financing bottlenecks, will report in June 2024, and is pursuing EU level-playing-field measures and a sectoral defence-industry law.
In June 2024 the House will be informed about the bottlenecks in financing defence-related companies and the measures that could strengthen this financing.
In juni 2024 zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de knelpunten voor financiering van defensie gerelateerde bedrijven en de maatregelen die deze financiering kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vermeer over de reactie van de minister over de landelijke uitrol van de Streetwise-methodiek

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vermeer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Streetwise method, which has supported startups and filled vacant shop space, should be rolled out nationally and what the ministry will do to support it. The minister answers that the approach is positive and not specific to Limburg, that a pilot in Overijssel could help, but that no firm rollout plan exists yet and the ministry will only stimulate partners to draw one up.
At present my ministry is playing a stimulating role in bringing about a broadly supported step-by-step plan by bringing parties together and convincing them of the need for such a plan.

Op dit moment speelt mijn ministerie een stimulerende rol bij het totstandkomen van een gedragen stappenplan door partijen bij elkaar te brengen en ze te overtuigen van de noodzaak van een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about the progress, investment timing, realisation deadline, the absence of an LPG/propylene pipeline initiator, and next steps with Germany on the Delta Rhine Corridor. The minister answered that the government supports and coordinates spatial planning and permits while investment decisions rest with private initiators, that no LPG/propylene initiator emerged, and that a letter on schedule effects will follow before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer of this year with a letter on the effect of this exercise on the project's planning.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer van dit jaar met een brief over het effect van deze exercitie op de planning van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over 100 tot 150 banen die weg gaan bij Batavus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about 100 to 150 job losses at Batavus, production moves abroad, and private equity takeovers such as KKR's acquisition of Accell Group, and whether the cabinet would act against large investors buying up the economy. The minister answered that restructuring is a company decision, that she prefers firms to stay in the Netherlands, that private equity is a legitimate financing source, and pointed to tax measures on debt financing and a business climate strategy.
It is further not for me to pass judgment on the strategy and policy of an individual company.
Het is verder niet aan mij om uitspraak te doen over de strategie en het beleid van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over te late postbezorging in Zeeland en slechte arbeidsvoorwaarden voor postbezorgers bij PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about late mail delivery in Zeeland, whether other regions are affected, what steps will be taken to restore quality, and whether poor working conditions for PostNL couriers contribute to the problem. The minister acknowledged that PostNL falls short of the statutory 95% on-time standard, pointed to ACM oversight, a pending Postwet amendment and a forthcoming policy letter, but said no signals link the problem to working conditions and largely deferred labour matters to general labour law.
It is not acceptable that PostNL does not meet the legally prescribed quality.
Het is niet acceptabel dat PostNL de wettelijk voorgeschreven kwaliteit niet haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gang van zaken omtrent toekenningen en reserveringen voor het Nationaal Groeifonds

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how conditional allocations and reservations under the National Growth Fund are structured, how they are tranched, whether they are legally binding, and whether reservations and expectations for a fourth round should be withdrawn. The minister answers that conditional allocations are legally binding but reservations are not, that the government will keep existing reservations, and that only communication, not firm commitments, has been made to prospective applicants for the fourth round.
The conversions of the reservations become legally binding after authorisation of the first supplementary budget (Voorjaarsnota) by both chambers.
De omzettingen van de reserveringen worden juridisch verplicht na autorisatie van de eerste suppletoire begroting (Voorjaarsnota) door beide Kamers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Zonder opgeleide werknemers staat de groene staalfabriek in 2030 stil' uit Trouw van 13 februari

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses at Tata Steel, the Sociaal Contract Groen Staal, and how the company's green transition could retain skilled workers and democratise the firm. The minister answered that the job reductions are the company's own choice, that the ministry was not involved in the social contract, and that she is pursuing a tailored agreement with Tata Steel on emissions and health.
It is up to the company to make its own choices and to adapt its operations to changing circumstances.
Het is aan het bedrijf om haar eigen keuzes te maken en om de bedrijfsvoering aan te passen aan veranderende omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Six Dijkstra en Sneller over de verhuizing van het.nl domein

MPs Kathmann, Six Dijkstra and Sneller asked about SIDN's plan to move the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, raising sovereignty, US access, oversight and security concerns. The minister answers that no move has yet occurred, that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps, that the RDI and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will review risks via a DPIA/DTIA, and that a quickscan of Dutch and EU alternatives will be carried out with a further letter expected in Q2.
It has been agreed that SIDN will not take any irreversible steps at this time.
Afgesproken is dat SIDN op dit moment geen onomkeerbare stappen zal zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over “RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval”

An MP asks the ministers how they will press grid operators Enexis and TenneT to keep the FUREC hydrogen-from-waste project on its 2026 connection schedule, and whether delay risks losing EU Innovation Fund money. The ministers say they have no direct role in grid connection priorities, point to the pending ACM prioritisation framework, and say RWE has not yet taken a final investment decision.
However, I have no role in the prioritisation of customer requests with grid operators.
Bij de prioritering van klantaanvragen bij netbeheerders heb ik echter geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Bontenbal en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Zinkfabriek Nyrstar in Budel legt productie stil’

MPs Erkens, Bontenbal and Grinwis asked how the government views the shutdown of the Nyrstar zinc plant in Budel over high energy costs, lack of state aid and the investment climate, and whether this reflects a wider industrial trend, the effect of the tax changes and the ending of the IKC and volume compensation schemes, the link to grid congestion and balancing, and how the government will address negative sentiment around industry.
