The minister acknowledges the high energy costs and competitive disadvantage relative to neighbours, defends the Dutch climate-led industrial policy ('greener here than grey elsewhere'), explains the reasons for ending the IKC and the ACM's abolition of the VCR, and promises further studies on electricity costs and a report to parliament, but gives limited concrete answers on grid congestion and some questions are answered by reference to policy stance.
I expect that the cabinet will inform the House later this quarter about the findings.
Ik verwacht dat het kabinet de Kamer later dit kwartaal zal inlichten over de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het wetsvoorstel maatschappelijke BV

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays in the maatschappelijke BV bill, which social entrepreneurs have long awaited and which was postponed by a year. The Minister says the draft still faces unresolved problems on profit and asset rules, will be reviewed by experts first, and that Parliament will be informed when the process is complete.
I will inform your House when it has been completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer berichten wanneer het is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het NOS-bericht dat milieuproblemen onbelangrijk waren voor een miljoenensubsidie aan DuPont begin jaren 80

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that environmental concerns were deemed unimportant when a DuPont chemical plant received a multi-million subsidy in the early 1980s, and about how subsidies and permit processes prevent such outcomes today. The minister said the files do not show the predecessor dismissed environmental problems, pointed to EU state aid rules, the environmental permitting and enforcement system, and EU chemical rules, but could not reconstruct the earlier weighing of arguments and could not assess the company report's role.
From the documents that have been made public, I cannot conclude that my predecessor considered environmental problems unimportant.
Uit de stukken die openbaar zijn gemaakt kan ik niet concluderen dat mijn voorganger milieuproblemen onbelangrijk vond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Netcongestie

MP Vermeer asked the Minister about Professor Vittal's warnings on grid stability, whether renewable integration should be halted, and whether the National Energy System Plan should be updated. The Minister replied that grid operators already use the relevant science, that no halt or plan revision is planned, and that smart charging rules are being developed with consent of those affected.
At this moment I see no reason to update the NPE.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden om het NPE bij te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sneller over het bericht 'Werkgevers: bedrijven verplaatsen nieuwe investeringen naar het buitenland'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that firms are shifting new investment abroad, the causes, the effects of nitrogen (stikstof) uncertainty, cuts to the National Growth Fund and R&D, and whether the government will commission studies. The minister acknowledges the concerns, attributes relocation mainly to firm-specific growth constraints, and commits to a study of the economic effects of nitrogen and to a letter on securing earning capacity, while leaving other questions to the next cabinet.
However, I can commit to a study to objectively map the main economic consequences of the nitrogen problem.
Wel kan ik een onderzoek toezeggen om de belangrijkste economische gevolgen van de stikstofproblematiek objectief in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Pijpelink over wachtrijen voor netaansluitingen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about grid connection queues in Zeeland and other provinces, including effects on jobs, firms affected, and investment in renewables. The minister answered that company-level queue data is confidential, the province warned only in general terms, and congestion research and flexible grid solutions are ongoing, without committing to a new concrete step.
Applications for a grid connection by individual companies with the grid operator are commercially confidential information.
Aanvragen voor een netaansluiting door individuele bedrijven bij de netbeheerder zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gebrekkige concurrentie in de Nederlandse bankensector en achterblijvende spaarrentes

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why savings rates lag behind mortgage and ECB rates, whether banks should be pressed to raise them, and what instruments exist such as ACM market scrutiny, state bonds for savers and windfall-profit measures. The minister answered that Dutch savings rates have risen more than the EU average, that the ACM is investigating the savings market, and that further policy options will await the ACM report.
I see no reason at this moment to hold new talks.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om opnieuw gesprekken te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Uitvoerder waarschuwt: Ondernemers raken gefrustreerd en haken af'

A CDA MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about RVO's warnings that complex schemes frustrate entrepreneurs, how signals from the field reach ministries, whether RVO is consulted early on feasibility, and how interdepartmental friction and regulatory burden are tackled. The minister answers that RVO feedback is shared with ministries through several structural consultations, that early involvement and a new 'opgavegericht' approach are being developed, and that a regulatory-burden coordinator structure already exists, but offers no new binding commitments.
Where the signals concern bottlenecks in policy, these are fed back to the departments concerned.
Daar waar het signalen over knelpunten in beleid betreft, worden deze teruggekoppeld naar de betrokken departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de zoutwinning in het Heiligerleeveld

MP Van Haga asks the minister about salt mining in Heiligerlee, including cavern dimensions exceeding limits, pillar spacing, subsidence, participation, abandonment plans and a diesel leak. The state secretary denies approval of the exceedances, states SodM monitors the caverns and finds no safety risks, says a subsidence plan change was adopted without new conditions, and promises further research on abandonment plans and the national-interest designation.
I recently agreed to an amendment of the mining plan.
Ik heb recent ingestemd met een aanpassing van het winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Resultaten MOB-vergadering 28 november 2023’

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the MOB's reachability monitor showing falling business satisfaction with payment services, bank information points, de-risking standards, bank tariff increases, and public cost-sharing for payments. The minister said he will report to parliament on the MOB's further analysis (expected autumn 2024), that bank information point pilots are continuing, that the NVB risk-based standards are non-binding and will be evaluated, and that he sees no reason for public subsidies for payments infrastructure.
When the outcomes of this are known, I will inform your House of the conclusions.
Wanneer de uitkomsten hiervan bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het achterwege blijven van afspraken met de industrie over reductie van de stikstofuitstoot

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why little has been agreed with industrial peak polluters on nitrogen emission reductions despite reported possibilities, and why talks have not yet produced concrete results. The minister replied that talks have been held with all 19 peak polluters, that existing regulation already drives emission declines, and that concrete reductions take time and cost checks, while committing to continue the approach and report progress to parliament.
I will keep your House informed of progress through the regular customised-agreement letters.
Ik zal uw Kamer via de reguliere maatwerkbrieven van de voortgang op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen zonder investering duurder dan gedacht’

MPs Boulakjar asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Radar broadcast showing misleading sales of leased solar panels with high-interest loans, and what the government would do about it and about the planned phase-out of net metering. The minister said consumer misleading rules apply, that enforcement is for ACM and AFM or the courts, pointed to Warmtefonds promotion and a forthcoming sector code, and described the net-metering phase-out.

Whether misleading occurs in specific cases is for the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and, where credit under the Wft is concerned, the Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM), or the courts.

Of er in specifieke gevallen sprake is van misleiding is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en, waar het gaat om krediet in de zin van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft), de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM), of aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het niet uitvoeren van de aangenomen motie ontheffing zero-emissiezone

Van Haga asks the minister whether she is aware of business concerns about zero-emission zones and whether she will immediately implement the adopted motion on exemptions for those zones. The minister says a largely harmonised exemption policy has been agreed with municipalities, with details in a letter from the State Secretary, and that this follows the motion.
In line with the Van Haga motion and as indicated above, there is a largely harmonised exemption policy for the zero-emission zone.
In lijn met de motie Van Haga en zoals hiervoor aangegeven is er een grotendeels geharmoniseerd ontheffingenbeleid voor de zero-emissiezone.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de innovaties van batterijtechnieken

An MP asked the Economic Affairs and Climate and Energy ministers about battery technology, grid congestion, investment incentives, lithium supply and alternative battery chemistries such as sodium-ion. The minister answered that TenneT will propose a tariff change that could make 2 to 5 GW of batteries profitable by 2030, outlined the Growth Fund and innovation programmes, and said lithium remains import-dependent while sodium-ion is being researched.
Grid operator TenneT will submit a code change proposal to the ACM that could lead to a maximum discount of 65% on transport tariffs.
Netbeheer TenneT gaat een codewijzigingsvoorstel indienen bij de ACM die kan leiden tot een maximale korting van 65% op transporttarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de raffinageroute en het belang ervan voor de ontwikkeling van groene waterstofproductie

An MP asked the government about the progress, timing and market effects of the planned raffinage route for renewable hydrogen, and about long-term investment certainty and lessons from other member states. The minister answered that the route is well advanced, will open in 2025 with a draft decree to parliament in early 2024, and outlined subsidies and normering as ways to secure supply, while offering no firm mitigation for delay.

The planned timeline of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management is to send the bill and the amendment to the Energy Transport Decree to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2024.

De voorgenomen tijdslijn van de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is om in de eerste helft van 2024 het wetsvoorstel en wijziging voor het Besluit energie vervoer aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de overname van Delfts chipbedrijf NOWI door Nexperia

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the Dutch government would investigate Nexperia's takeover of chip firm NOWI, citing claims that IoT chips could be used for sabotage against countries. The minister answered that NOWI's products are not dual-use or military goods, so the transaction falls outside the retroactive scope of the investment screening law, and that Defence applies security measures in procurement generally.
NOWI's products cannot be classified as dual-use products or military goods.
De producten van Nowi zijn niet aan te merken als producten voor tweeërlei gebruik of militaire goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de Nederlandse deelname aan de IPCEI-regeling voor cloudtechnologie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Dutch participation in the IPCEI scheme for next-generation cloud technology, including the cloud value chain, market concentration, sovereignty, and governance of the EUR 70 million. The minister answered that the scheme serves European innovation and autonomy, that Dutch projects were selected through criteria and monitored by RVO, and that a purely Dutch sovereign cloud service is not the aim.
The cabinet informed parliament on 21 September 2021 about the planned Dutch participation in the IPCEI CIS and the decision to make EUR 70 million available for Dutch projects.

Het kabinet heeft op 21 september 2021 (Prinsjesdag) uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen Nederlandse deelname aan het Important Project of Common European Interest Next Generation Cloud Infrastructure and Services (IPCEI CIS) en de beslissing hiervoor 70 miljoen euro ten behoeve van Nederlandse projecten beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Nijboer over de vergunningverlening locatie Schoonebeek van NAM

MPs Kröger and Nijboer asked whether a temporary carbon-filter installation permit for NAM at Schoonebeek signals a resumption of oil extraction and Twente water injection, and about decommissioning costs, e-boiler plans, state subsidies and grid use. The state secretary answered that the permit is only valid until 31 December 2023, that water injection in Twente will not resume under an agreement, and gave cost, subsidy and e-boiler details while noting some matters are NAM's responsibility.
Furthermore, I have agreed with NAM that water injection in Twente will not be resumed, and I will hold NAM to this agreement.
Daarnaast heb ik met de NAM afgesproken dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet zal worden hervat en ik zal de NAM houden aan deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over klimaatstress onder jongeren

An MP asks the government how it will increase youth participation in climate policy, track climate-related stress and mental health among young people, and address communication, polarisation and related concerns. The government answers with planned youth consultations, a youth climate campaign, RIVM research on health effects, and mental health programmes, while rejecting the claim that its climate communication causes youth stress.
A meeting with young people will therefore be organised in the short term, together with the National Climate Platform, to map the opportunities and barriers to more and better participation.

Er zal daarom op korte termijn in samenwerking met het Nationaal Klimaatplatform (NKP) een bijeenkomst met jongeren georganiseerd worden waarin de kansen en belemmeringen voor meer en betere participatie geïnventariseerd worden.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over jaarrekening Coöperatie Mobilisation for the Environment en Milieu-Adviesbureau Vollenbroek B.V.

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about Coöperatie MOB and Milieu-Adviesbureau Vollenbroek, including their hiring by public bodies, their missing annual accounts, and enforcement against non-filing. The minister answers that the government may choose its own advisers, that no exemption was requested or granted, that non-filing is a criminal offence, and that enforcement is risk-based and individual cases cannot be discussed.
Due to the confidentiality obligation, no statements can be made about individual cases.
In verband met de geheimhoudingsverplichting kunnen geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over klimaatstress onder jongeren

MP Van Haga asked the ministers about climate stress among young people, the role of government and media communication, mental health effects, and whether the government would change its communication strategy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, is running a public climate campaign and youth participation measures, rejects any intent to instil fear, and reports insufficient data on long-term effects and no specific programmes for climate-stressed youth.
The cabinet wants to prevent young people from experiencing stress due to climate change.
Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat jongeren stress ervaren door klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Teunissen, Alkaya, Dassen en Thijssen over fossiele subsidies

MPs asked the government about a report estimating fossil fuel subsidies at 37.5 billion euro per year, the reconciliation with the Miljoenennota annex, EU constraints, revenue use, and effects on competitiveness and the budget. The minister answered that the annex gives a range of 39.7 to 46.4 billion euro, that concrete tax measures were proposed in Belastingplan 2024, and that further proposals await a cabinet with full powers.
Given its caretaker status, the cabinet will not make further proposals for phasing out fossil fuel advantages.
Het kabinet zal, gezien zijn demissionaire status, geen verdere voorstellen doen voor afbouw van fossiele voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de situatie met betrekking tot de vermoorde snackbareigenaar

An MP asks the government why the widow of a murdered snack-bar owner receives no state help, which pushes successful entrepreneurs onto welfare, and whether rules will change. The Minister replies that existing schemes (Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, Bbz, Anw, victim compensation and advance payment) already cover such cases, sees no reason to change the rules, and declines to share the crowdfunding campaign.
Therefore I see no reason to amend the rules.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om de regels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een dreigend massaontslag bij metaalbedrijf KME

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a feared mass layoff at metals firm KME in Zutphen, following a foreign takeover, and whether foreign investors who restructure Dutch firms are acceptable. The minister answered that restructuring is the company's own responsibility, that an open economy welcomes foreign investment, that the cause is rising energy and material costs, and that the government will review any support request if one is submitted.
It is up to the company itself to determine its own strategy as long as it complies with applicable laws and regulations.
Het is aan het bedrijf zelf om de eigen strategie te bepalen zolang het zich houdt aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel “Yara tekent voor 1,5 megaton CO2-reductie in 2030”

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked why the Expression of Principles with Yara was signed without first being shared with parliament, and about its legal status, timing, CCS share, green electricity deals and government obligations. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding, will be followed by a JLoI reviewed by an independent advisory committee and shared with parliament, and that the government's contribution will be analysed, while giving only high-level detail on several points.
In line with this reasoning, the EoP with Yara, like other EoPs signed before the cabinet became caretaker, was not shared with your House first.
In lijn met deze redenering is de EoP met Yara, net als bij andere EoP’s die zijn gesloten voordat het kabinet demissionair werd, niet eerst met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Minister Adriaansens schrikt van krimppercentage en het bericht Duitse recessie wakkert zorgen aan om Europese economie

Opposition MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports on the Dutch economic contraction and German recession, their causes, competitiveness impact, sectoral outlook and employment. The minister answered that the Dutch downturn is mild and largely temporary, that trade diversification and innovation policy are being pursued, and that the German economy faces more structural problems.
Despite two quarters of economic contraction, the CPB still expects annual economic growth of 0.7%.
Ondanks de twee kwartalen van economische krimp verwacht het CPB nog steeds economische groei op jaarbasis van 0,7%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Minister gooit satellietbedrijf Inmarsat van 5G-frequentie'

MPs Amhaouch and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked why Inmarsat cannot get a longer licence in Greece, whether its demand for ten years of certainty is proportionate, and about the 3.5 GHz auction timing. The minister replied that Greece can grant only 5-year licences with a renewal already provided for, that no compensation has been agreed, and that the auction will move to 2024 depending on a pending court case.
However, I do not control whether interested parties initiate legal proceedings against the decisions I take.
Ik heb daarbij echter niet in de hand dat belanghebbende partijen juridische procedures aanspannen tegen de besluiten die ik neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Aartsen en Erkens over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

Three VVD MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that drug gangs were offering 'help' to Limburg hospitality businesses struggling after the 2021 floods, covering compensation, prevention, RIEC analysis, information sharing and cross-border criminal approaches. The minister answered that affected hospitality entrepreneurs awaited no pending compensation decision, described existing prevention campaigns and cooperation, and said no specific sector analysis or concrete RIEC signals existed.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether criminals offering help to flood-hit Limburg hospitality entrepreneurs was known, and what support the state provides. The minister answered that the matter is known, outlined prevention efforts and compensation schemes (Wts, provincial omzetderving scheme with a second opening), and said the state would keep working on resilience against organised crime.
Progress will be reported to the House on a regular basis in the half-yearly letter on the approach to organised, undermining crime and in reports on the progress of handling Wts claims.

Over de voortgang wordt de Kamer op regelmatige basis geïnformeerd in de halfjaarbrief aanpak georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit en in rapportages over de voortgang van de afhandeling van de Wts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Niet-afgedekt renterisico maakt private equity opeens kwetsbaar'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether unhedged interest rate risk threatens private equity funds and their portfolio companies, and what regulation or monitoring is needed. The minister answered that PE funds and portfolio firms are responsible for hedging their own rate risk, that additional rules are not currently warranted, and that DNB and the AFM will discuss the economic impact with the minister.
I will discuss the possible impact on the Dutch economy of interest rate rises for PE funds and their companies with DNB and the AFM.
Ik zal de mogelijke impact op de Nederlandse economie als gevolg van rentestijgingen voor PE-fondsen en hun bedrijven bespreken met DNB en de AFM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over milieu- en klimaatvervuiling door mondneusmaskers tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the environmental and climate damage from face masks during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether impact analyses were made, whether compensation or health funds are planned, and how future pandemics will be handled. The minister acknowledged the RIVM study, said no environmental impact analysis was made at the time, and gave largely non-committal answers, noting that the mask obligation was judged to outweigh the environmental harms and that waste is a broader problem.
At the time the decision was taken, it was not chosen to make an environmental impact analysis, and the cabinet was not aware of any warnings about the environmental consequences of using face masks.

Ten tijde van het nemen van het besluit is er niet voor gekozen om een milieu-impactanalyse te maken en waren het kabinet geen waarschuwingen bekend over de gevolgen van de inzet van mondneusmaskers voor het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gevolgen van dure benzine voor de grensregio

An MP asks the government why fuel excise is high despite cross-border fuel and grocery spending, whether it will reverse the temporary excise cut, and why no cross-border effects test has been applied. The state secretary answers that excise is mainly budget-driven, that the cut was temporary and cannot be extended without budget cover, and that cross-border effects are already part of the policy framework and monitored.
Taking cross-border effects into account is included in the integrated assessment framework (IAK) and is supported by the Guideline on Cross-Border Effects.
Het meenemen van grenseffecten is opgenomen in het integraal afwegingskader (IAK) en wordt ondersteund door de Leidraad Grenseffecten.
Antwoord op ragen van Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht Koester familiebedrijven, ze dragen de economie

MPs Inge van Dijk, Palland and Amhaouch asked whether family businesses deserve protection and whether the planned tightening of the business succession exemption (BOR) risks harming them, citing commentary by Maarten de Groot. The State Secretary agreed family firms add substantial economic value and should be supported, but rejected claims that the BOR changes would threaten them, citing a CPB evaluation, and promised to report after a pending study requested by a motion.
The cabinet does not expect that the announced adjustments to the BOR will lead to this.
Het kabinet verwacht niet dat de aangekondigde aanpassingen in de BOR hier toe zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over accounts die mogelijk nepnieuws verspreiden

The MP asked the minister to share correspondence with Twitter about a 2020 request to review accounts spreading fake news about 5G and Covid-19. The minister shares the email, explains the context of arboning 112 risks from 5G arson, and stresses that Twitter alone decided whether to act, with some account names redacted for privacy.
I have redacted some of the reported account names for the privacy of the people behind those accounts.
Een aantal van de gemelde accountnamen heb ik omwille van de privacy van de mensen achter die accounts gelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over het bericht 'Tata hakt knoop door en gaat tóch staal maken met waterstof'

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the ministers about reports that Tata Steel India and Tata Steel Netherlands would pursue revised green steel plans with a DRI and electric arc furnace, and what this means for climate, air quality, emissions, noise, jobs and the maatwerk agreements. The minister answered that the revised plans cannot yet be assessed, that the April 2022 expression of principles remains in place, and that the government will test the plans once the company provides details after the summer.
I cannot yet assess the plans at this moment.
Ik kan de plannen op dit moment nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de parlementaire BBQ

An MP asked ministers about the parliamentary BBQ, renamed NLvoedt, and whether its meat, fish and dairy industry organisers, including a sitting senator, give disproportionate lobbying influence, and whether ministers should attend. The government replied that lobbying is a legitimate part of democracy, that the event's partners are publicly listed, that attendance is a matter for individual politicians, and that it sees no ground to exclude such events, while committing to an evaluation of agenda and lobby-paragraph transparency tools.
To improve transparency and accountability, the guideline on transparency of ministers' agendas has been tightened in line with the Van Baarle-Dassen motion.
Om transparantie en verantwoording te verbeteren is de «Uitvoeringsrichtlijn transparantie agenda’s bewindslieden» aangescherpt in lijn met de motie Van Baarle-Dassen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van MAX vakantieman 3 juli 2023

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers whether travel organisers are transparent about extra costs that people with disabilities face for mobility aids, and how this fits with ANVR conditions and the UN disability convention. The government answered that organisers must disclose costs and suitability for reduced mobility under consumer law, that the ACM supervises this, and that it will raise the position of disabled travellers in EU negotiations on the package travel directive.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Rondtrekkende bendes vaker betrokken bij diefstallen in Nederland'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aartsen asked the Justice Minister about reports that travelling criminal gangs are increasingly involved in thefts, including the share of non-Dutch suspects, cooperation with European and non-European countries, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, Europol's role and prevention measures. The minister answered in detail that suspect data is limited, that a 25 percent figure applies only to cases where a suspect is identified, that existing cooperation and information-sharing mechanisms are adequate, and that the mobile banditry approach is now embedded in the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen.
Yes, I will also address the progress of the approach to mobile banditry in the next half-yearly report.
Ja, ik zal in het volgende halfjaarbericht ook ingaan op de voortgang van de aanpak van mobiel banditisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de oorzaken van Inflatie en het feit dat volgens een recente IMF studie stijgende bedrijfswinsten de grootste oorzaak zijn

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether an IMF study finding that rising profits drove about half of euro area inflation applies to the Netherlands, and what policy lessons and measures follow. The minister says the Dutch contribution of profits to inflation cannot yet be established, that the study may not be representative of the Netherlands, and that price-intervention measures used abroad carry serious costs, while promising to address income distribution and purchasing power in the August decision-making.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that part of the inflation is caused by higher profits, as also previously stated in answers to parliamentary questions.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat een gedeelte van de inflatie wordt veroorzaakt door hogere winsten, zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de vertraging om de groenstaalplannen van Tata Steel

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked about delays in Tata Steel's green steel plans, the regional environmental service's enforcement against unclean cokes-oven gas and its capacity, and the government's follow-up on related motions. The State Secretary answered that delays are undesirable, that the government is in talks with the company and the regional service, that enforcement is independent and risk-based, and that a verbal commitment to further steps and extra capacity funding has been made.
I agree with the OD NZKG that a worked-out and reliable planning is necessary for the success of the project.
Ik ben het eens met de OD NZKG dat een uitgewerkte en betrouwbare planning nodig is voor het slagen van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de strategische autonomie van Nederland op het gebied van de energietransitie

An MP asked the ministers how strategic autonomy in the energy transition is defined, how large Dutch and EU dependencies on China and other non-EU countries are for key technologies and critical raw materials, and what instruments exist to reduce them. The government answered that dependencies are not inherently problematic but must be mitigated where risky, that quantitative data are insufficient alone, and that it is pursuing a taskforce, further studies and EU instruments, with updates promised to parliament by late 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Den Haag verwaarloost innovatief mkb in de regio'

MPs Romke de Jong and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report claiming The Hague neglects innovative SMEs in the regions, and whether regional development companies (ROMs) should play a bigger role and receive more funding. The minister acknowledges the potential, describes existing instruments and ROM funding, denies that ROMs received disproportionately little, and says a multi-year plan for the ROMs is being prepared with provinces, to be reported by end of Q4.
A multi-year plan for the ROMs is currently being prepared, precisely to examine where they can be structurally deployed and how the supra-regional system can be better used.
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan een meerjarenplan voor de ROM’s, juist om te kijken waar zij structureel ingezet kunnen worden en het bovenregionale stelsel beter benut kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het artikel 'Faillissementsgolf mkb door corona schulden, Nederland wereldwijd koploper'

Two MPs from JA21 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the rise in bankruptcies among SMEs is caused by unpaid tax and corona debts, and about support, repayment options and tax measures. The minister answered that bankruptcies are currently below pre-pandemic levels and rising towards them, that repayment arrangements (NOW, tax deferral) are available, and that the government will report on debt solutions after the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht 'Bedrijven €200 mln. duurder uit door regels die ministeries vorig jaar invoerden'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that new government rules raised costs for businesses by €200 million, and about the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk's (ATR) findings that regulatory burden is insufficiently addressed and that many draft laws were rated negatively. The Minister answers that regulatory burden is already actively monitored through ATR advice, MKB-tests and the Beleidskompas, that ATR advice is not binding, that a permanent ATR with an expanded role is being prepared, and that no central record is kept of where MKB-tests are skipped.
I am currently preparing a proposal for the founding law of the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk.
Ik bereid op dit moment een voorstel voor de instellingswet voor het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Eppink over ‘de Nedcar-fabriek in Born helpen omschakelen naar een fabriek voor militaire voertuigen’

MPs Eerdmans and Eppink asked whether the government would help convert the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to military vehicle production after BMW's Mini production ends in 2024, and about Chinese state-owned involvement in Dutch military vehicles. The minister said the plant is unsuited to military series production, that the government will facilitate contacts and support any viable initiative, and referred to defence procurement screening and a forthcoming investment-screening law.

The cabinet considers employment at VDL Nedcar of great importance for the regional labour market and the liveability of the area, and has therefore pledged its cooperation in finding solutions to preserve it.

Het kabinet acht de werkgelegenheid bij VDL Nedcar van groot belang voor de regionale arbeidsmarkt en de leefbaarheid van het gebied en heeft dan ook haar medewerking toegezegd om oplossingen te vinden voor het behoud ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘VDL Nedcar kondigt massaontslag aan: helft personeel eruit’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about VDL Nedcar's announced mass dismissals, the consequences for regional employment and suppliers, and the extent of central government involvement in finding new clients. The minister answered that the government is closely involved and supportive, but withheld specific details of contacts with individual companies citing confidentiality and ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet is generally reticent about giving specific information on contacts with individual companies, because of the usually confidential nature of those contacts.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van specifieke informatie over contacten met individuele bedrijven, omwille van het doorgaans vertrouwelijke karakter van die contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de ontslagen bij VDL Nedcar en het mogelijk aanwenden van verschillende Europese defensiefondsen

MP Van der Plas asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about mass layoffs at VDL Nedcar and whether EU defence funds (EDIRPA, ASAP) could help, including jobs and redeploying staff at Defence. The state secretary answered that EDIRPA and ASAP offer little direct benefit to VDL Nedcar, that the government is supporting the company's search for new clients, and that Defence is willing to hire some laid-off technical staff.
Too much openness could harm both commercial confidentiality and the process.
Teveel openheid kan zowel de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid als het proces schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Grevink over het bericht 'Schiphol en Havenbedrijf Rotterdam klagen de staat aan over 5G-beleid'

MPs asked the minister about the 3.5 GHz spectrum allocation for local use, after Schiphol and the Port of Rotterdam sued the state over the 5G policy and its first-come-first-served allocation. The minister answered that local-use concerns were partly accommodated in the final band plan, that the mainports' wish for a formal coordinating role is for the government to weigh in the allocation conditions, and that the appeals may delay but do not necessarily stop the auction.

However, it remains the (statutory) task of the government, specifically the Radio Communications Agency (RDI), to assess licence applications, coordinate with other radio services, and grant licences to applicants.

Het is en blijft echter de (wettelijke) taak van de overheid, specifiek die van de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI), om vergunningaanvragen te toetsen, de coördinatie met andere radiodiensten te verzorgen, en vergunningen te verlenen aan de aanvragers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de ontwikkelingen in de nettarieven

An MP asked the government about TenneT's announced 2024 transmission tariff increase, its distributional effects, the history and causes of grid tariffs, long-term forecasts, measures to limit increases, and how offshore wind grid costs are allocated. The minister answered substantively, explaining that tariff allocation is the exclusive competence of the ACM and that the government's role is limited to designating which grid operator bears offshore grid costs.
Yes, I am aware of TenneT's tariff forecast for 2024.
Ik ben bekend met de tariefprognose van TenneT voor 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een CBS-onderzoek naar graaiflatie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CBS survey on whether firms pass on cost increases, and whether 'profit-driven inflation' can be inferred from such surveys, questioning the survey's methodology and question wording. The minister rejected the term 'graaiflatie', defended the survey's method and its split question, and declined to commission new research, saying CBS is independent.
At this moment we see no reason to commission additional research into the extent to which companies can pass on their higher costs to customers and what obstacles they encounter.

Op dit moment zien wij geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek uit te zetten naar de mate waarin bedrijven hun hogere kosten kunnen doorberekenen aan hun klanten en tegen welke obstakels zij aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kathmann over online identiteitsfraude

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked about online identity fraude, including its prevalence, links to data hacks, who bears the burden of proof for disputed contracts, and whether businesses should verify customer identities. The minister answered that no central figures exist, pointed to CMI and Fraudemonitor data, stated the trader bears the burden of proof, and said verification is a business responsibility while promising a letter on the Energy Act.
Article 150 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that the party relying on legal consequences of facts or rights it asserts bears the burden of proving them.
Artikel 150 van de Wet van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering stelt dat de partij die zich beroept op rechtsgevolgen van door haar gestelde feiten of rechten, de bewijslast daarvan draagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over graaiflatie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether 'greedflation' (profit-driven price increases) is occurring in the Netherlands, whether market power concentrations are being monitored, and whether the ACM should get more powers. The Minister denies that greedflation is present, attributes price rises mainly to overheating and supply disruptions, says the ACM is adequately engaged and that the ministry is examining whether additional market-supervision instruments are needed.
These are average values and do not rule out that there are sectors where concentration and/or markups may have increased.
Dit betreft gemiddelde waarden en neemt niet weg dat er sectoren zijn waar de concentratie en/of markups kunnen zijn toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'RVO maakt dieraantallen en adressen veehouderijen toch openbaar'

An MP asked ministers whether RVO's public release of livestock numbers and farm addresses, which are business data, undermines trust in confidential data provided to government and whether the Woo rules should be clarified. The minister answered that such data counts as emission-related environmental information that must be disclosed under the Woo, that the requester's identity is not disclosed, and that no regulatory change is planned.
Information on numbers of animals and on locations where animals are kept must be regarded as information on emissions into the environment.
Informatie over aantallen dieren en over locaties waar dieren worden gehouden moet worden gezien als informatie over emissies in het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Marijnissen over de staking bij VDL Nedcar

MPs Van Kent and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the strike at VDL Nedcar, the government's response to the planned end of the BMW contract, and the dates and content of contacts between ministers and VDL management and between ministries. The minister acknowledged the job losses and the union dispute, but repeatedly declined to disclose the contents, dates or preparatory documents of the contacts, citing business confidentiality and an ongoing process.
For this reason the cabinet is generally reluctant to provide specific information about this.
Om die reden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van specifieke informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg wil Europese waterstofbank naar Chemelot halen'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government supports Limburg's bid to host the European hydrogen bank, which other regions are in the race, and how the government would help. The ministers replied that the Commission does not plan a new physical entity or a selection process, so no bid decision is needed, and they welcomed the initiative while promising to monitor its institutional design.
There is so far no question of a selection process.
Van een selectieproces is vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over de Nederlandse zonnepanelenindustrie

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked about dependence on Chinese solar panels, Dutch/European production support, EU Recovery and Resilience funds and the IPCEI-Solar motion. The minister answered that Europe and the Netherlands depend heavily on China, outlined Dutch production support and funding applications, and said the government prefers aligning with the Net Zero Industry Act rather than the IPCEI-Solar.
Your House will be informed about this before the summer in the broad solar policy letter.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer voor de zomer geïnformeerd in de brede beleidsbrief over zon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bouw van het datacentrum van Microsoft

An SP MP asked how Microsoft could keep building a data centre without a permit, whether preferential treatment undermines trust, whether the project should be halted, and what role EZK and NFIA played. The minister answered that the province of Noord-Holland, as competent authority, allowed construction via two gedoogbeslissingen, that the omgevingsvergunning was granted on 19 April but is not yet final, that the data centre is within designated zoning, and that NFIA's involvement was limited to investor relations and referral to regional authorities.
The college of gedeputeerde staten of the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority for permit granting, supervision and enforcement.
Het college van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland is het bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Storing Vodafone: telefoonproblemen bij onder meer ziekenhuizen en 112'

An MP asked why 112 emergency calls failed for some Vodafone customers for nearly a full day on 14 April 2023, how this squares with rules requiring automatic fallback to another provider, and about 2G/3G switch-off, emergency call standards and a reporting point. The minister attributed the outage to a technical fault during night maintenance, explained existing legal rules and ongoing standardisation work, said a reporting point is still being explored, and reported no known casualties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Van Strien over het bericht 'Lightyear stopt productie eerste zonneauto: 'Focus op goedkopere model''

MPs Romke de Jong and Van Strien asked the minister about Lightyear halting production of its first solar car, the Lightyear 0, after bankruptcy of its production subsidiary, and about IP rights, public investments, and support for solar mobility. The minister regretted the situation, said the company is continuing in reduced form with an 8 million euro injection, that the public investors' IP and investments are secured through the restart, and promised a market study letter on solar mobility before summer.
With this restart, the public investments via, among others, Invest-NL, BOM and LIOF are also secured given the circumstances.
Met deze doorstart zijn de publieke investeringen via onder meer Invest-NL, BOM en LIOF gegeven de omstandigheden eveneens geborgd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Japan weigert verantwoordelijk te nemen voor de onmenselijke behandeling van 'troostmeisjes' – die gedwongen werden tot prostitutie – gedurende de Tweede Wereld

An MP asked the government about Japan's refusal to acknowledge responsibility for forced prostitution of 'comfort women' in WWII, and whether Dutch state and royal family profited from the liquidation of Japanese wartime bank funds that held their earnings. The government answered that archives (Foreign Affairs, Finance, NEFIS, National Archives) do not allow verification of such profit, sees no reason for further research, and cited archival access restrictions and the Archives Act.
At this moment the Dutch State sees no reason to conduct further investigation into the money flows, beyond the archival research already carried out.
Op dit moment ziet de Nederlandse Staat geen aanleiding om, naast het verrichte archiefonderzoek, nader onderzoek te doen naar de geldstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de verduurzaming van het zesde industriecluster

An MP asked how the government facilitates decarbonisation of industrial cluster 6 (geographically dispersed firms), including infrastructure, bottlenecks, provincial energy planning, carbon pricing risks and possible maatwerk agreements. The minister answers that regional strategies and the MIEK framework will map needs, a new NPVI unit will address bottlenecks, and a regular update on cluster 6 will be included in future letters.
Yes, I will provide a regular update on the decarbonisation of cluster 6 for companies subject to the CO2 levy in the letters on industrial decarbonisation.
Ja, ik zal in de Kamerbrieven over de verduurzaming van de industrie een reguliere update geven over de verduurzaming van cluster 6 voor de bedrijven die onder de CO 2 -heffing vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Trek stikstofdossier los door specifieke Nederlandse regels terug te draaien' van VNO-NCW

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers about VNO-NCW's proposals to loosen nitrogen permitting rules (AERIUS link, a 0.5 mol/ha/yr threshold, a national nitrogen bank, ending the intern salderen bill). The minister responded point by point, defending the current legal framework, stating a threshold is not yet ecologically feasible, and promising further dialogue and a study of alternatives to the KDW, but declined to give a project count for the threshold scenario.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het rapport 'Het energiesysteem van de toekomst: de II3050-scenario’s' van Netbeheer Nederland en Gasunie

An MP asked the minister about the netbeheerders' II3050 report on industrial decarbonisation, including which sectors are strategic, whether space exists for new industry, and whether norms and support would be provided. The minister answered that the NPVI and a forthcoming Routekaart will set framework conditions, that companies decide their own strategies, and that no sectors are being written off.
Before the summer I will present the Routekaart Verduurzaming Industrie to your House.
Voor de zomer zal ik de Routekaart Verduurzaming Industrie aan uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Afhankelijkheid van China moet niet worden herhaald bij 6G'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the role of the ministry in the 6G Future Network Services project, its link to strategic autonomy and reducing dependence on China, SME involvement, Nationaal Groeifonds funding and European cooperation. The minister answers that the ministry co-submitted the proposal, that strategic autonomy is a stated goal, that public funding is necessary, and that European cooperation is being pursued.
Yes, promoting digital and open strategic autonomy is one of the objectives of the project.
Ja, het bevorderen van digitale en open strategische autonomie is een van de doelstellingen van het project.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het nieuws dat kringloopwinkels zich grote zorgen maken om het moeten bijhouden van een verplicht register voor alle binnengekomen producten middels het Digitaal

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about concerns from thrift shops over a mandatory product register via the Digitaal Opkopers Register, and whether it serves to prevent handling stolen goods and money laundering. The minister answered that the registration duty already exists, that it will be narrowed to theft-sensitive goods with a limited regime for free-donated items, and that a proportionate arrangement is being negotiated with the trade association.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'In de slag om glasvezel blijft geen tegel onberoerd'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about duplicate fibre-optic network rollout in several municipalities, including whether municipalities can prevent it, whether co-investment and a statutory standard dig-rest period should be introduced, and whether the government will take a larger coordinating role. The Minister answered that municipalities cannot in first instance block additional networks under EU and Dutch telecom law, but can impose conditions on works, that no statutory standard period is needed, and that the government will mainly facilitate and inform municipalities.

No, not in the first instance, because under the European Electronic Communications Code and its implementation in the Telecommunications Act, municipalities must tolerate that every provider of a public telecom network may lay such a network in public land.

Nee, in eerste aanleg niet, omdat gemeenten vanuit de Europese Telecomcode (richtlijn (EU)2018/1972) en implementatie daarvan in de Telecommunicatiewet moeten gedogen dat elke aanbieder van een openbaar telecomnetwerk (waaronder een glasvezelnetwerk) een dergelijk netwerk mag aanleggen in de openbare grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de toepassing van de MKB-toets bij wetgeving

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for an overview of when the SME test (MKB-toets) was applied to new legislation this cabinet term, why it was skipped in some cases, and when all legislation would be tested for SME feasibility. The minister listed about 20 laws and regulations tested, said the test is targeted rather than mandatory for all legislation, and explained the 'apply or explain' rule and the grounds for not applying it, without centrally tracking skipped cases.
It is not centrally tracked for which legislation no SME test was carried out.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden bij welke regelgeving er geen MKB-toets is gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen Nederlandse ministeries

An MP asked whether the cabinet would release all communications between Dutch ministries and Twitter from June 2019 to September 2022. The minister answered that no integrated overview exists, listed the contacts found (mostly on account verification, privacy, hacked accounts and features), and did not release the full communications.
There is no integrated overview of contact between Twitter and the ministries, even within the ministries.
Er bestaat, ook binnen de ministeries, geen integraal overzicht van contact tussen Twitter en ministeries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Palland over het bericht ‘Subsidie op je rieten dak, maar alleen als het riet uit China komt’

CDA MPs asked why Chinese reed qualifies for ISDE insulation subsidy while Dutch reed does not, and whether Dutch reed's lower environmental impact was ignored. The minister said Chinese reed was listed because it met the minimum insulation value, Dutch reed is awaiting a performance declaration due in May, and the subsidy does not discriminate by country of origin.
Currently it is being examined how a good environmental performance of insulation material, for example biobased insulation materials, can be valued in the insulation subsidy schemes.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht hoe een goede milieuprestatie van isolatiemateriaal – bijvoorbeeld bij biobased isolatiematerialen – kan worden gewaardeerd in de subsidieregelingen voor isolatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over lagere prijzen in Duitsland voor dagelijkse boodschappen en het uitblijven van de grenseffectentoets

Van Haga asked the Economy and Climate minister why grocery prices are lower in Germany and Belgium, whether this is causing border-region decline, and whether a border-effects test will be applied to policy. The minister replied that price differences are limited and driven by many factors, that no evidence of a hollowed-out border region was found, and that the cabinet has made border-effects assessment a mandatory quality requirement since 2021.

Since 2021 the cabinet has included in the integrated assessment framework (IAK) a mandatory quality requirement to take border effects into account in proposed new or amended policy and regulation, where relevant.

Het kabinet heeft sinds 2021 als verplichte kwaliteitseis in het integraal afwegingskader (IAK) opgenomen, om bij voorgenomen (nieuw of gewijzigd) beleid en regelgeving – wanneer aan de orde – ook rekening te houden met grenseffecten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de explosieve uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Amerikaanse House Committee on Oversight and Reform naar de klimaatontwrichtende investeringsplannen van de li

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers whether they know of, and how they will respond to, US House Oversight Committee findings that major fossil fuel firms plan to keep investing in oil and gas and engage in greenwashing, and whether the government will hold these companies to account, demand Paris-aligned investment plans, or investigate similar conduct in the Netherlands. The ministers answered that the government expects firms to meet Paris goals through binding bilateral agreements and carbon pricing, cannot dictate strategies to international companies, will not summon them or investigate Dutch conduct, and will not make Paris alignment a condition for subsidies.
I will not summon these companies following the American investigation.
Ik zal deze bedrijven naar aanleiding van het Amerikaanse onderzoek niet op het matje roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de tijdelijke verrekenfactor voor nieuwbouw vanwege de hoger uitgevallen milieubelasting van warmtepompen

Two MPs (SP) asked why a temporary calculation factor for heat pumps' environmental impact was introduced without informing parliament, whether legal advice was obtained, and what the consequences are for the climate goals. The minister replies that the factor was developed by the independent Stichting NMD, that the government did not seek legal advice because the method itself was unchanged, that parliament was not informed since the database is managed by the sector, and that heat pumps remain climate-friendly overall.
If the calculation method or requirement designated in the building regulations is changed, your House will be informed of this.
Als de in de bouwregelgeving aangewezen bepalingsmethode of eis wordt gewijzigd, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kröger over het bericht ‘Studenten eisen dat UvA banden verbreekt met Shell, bezetten universiteitsgebouw’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether fossil-industry research funding (Shell at UvA) is compatible with research integrity codes, what frameworks govern public-private partnerships, and whether universities should cut ties with Shell. The minister answered that universities are autonomous under academic freedom, cited the NGWI code under evaluation and existing independence frameworks, and declined to set content-based restrictions on partnerships.
On the basis of these freedoms, it is not possible to steer substantively the public-private partnerships universities enter into, and no frameworks can be set that infringe on academic freedom.

Op basis van deze vrijheden kan niet inhoudelijk gestuurd worden op de publiek-private samenwerkingen die universiteiten aangaan en kunnen geen kaders gesteld worden die inbreuk maken op de academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Groene toekomst van Tata Steel allerminst zeker’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports doubting the green future of Tata Steel, covering permits, energy and hydrogen needs, infrastructure, state aid, jobs and the timing of a maatwerkafspraak. The minister answered that the company must first submit complete permit applications and detailed plans, that no firm timeline can be guaranteed, that state aid requires prior European Commission approval, and that the decision on support depends on analysis not yet finished.

Although I cannot go into detail about the commercially confidential information provided, this information and subsequent analyses are essential for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate to assess the plans.

Alhoewel ik niet in detail kan treden over de aangeleverde bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, is deze informatie en opvolgende analyses essentieel voor het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat om de plannen te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Van der Woude, El Yassini en Rajkowski over kunstmatige intelligentie in het onderwijs

MPs from the VVD asked the education and economic affairs ministers about the risks and opportunities of AI such as ChatGPT in schools, teacher preparedness, research, and cooperation with the Dutch AI Coalition. The ministers answered that they support schools through Kennisnet, SURF, the national education lab NOLAI and funding, but offered no measures to check or constrain executive power.
It is important that school boards and teachers are sufficiently aware of the risks of AI for education, in addition to its opportunities.
Het is belangrijk dat schoolbesturen en leraren naast de kansen ook voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de risico's van AI voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de staatsrechtelijke opstelling kabinet nieuwe wetgeving

MP Van der Plas asked whether the cabinet was blocking the IMVO initiative bill and whether ministers would implement a law passed by parliament, and questioned the constitutional relationship. The ministers deny refusing the bill, say talks with initiators are ongoing, confirm they will implement any law adopted by both chambers after royal assent, and promise to inform parliament of the outcome.
These exploratory talks are still ongoing. We undertake to inform your House of the final outcome of these talks.
Deze verkennende gesprekken lopen nog. Wij zeggen toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te brengen van de einduitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het artikel Chinees staatsbedrijf bouwt onze pantservoertuigen

An MP asked the government about reports that Visser B.V., a defence contractor building armoured vehicle components, is owned by a Chinese state-owned company, and whether a required security check and notification after the takeover took place. The State Secretary answered that Visser had not notified a November 2022 change in ownership despite holding an ABDO authorisation, that Defence is in discussion with the firm about consequences, and that a sectoral investment screening law and the Wet vifo are planned.
Visser BV did not do this; Defence is in discussion with the company and is considering what consequences should be attached to it.
Visser BV heeft dit niet gedaan; Defensie is hierover met het bedrijf in gesprek en beziet welke consequenties daaraan verbonden worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Kröger, Van Esch en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Vervuilende Kooksfabriek 2 van Tata Steel blijkt verkeerd gebouwd: rookt en lekt vanaf eerste dag 'aan alle kanten'’

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdD asked the government about reports that Tata Steel's Coke Plant 2 was built with defects and emits pollutants, and about enforcement, permit revision, closure and related subsidies. The State Secretary answered that the competent authority (province and Omgevingsdienst NZKG) is investigating defects, has issued a third penalty payment order, and is examining permit withdrawal, while closure would be discussed in the maatwerk negotiations; several questions were referred to other bodies or withheld for tax confidentiality.
The OD NZKG asked EenVandaag and the reporters for further information; the information provided in the broadcast is insufficient to establish whether there are actually construction defects.

De OD NZKG heeft EénVandaag en de melders verzocht om nadere informatie; de in de uitzending aangereikte informatie is onvoldoende om vast te kunnen stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van constructiefouten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Boucke over het initiatief voor energiebesparing op De Zuidas en het voorzien van alle straatverlichting van een led-lichtbron

Two MPs asked the ministers about a campaign to switch off night-time office lighting on the Zuidas and about fully converting street lighting to LED, including whether the government would support the initiative and how energy savings could be mandated. The ministers confirmed support for the campaign, pointed to the energy-saving obligation and the updated measures list, and said about 32% of motorway lighting is LED with the rest to be replaced at natural replacement moments, rather than accelerating full conversion.
Almost all provinces will fit the remaining street lighting with LED lamps in the coming years.
Vrijwel alle provincies gaan de komende jaren de resterende straatverlichting van ledlampen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over fossiele subsidies

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked whether the fossil subsidy debate should focus on the carbon pricing gap identified by PBL, whether energy tax on electricity is too untargeted and should be revised, and how the Energy Tax Directive and non-energy use of fossil fuels should be handled. The government answered that carbon pricing analysis is useful, agreed to ask PBL for an update, acknowledged the electricity tax issue and EU negotiations, and said further study of non-energy fossil use is needed.
I will ask PBL to update the 2021 analysis.
Ik zal het PBL vragen om een actualisatie van de analyse uit 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het actualiseren van de efficiënte CO2-prijs uit de WLO studies en de maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse (MKBA) oliewinning Schoonebeek

An MP asks about updating the efficient CO2 price from the WLO studies, the delayed new WLO study, and whether the Schoonebeek oil extraction cost-benefit analysis should be tested against the two-degree scenario rather than only the WLO low and high scenarios. The minister answers that the new WLO study will appear in 2024, that the two-degree scenario is used only as a supplementary sensitivity check, and that multiple scenarios are kept deliberately to test robustness.
It is precisely important to use multiple scenarios because the future is uncertain and this allows checking whether policy measures are robust.
Het is juist van belang meerdere scenario's te hanteren omdat de toekomst onzeker is en zo gecheckt kan worden of de beleidsmaatregelen robuust zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie
