Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving over energiearmoede en schimmel in woningen

An MP asked the ministers about news reports on energy poverty and mould in homes, including health effects, impact on care costs, housing market and environment. The State Secretary answered that about 7.4% of households faced energy poverty in 2022, outlined existing support measures and mould policy, and said the government lacks overview on some effects and cannot estimate housing market impacts.
The cabinet has no overview of the number of homes in the Netherlands experiencing effects of inadequate heating.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van het aantal huizen in Nederland dat gevolgen ondervindt van ontoereikende verwarming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het verlopen van vergunningen voor ambulante ondernemers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about market-stall permits with unlimited duration expiring under EU services rules, and whether local cultural ties should count in allocation. The minister said the matter is a municipal discretionary competence under the Services Directive, that she has no local data, and that municipalities may reallocate permits through open competition or extension, with no national measure planned.
Policy on market-stall permits is a discretionary competence of municipalities.
Het beleid met betrekking tot marktplaatsvergunningen is een discretionaire bevoegdheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘VS verbieden producten Huawei en andere Chinese bedrijven: ‘Onacceptabel risico voor nationale veiligheid’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked the minister whether the Netherlands would follow US bans on Huawei and restrict Huawei's access to Dutch banks, and how far Huawei remains in Dutch telecom networks. The minister said the government shares US security concerns, that Huawei is already excluded from the vital core network with implementation being checked, that detailed supplier information is confidential, and that the Netherlands will decide independently on any bank-access restriction.
Detailed information on who uses which supplier where, and which phase-out deadlines apply, is considered commercially confidential information.
Gedetailleerde informatie over wie waar welke leverancier gebruikt, en welke uitfaseringstermijnen gelden wordt gezien als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het krantenartikel ‘US touts Biden green subsidies to lure clean tech from Europe’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether US states are luring European clean-tech firms with Inflation Reduction Act subsidies and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister reports no observed increase in US recruitment in the Netherlands, acknowledges a risk to investment and the investment climate, and points to Dutch and EU instruments in response.
That is why last October I sent my strategic agenda for the business climate to the House of Representatives.
Ik heb daarom afgelopen oktober mijn strategische agenda Ondernemingsklimaat aan de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de mogelijke gevolgen van de boycots op olie uit Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the national oil crisis plan and diesel distribution plan would be finished before the Russian oil import ban, what scenarios and impact analyses exist, and which sectors would be prioritised. The minister answered that the concept plans are nearly ready and will be formally adopted soon, that a concept diesel distribution plan is due before the 5 February 2023 sanctions start, and that the logistics sector and priority users will be addressed through the plan's scenario work, while impact monitoring falls partly under the NCTV and EU-level analysis.
Formal approval and adoption will take place in the short term, after which it will be shared with your House.
Formele goedkeuring en vaststelling zal op korte termijn plaatsvinden, waarna het met uw Kamer gedeeld zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Utrechtse standplaatshouders die hun vertrouwde plaats moeten opgeven vanwege Europese regelgeving

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why Utrecht market stallholders must lose their long-held fixed pitches and compete for new permits under the EU Services Directive, and questions the legal certainty and fairness of this. The Minister replies that permits for scarce public space must have limited duration under the Directive, that municipalities must consider payback periods, that stakeholders were informed in advance, and that the Netherlands supports the policy.
It is up to the municipality how it wishes to shape the allocation.
Het is aan de gemeente hoe zij de toewijzing willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sjoerdsma over een kadaster voor journalisten

Two D66 MPs asked why journalists cannot shield their home addresses in the Kadaster as threatened persons can, and why the Verhoeven motion on withholding private addresses has not been implemented. The minister answered that the Kadaster must keep object addresses public for a transparent property market, that searching by name is now limited to professional users, and that doxing should be criminalised instead, so no change to the Kadasterbesluit is planned.
I am aware that with this I depart from the line being taken for the Trade Register.
Ik ben mij bewust van het feit dat ik daarmee afwijk van de lijn die wordt ingezet bij het Handelsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van Boswijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Steunmaatregelen 'zeer teleurstellend' voor glastuinbouw: 'Dit gaat tuinders niet helpen"

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the ministers of Agriculture and Economic Affairs about reports that support measures for greenhouse horticulture were insufficient, and about the sector's energy costs, its classification, and EU support options. The government disagrees that the measures do not help, points to raised compensation ceilings and a generic SME scheme, and says it sees no need for additional EU-based support for the sector.
I do not agree with the statement that the measures taken do not help the growers.
Ik ben het niet eens met de uitspraak dat de maatregelen die zijn genomen de tuinders niet helpt.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Achterlijke situaties bij glastuinders, eerste bedrijven stoppen’

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that high energy prices are forcing greenhouse horticulture firms to close or cut production, and about the consequences for vegetable supply, prices, competitiveness, sustainability and the energy transition. The minister answers that the impact is real but exact figures are unknown, expects some volume declines with imports partly filling gaps, notes limited quantification, and points to extra energy-saving subsidy funding and a planned guarantee scheme for working capital.
Because of the diverse business situations and dependencies within the rest of the chain, it is difficult to make generic statements.
Het is vanwege de uiteenlopende bedrijfssituaties en afhankelijkheden met de rest van de keten moeilijk om generieke uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Chipmaker Nexperia koopt Delftse start-up’

MPs asked the government about the acquisition of Delft start-up Nowi by Nexperia, a Chinese-owned chipmaker, and how the pending Wet Vifo investment screening law applies, including comparisons with UK and German blocking decisions. The minister said the Wet Vifo is not yet in force so no assessment of the Nowi takeover has been made, that it will examine the deal once the law takes effect given its retroactive reach, and that the government is not commenting on UK or German decisions.
Because there is no legal basis yet, I have not been able to carry out any investigations under this law, and therefore no assessment of the Nowi takeover has taken place.
Vanwege het ontbreken van een wettelijke basis, heb ik op dit moment nog geen onderzoeken kunnen doen op grond van deze wet en heeft er dus geen beoordeling plaatsgevonden van de overname van Nowi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de energie-intensieve bedrijven in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the minister about fears of a domino effect among energy-intensive firms in the Eemsdelta, support for firms forced to halt production, use of the EU state aid framework, knock-on effects in the value chain, and when indirect ETS cost compensation would be paid. The minister said she met the regional industry delegation, promised a letter before year-end on the energy crisis impact and options, explained that substitutes exist in the chain, and stated that compensation for 2022 is being paid but there is no budget to reopen the scheme after 2022.
Before the end of this year I want to inform your House about the impact of the energy crisis on energy-intensive industry.
Nog voor het einde van dit jaar wil ik uw Kamer informeren over de impact van de energiecrisis op de energie-intensieve industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Stoffer over het bericht 'Scheepsbouwer IHC zet kroonjuweel in etalage'

MPs Amhaouch and Stoffer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that IHC was offering its profitable subsidiary IQIP for sale, its effect on maritime capabilities, state exposure and financial risk, and whether the Netherlands can keep the knowledge and the shipyard. The minister answered that the state has some influence over the IQIP sale through the 2020 rescue terms but withheld details as confidential, declined to assess the company's viability, gave outstanding exposure figures, and promised a maritime sector agenda by summer.

The State is not a shareholder in IHC. In the 2020 rescue operation the State did secure influence over the sale of IQIP. How far this influence extends is commercially confidential information and is therefore not shared.

De Staat is geen aandeelhouder in IHC. Bij de steunoperatie in 2020 heeft de Staat wel invloed bedongen op de verkoop van IQIP. Hoe ver deze invloed reikt, betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die derhalve niet gedeeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de voorgenomen verkoop van het Zeeuwse energiebedrijf PZEM aan het Tsjechische energiebedrijf EPH

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the ministers about the planned sale of the publicly owned Zeeland energy company PZEM to Czech firm EPH, raising concerns about privatisation, fossil fuel assets, climate targets and risk allocation. Minister Jetten answered that the province as shareholder may decide on the sale, that he raised no objection under the Electricity Act while noting climate concerns, that the government will respond to the Segers-Marijnissen motion next year, and that the transaction structure is for the shareholders to decide.
As a shareholder, the province of Zeeland is free to decide on its own shareholding.
Als aandeelhouder staat het de provincie Zeeland vrij om over het eigen aandeelhouderschap te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorbereiding van het prijsplafond voor consumenten

An MP asked the Minister about contacts with the European Commission on the consumer energy price cap, the margin test, the constitutional equality of households, the sharing of memos, and firms with negative equity. The Minister answered that Commission correspondence is confidential, that the relevant internal notes and the draft regulation were shared with parliament, and that a brutomargetoets and bankruptcy clauses are included, while several questions were answered with commitments to follow up.
Official-level conversations with the Commission in the context of ongoing state aid procedures are confidential.
Gesprekken op ambtelijk niveau met de Commissie in het kader van lopende staatsteunprocedures zijn vertrouwelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Van Strien over de artikelen 'ESA-baas: Nederland moet meer investeren in Europeseruimtevaart' en 'Experts: niet landen zelf, maar satellieten gaan straks CO2-uitstoot met

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about news reports urging more Dutch investment in European space programmes and satellite CO2 monitoring, including sovereignty and broadening Dutch access to greenhouse gas data. The minister answered that the Netherlands invested EUR 389 million via ESA at CM22 (37% more than 2019), with EUR 61 million for Earth observation, and that broader ESA investment and a budgetary review will be considered in 2023.
Therefore, under the amended Van Strien motion 7 et al., a budgetary exploration will be included in the development of the Long-Term Space Agenda in 2023.
Daarom zal in het kader van de gewijzigde motie Van Strien 7 c.s. een budgettaire verkenning worden meegenomen bij de uitwerking van de Lange Termijn Ruimtevaartagenda in 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven van 20 september 2022 omtrent de Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten

MP Aartsen (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CBb ruling that startup entrepreneurs were wrongly refused the TVL fixed-cost allowance for Q4 2020, asking how many were affected, why no remedy was given, and whether they will be compensated. The minister answered that the number affected cannot be determined, that earlier steps (a Q1 2021 starters scheme and a reference-period option from Q2 2021) were taken, and that the ruling does not require reopening decisions, which she says is no longer legally possible after the scheme ended.
How many of these companies were rejected due to the absence of the reference period is not known.
Hoeveel ondernemingen daarvan zijn afgewezen als gevolg van het ontbreken van de referentieperiode is niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over de toegezegde brief aan het lid Rajkowski (VVD) tijdens het Commissiedebat Telecomraad van 31 mei 2022 over de mogelijke gevaren rondom het uitschakelen van 2G en 3G i

An MP asks whether the shutdown of 2G and 3G in 2025 will leave only 4G/5G for calls, whether government can influence the timing, and how emergency 112 reachability and VoLTE reliability will be affected. The minister answers that providers decide shutdown timing under technology neutrality, that VoLTE calling is not yet as reliable as 2G/3G but is being worked on, and that she will send a supplementary letter, without guaranteeing provider-independent 112 access.
At this moment I cannot guarantee that. But I am committed to it.
Op dit moment kan ik dat niet garanderen. Maar ik zet ik mij daar wel voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Gestreste ondernemer is makkelijke prooi: trap niet in fraudeval’

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about phishing and ransomware targeting entrepreneurs, including awareness campaigns, reporting rates, support for victims, telecom measures, and a Belgian-style anti-phishing shield. The ministers answered that existing campaigns, the Digital Trust Center, the Fraudehelpdesk and telecom talks are ongoing, and that a Belgian-style shield is being explored, without new binding commitments.

Yes. As reported in the annex to the letter on the integrated approach to cybercrime of 4 November, the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the NCSC, is exploring whether an anti-phishing shield modelled on the Belgian example can also be set up in the Netherlands.

Ja. Zoals gemeld in de bijlage bij de Kamerbrief over de integrale aanpak van cybercrime van 4 november jl. verkent het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, tezamen met het NCSC of een «anti-phishing-schild» naar Belgisch voorbeeld ook in Nederland kan worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'iPhone 14 kan vanaf nu noodoproepen sturen via satellieten'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Apple's satellite emergency SOS feature for iPhone 14 and whether Dutch emergency access (112) could be improved through such technology. The minister answered that the feature offers little added value in the Dutch context given good mobile coverage, notes it routes via Apple call centres and privacy concerns, and said the government would examine a central reporting point for 112 accessibility problems in 2023, after prioritising VoLTE support.
It is also uncertain whether this service will in all cases remain completely free for users and emergency centres, as European regulation requires.
Ook is niet zeker dat deze dienst in alle gevallen volledig gratis blijft voor de gebruikers en alarmcentrale, zoals de Europese regelgeving voorschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Terwijl Amerikanen zwaar materieel aanvoeren voor de oorlog, verkopen EU-staten havens aan China'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about Chinese stakes in European ports, including Dutch ports, and what the Netherlands and EU should do to protect strategic interests. The minister answered that no full overview of Chinese stakes exists, that Dutch port authorities remain publicly owned, that Chinese firms are strongly present in container logistics, and that the government will raise the issue with the Commission, Germany, France and Belgium and push for a joint European approach.
The cabinet does not keep track of this per port.
Het kabinet houdt dit niet per haven bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een besluit op Wob-verzoeken op 7 november 2022

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a July 2021 email from a civil servant using a World Economic Forum address, and about secondment, email archiving and staffing of a WEF food innovation hub project. The minister confirmed the facts, pointed to an earlier letter for the secondment details, and said WEF-domain email is outside government archives and not requestable under Woo or Article 68 of the Constitution, except in limited cases.
Email traffic between @weforum.org addresses falls outside the archives the cabinet manages because this email traffic concerns an external organisation.
Mailverkeer tussen @weforum.org-mailadressen vallen buiten de archieven die het kabinet beheert omdat dit mailverkeer betreft van een externe organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien, Rajkowski en Brekelmans over de Chinese investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

VVD MPs asked the ministers about Chinese investments in Dutch firms, the risk of espionage, screening tools such as the Vifo Act, and the EU foreign subsidies regulation. The government answered that existing tools are being strengthened, that it keeps no active overview of ownership structures, and that the Rotterdam port issue is under study, with a country-neutral approach preferred.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ruim 900 Nederlandse bedrijven in handen van Chinezen: 'Risico op spionage'

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs, Foreign Trade and Justice about a report that 903 Dutch firms are majority-owned by Chinese parents or the state, and what the government will do about economic dependence and espionage risks. The ministers acknowledge the espionage risk and point to existing and planned instruments (investment screening, espionage offence, knowledge security), but say they keep no active overview of ownership structures and give no concrete list of sectors at greatest risk.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt inzake vergoedingen voor energiebedrijven (Kamerstuk 36200, nr. 118)

MP Omtzigt asks the government how it implements two motions on the energy price cap: margin-based compensation for energy suppliers and handling of shared connections (blokaansluitingen), plus questions on tax changes and the timing of the cap. The minister answers that talks on margin testing are ongoing, a solution for shared connections has top priority under coordination by the Tax Authority, the 2023 cap is intended to start on 1 January 2023, and no further change to energy tax rates is currently planned.
Talks are currently being held with energy suppliers on how to arrive at some form of margin testing in implementing the 2023 price cap scheme.
Op dit moment worden gesprekken gevoerd met de energieleveranciers over hoe te komen tot een vorm van margetoetsing bij de uitvoering van de prijsplafondregeling voor 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de dieselprijs

An FvD MP asked the government whether diesel is now more expensive than petrol, whether the lower historic diesel price explains higher motor vehicle tax on diesel cars, and whether diesel drivers will be compensated for high diesel prices. The State Secretary confirmed diesel is more expensive, denied that motor vehicle tax compensates for lower diesel excise, and pointed to the Belastingplan 2023 package of energy-price measures including excise cuts until 2024.
It is not correct that the low diesel price is compensated by the motor vehicle tax (mrb) on diesel vehicles.
Het klopt niet dat de lage dieselprijs wordt gecompenseerd door de motorrijtuigenbelasting (mrb) voor dieselvoertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland’

An MP asked ministers whether illegal and far-right websites could be hosted via Dutch datacentres and what powers the government has to intervene. The ministers answered that hosts must act once informed of illegal content, that the government relies largely on self-regulation and forthcoming instruments (ATKM, DSA), and that they consider it undesirable for Dutch firms to serve botnet-linked parties.
The Dutch datacentre Serverius did not have to take any action itself for this.
Het Nederlandse datacenter Serverius heeft hiervoor zelf geen actie hoeven te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de overname van contracten van failliete energiebedrijven zoals Welkom energie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the takeover of customer contracts after the bankruptcy of Welkom Energie, including the ACM's role and whether Eneco was bound by the contracts. The minister answered that the courts, not the government, judge the specific case, that the ACM applies the rules independently, and that the Energy Act procedure for customer takeover at bankruptcy will be clarified, while refusing to revise earlier answers or assess the email, and postponing answers.
It is for the court to judge the specific circumstances of a given case.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de specifieke omstandigheden in een bepaald geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Internet kan tientallen euro’s goedkoper in Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch internet prices are the highest in Europe, whether competition is too weak, and what the government can do to promote competition and regulate dominant providers. The minister replied that prices are relatively high, that the independent regulator ACM (which concluded the market is an oligopoly) is responsible for judging competition, and described the regulatory instruments available to the ACM, including an upcoming market analysis.
It is up to the ACM to form a judgment on competition and tariffs in the internet market.
Het is aan ACM om een oordeel te vellen over de concurrentie en de tarieven op de internetmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grevink en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Internet kan tientallen euro’s goedkoper in Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether internet access prices in the Netherlands are too high, whether market entry is hindered, and what will be done to open the market. The minister confirmed Dutch prices are relatively high, noted the ACM has binding commitments from KPN and Glaspoort and is preparing a new market analysis that will be delayed beyond this year, and pointed to the existing legislative framework as the responsibility of the independent regulator.
The ACM is currently working on a new market analysis.
De ACM werkt momenteel aan een nieuwe marktanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de potentieel desastreuze gevolgen van de gascrisis voor de industrie

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about the risk that the gas crisis could cause uncontrolled industrial shutdowns, including whether gas shortages can be ruled out at a 90 percent storage fill level and what contingency measures apply. The minister answered that the GTS conditions for avoiding shortages are currently met, that the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas is being operationalised, and that a study of the impact of high energy prices on industry will be shared before year-end, though several questions were answered only in part or deferred.
By the end of the year I will come with a new update on the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan.
Voor het einde van het jaar kom ik met een nieuwe update rond het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport ‘onderzoek opkopen vakantieparken’

An SP MP asks the ministers about a report on the buy-up of holiday parks, raising criminal and speculative investors, stikstof, intimidation of tenants, weak tenant protection under RECRON terms, and the role of municipalities. The minister answers that the government sees no need for a moratorium, buy-up protection, Bibob mandatory checks or a revolving fund, while pointing to municipal tools, the Actie-agenda and a dialogue with the sector on tenant information.
In the first place it is up to the local competent authority, the municipality or province, to determine whether buying up and restructuring a given holiday park is desirable or possible.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan het lokale bevoegd gezag, de gemeente of provincie, om te bepalen of het opkopen en herstructureren van een gegeven vakantiepark wenselijk danwel mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de berichten 'Hoe de industrie steeds onder energiebesparing uit wist te komen' en 'Aanpak energiebesparing bij bedrijven faalt'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about press reports that industry escaped energy-saving obligations, including why the Netherlands exempted ETS firms, whether lobbying occurred, and how enforcement and monitoring work. Minister Jetten answered most questions substantively, admitted weak enforcement and some gaps, and committed to tightening the obligation from 2023 and reporting further by year end, while declining to create a separate monitor or to state some figures.
With the tightening of the energy saving obligation, supervision of the energy saving obligation will be assigned to a single regional body.
Met de aanscherping van de energiebesparingsplicht wordt het toezicht op de energiebesparingsplicht belegd bij één regionale instantie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bewuste stellingname van Shell geen plannen te maken om net zero emission te bereiken binnen de komende tien à twintig jaar en doorgaat met het zoeken naar nieuwe olie en gas

MP Kröger asks the government how it views Shell's stated lack of plans to reach net zero within 10 to 20 years and its continued search for new oil and gas, including the court ruling requiring a 45% CO2 cut by 2030 and Scope 3 emissions. The minister answers that the government holds Shell to EU and national climate targets, declines further comment while the appeal is pending, notes Shell's low-carbon initiatives, and states the government remains committed to the Paris goals.
As long as the appeal is before the court, I refrain from further comment.
Zolang het hoger beroep onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van verder commentaar.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rahimi over het bericht 'Stille ramp in bakkerswereld: 'We kunnen straks geen brood meer bakken''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper report on crisis-hit SMEs such as bakeries, including whether government will map affected sectors and coordinate across ministries. The minister answered that support such as the energy cost tegemoetkoming (TEK) and tax payment deferral is available, that some firms may still have to close, and that departments already cooperate and monitor sector signals.
It is therefore also not excluded that companies will be forced to close due to high energy costs, however drastic in individual cases.
Het is daarom ook niet uitgesloten dat bedrijven door de hoge energiekosten gedwongen zullen moeten sluiten, hoe ingrijpend in individuele gevallen ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de regeling Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten en de maatregelen vanaf november

Van Haga asked why the cabinet waited months to act on high energy costs for energy-intensive SMEs, whether it had failed them, and how Parliament can scrutinise support options before November. The minister acknowledges the problem, explains the TEK scheme is retroactive from November with payouts expected in Q2 2023 due to feasibility and EU approval, and points to tax deferral and bank bridge financing as interim help, but does not share the options before the consultation.
For these energy-intensive enterprises I have announced the Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK scheme).
Voor deze energie-intensieve ondernemingen heb ik de Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK-regeling) aangekondigd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de 190 euro regeling voor huishoudens in november en december 2022

MP Omtzigt asked about the 190 euro per month energy allowance for small-scale consumers in November and December 2022, including its budget authorisation, cost estimates, households without small-consumer connections, and legal protection for individuals. Minister Jetten answered that the budget was raised to 3.15 billion euro after a VAT correction, that the government relied on an urgency provision (art. 2.27(2) Comptabiliteitswet) to bypass prior parliamentary approval, and that consumers have a right via their supplier, though some households in shared connections may not be reached.
For authorisation, the cover letter to the Ninth supplementary budget invoked the second paragraph of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet because of the high urgency of the expenditure.

Ter autorisatie is in de aanbiedingsbrief bij de Negende incidentele begroting (Kamerstuk 36 220 ) een beroep is gedaan op het tweede lid van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet vanwege de hoge urgentie van de uitgaven

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bontenbal over de berichten 'Steeds meer productie wordt stilgelegd vanwege de hoge energieprijs' en 'De Croo: 'We dreigen in oorlogseconomie te belanden als EU niet ingrijpt''

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that production is being halted due to high energy prices and about the risk of a war economy. The minister answered that some firms have curtailed output, that industrial production has so far held up overall, and that targeted support (TEK scheme, Dutch price cap, EU temporary crisis framework) and a letter on energy-intensive industry are in preparation.
As announced in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will therefore send Parliament a letter before the end of the year on energy-intensive industry addressing the current situation.

Ik zal zoals aangekondigd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober, daarom voor het einde van het jaar een brief aan uw Kamer sturen over de energie-intensieve industrie waarin op de huidige situatie zal worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de nieuwe Amerikaanse wet die de export van geavanceerde chips en machines naar China verder aan banden wil leggen

Volt MP Dassen asked the Dutch ministers whether the US had requested Dutch-style export bans on chipmaking technology to China, whether a Dutch DUV machine ban was under discussion, and about the geopolitical implications. The government answered that it regularly consults the US on export controls but would inform parliament of relevant policy changes, declined to disclose the content of a confidential meeting, acknowledged economic interests, and said export control is a national competence while Dutch policy aims for European coordination.
Due to the confidentiality of this conversation, I cannot make statements about the precise content discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit gesprek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze besproken inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het prijsplafond voor energie en verwarming met propaan

Van Haga asked whether households and businesses heating with propane, who fall outside the energy price cap, will get a separate scheme, and whether they can join the TEK business support scheme. Minister Jetten said no separate scheme is planned due to limited time and data, that propane is excluded from TEK because of practical differences, and that some businesses may claim electricity support.
Because a relatively small share of households uses propane gas and the cabinet has little insight into its consumption and costs, realising a supplementary scheme for propane users is not feasible.

Doordat een relatief klein deel van de huishoudens gebruik maakt van propaangas en het kabinet weinig zicht heeft op het verbruik en de kosten hiervan, is het realiseren van een aanvullende regeling voor gebruikers van propaan niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Agressieve verkoper van energiecontracten start eigen energiemaatschappij. Radar Checkt!'

An MP asks the Minister about the energy supplier HEM, its five-year variable-rate contracts, whether ZZP-ers can be sold them, how a firm can sell energy without a licence, and how ACM oversight and consumer protection can be tightened. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says ACM oversees licensing and supplier conduct, points to stricter licensing rules in force since 4 October 2022 and forthcoming Energiewet provisions, and says courts or the dispute committee handle exit fees.
Tightening supervision of suppliers and setting additional requirements is urgently needed and has my full attention.
Het aanscherpen van toezicht op leveranciers en het stellen van extra eisen is hard nodig en heeft mijn volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Strien over het bericht ‘Scheepsbouwer IHC in zwaar weer: zo’n 250 personeelsleden ontslagen en werf in Krimpen tijdelijk dicht’

MPs Valstar and Van Strien asked about IHC's shipyard layoffs and whether closer cooperation with industry could speed up naval maintenance backlogs. The government answered that about half of naval maintenance is already outsourced to industry, that a backlog is manageable, and that talks with the maritime sector are ongoing.
Defence is exploring, within procurement rules, ways to further simplify and improve cooperation with and between maritime industry companies.
Defensie verkent de mogelijkheden om – binnen de aanbestedingsregelgeving – te komen tot verdere vereenvoudiging en verbetering van de samenwerking met en tussen bedrijven uit de maritieme industrie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Energy union or deindustrialisation'

MP Dassen (Volt) asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Economic Affairs about articles on energy prices causing deindustrialisation in Europe, and about the merits of a European Energy Union, a pan-European supergrid, a shared gas purchase and a European shutdown plan. Minister Adriaansens acknowledged the concern over high energy prices, said the government will inform parliament before year-end on the impact on industry, rejected the shutdown-plan and full Energy Union positions in part, and called the supergrid study's 32% savings figure uncertain.
As promised in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will inform your House before the end of the year about the impact of higher energy prices on industry.
Zoals toegezegd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober jl., zal ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar informeren over de impact van de gestegen energieprijzen op de industrie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gündoğan over het bericht 'Topambtenaar Economische Zaken nieuwe directeur VNO-NCW'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a senior civil servant moving to lobby group VNO-NCW, the cooling-off period rules for officials and ministers, and the early departure of the secretary-general amid alleged policy disagreements. The minister confirmed the move and the four-month cooling-off period, said the GRECO recommendations apply to ministers not officials, and denied that policy differences played a role in the secretary-general's departure.

The expanded lobbying ban took effect immediately in November 2021 and means former ministers may not act as intermediaries or lobbyists for two years from a company, semi-public body or lobby organisation.

Het uitgebreide lobbyverbod is destijds per direct, november 2021, ingegaan en houdt in dat gewezen bewindspersonen twee jaar lang niet vanuit een bedrijf, semipublieke organisatie of een lobbyorganisatie optreden als bemiddelaar, lobbyist of tussenpersoon
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Boswijk over het artikel 'Munitie-tekort explodeert: problemen met locaties en vergunningen voor kogelfabrieken'

MPs Valstar and Boswijk asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch dependence on imported ammunition, the lack of domestic munitions factories, and permitting barriers for new production sites. The government acknowledged the strategic dependence and the value of European cooperation, but said it will not pursue active policy to restart domestic munitions production, that no Defence sites are available, and that the timeline is unknown.
There are no more ammunition factories in the Netherlands. If they were to come, that would be good, but we will not pursue active policy on this.
Er zijn geen munitiefabrieken meer in Nederland. Als die er zouden komen is dat goed, maar we gaan hier geen actief beleid op voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over overheidsgeld aan niet-gouvernementele organisaties

An MP asked how much money the government paid to several Dutch nature and environmental NGOs, and whether MOB or its chair was ever hired as an adviser. The minister answered with payment amounts per organisation for 2021 and 2022, noted that other governments' payments are outside its information, and apologised for missing the answer deadline.
Of course other governments, such as provinces, may also have made payments to one or more of the organisations concerned. However, I do not have information on these payments.
Uiteraard kunnen ook andere overheden, zoals provincies, uitgaven hebben gedaan aan een of meerdere van de bedoelde organisaties. Ik beschik echter niet over informatie over deze betalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over investeringsplannen van de fossiele industrie

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about fossil fuel companies' investment plans (the 'carbon bombs' reported by The Guardian) and whether the government would act internationally to stop them, given the Paris Agreement. The minister acknowledges the climate risks, says the plans are incompatible with Paris if the figures hold, and lists existing policy and coalitions, but declines to provide an overview of Dutch-linked investment plans and does not join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance.
That data is not public and the cabinet therefore does not keep track of it.
Die data zijn niet openbaar en houdt het kabinet dus ook niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Essent maakt stroom en gas flink duurder'

An SP MP asks the government whether Essent's sharp energy tariff increases from 1 October 2022 are close to the planned price cap, whether agreements were made with suppliers, who monitors supplier purchase prices, and how overcompensation and profit-taking via the cap will be prevented. The minister replies that the ACM monitors reasonableness of supplier tariffs and that the cap is designed to avoid over- and undercompensation, but gives no commitments to freeze tariffs or new interventions.
I see no need to take earlier measures that intervene in the interim in the price formation of individual suppliers.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om eerder maatregelen te nemen die tussentijds ingrijpen ten aanzien van de prijsvorming bij individuele leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘onderhandse financiering van vakantiewoningen baart experts zorgen’

SP MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked ministers about reports that private, non-bank mortgage financing of holiday parks and homes raises money-laundering and undermining risks, and about regulation of park takeovers and oversight of gatekeepers. The government answered that such financing can be a risk indicator, that the Actie-agenda vakantieparken and existing Wwft and FIU measures apply, that no regulation of individual transactions is planned, and that it will report the results of the Actie-agenda and a banks/gatekeeper dialogue later.
It is important that all parties that may have insight into this are alert to it in performing their tasks.
Het is belangrijk dat alle betrokken partijen die hierop zicht kunnen hebben, daar alert op zijn bij de uitoefening van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het onbenut laten van Bibob-toetsing bij subsidieverlening

MPs Sneller and Michon-Derkzen asked why national ministries, notably RVO and Uitvoering van Beleid SZW, rarely apply the Bibob integrity test when granting subsidies. The minister answers that the test is discretionary, that ministries are in talks to increase its use, that RVO and UVB rely on other controls, and promises an update by the first quarter of 2023.
The Ministry of Justice and Security is engaging with various departments to stimulate the use of the Bibob Act within central government.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) gaat met verschillende departementen in gesprek om het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij de rijksoverheid te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Inge van Dijk en Palland over het beschermen en behouden van maritiem erfgoed.

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about protecting maritime and sailing heritage, including historic houseboats, and about registration, legal anchoring and a plan of action. The State Secretary answered that the national government's role is mainly support and facilitation, that existing registers and designation tools are in place, and that the Erfgoedwet evaluation and a follow-up meeting with the sector will come later.
For the national government, that role lies mainly in support and facilitation in the field of knowledge and expertise.
Voor het Rijk ligt die vooral in ondersteuning en facilitering op het vlak van kennis en kunde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het weigeren van dhr. Van Roost (voormalig CEO Esso Nederland) om voor de parlementaire enquêtecommissie te verschijnen

An MP asked whether a former ExxonMobil executive refusing to appear before the Groningen gas parliamentary inquiry was morally objectionable, and whether government contact with ExxonMobil should be halted. The State Secretary agreed witnesses affecting Groningen should cooperate, noted no legal obligation exists for non-Dutch residents abroad, said he would personally contact ExxonMobil, and rejected halting contacts given its role as shareholder.
I note that where persons do not have Dutch nationality and live abroad, there is no obligation to cooperate under the Parliamentary Inquiry Act.
Ik merk daarbij op dat wanneer personen geen Nederlandse nationaliteit hebben en in het buitenland wonen, er op grond van de Wet op de parlementaire enquête geen verplichting tot medewerking bestaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de subsidieregeling Indirecte kostencompensatie ETS die zij stelden naar aanleiding van berichtgeving van de Europese Commissie over haar goedkeuring van deze regel

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the government sought EU approval for an indirect ETS cost compensation scheme worth up to €835 million for about 62 energy-intensive firms without first consulting parliament, and whether firms should bear carbon price risk themselves. The minister answered that the scheme is delegated legislation not requiring parliamentary involvement, that only the 2022 budget is currently covered, and that the scheme carries a 3% CO2 reduction obligation with clawback if firms fail to comply.
The reason the subsidy scheme was not submitted to the House is that this concerns delegated legislation in which parliament has no formal involvement.
De reden dat de subsidieregeling niet aan de Kamer is voorgelegd is dat dit gedelegeerde wetgeving betreft waarbij het parlement in casu geen formele betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘NIST kiest wapens tegen kwantumcomputer als cryptokraker’

An MP asked the ministers whether quantum computers threaten secure communication and state and business secrets, what concrete preparations the government is making, and how it is investing in quantum technology. The state secretary agreed the risk is real, described migration to quantum-safe systems, national investments and European participation, and stated the government will publish guidance and coordinate a migration plan.
For the central government and sub-national governments, but also for the private sector, this means they will have to migrate to quantum-safe systems and technologies.
Voor de rijksoverheid en medeoverheden, maar ook voor de private sector, betekent dit dat zij zullen moeten migreren naar kwantumveilige systemen en technologieën.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief Beleidsinstrumentarium ten behoeve van de borging van het vestigings- en investeringsklimaat, maatschappelijke langetermijnwaardecreatie en nat

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government views the practical difficulties of applying their adopted amendment bringing campus operators under the investment screening law, and whether it will be implemented. The minister answered that an external study by Birch Consultants and HCSS, started 25 July 2022, will define which firms qualify as campus operators, and that the government intends to implement the amendment depending on the study's findings.
The research assignment shows that I am working on implementing the amendment.
Uit de opdracht tot onderzoek blijkt dat ik werk maak van de uitvoering van het amendement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het artikel ‘Sancties tegen Russen bleven maand liggen.’

An MP asked the ministers why Dutch enforcement of Russia sanctions was delayed by more than a month after the Chamber of Commerce held relevant data, and whether the delay was caused by legal issues and how recurrence will be prevented. The minister answered that the data could not be shared without a legal basis, that the legal gaps are being closed through changes to the sanctions regulation and modernisation of the sanctions system, and that a permanent sanctions team has been set up.

The sharing of these personal data was partly addressed with the amendment of the sanctions regulation in April, but it became clear that a more structural modernisation of the sanctions system would be needed.

Het delen van deze persoonsgegevens is met de wijziging van sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014 in april deels ondervangen, maar duidelijk werd dat een meer structurele modernisering van het sanctiestelsel nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked about a report that drug shipments by post were rising sharply and about customs seizures, staff safety, and cooperation with the US and other countries. The government answered that seizures rose from 4,080 in the first half of 2021 to nearly 13,500 in the first half of 2022, attributed partly to increased customs inspection capacity, described safety measures for postal staff, and said cooperation with the US, Australia and New Zealand is intensive, with a joint postal team planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ’het gebruik van Energie en de plek waar de miljardenwinsten terecht komen, terwijl de Nederlandse huishoudens in Energie-armoede vervallen’

Omtzigt asked the ministers how much gas is extracted in the Netherlands in 2022, where it goes, what long-term contracts and prices the state and its companies have, how much the state earns from gas, and whether consumers are overcharged, including whether electricity producers' profits and subsidies are fair. The government answered that the gas cannot be traced to a final destination, that contract terms are confidential, that the state earns gas revenue through specified channels, and that it is examining targeted relief for vulnerable households.
The content of these contracts is confidential, and this confidentiality is also agreed in the contracts themselves.
De inhoud van deze contracten is vertrouwelijk en deze vertrouwelijkheid is ook in de contracten zelf afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over vakantieparken die mogelijk misbruikt worden door criminelen om hun geld wit te wassen

Two MPs from the SP asked ministers about holiday parks possibly misused by criminals for money laundering, including the role of municipalities, BIBOB screening and intimidation of officials. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the problem is known, that an interdepartmental action agenda and guidance exist, that a Kadaster registration change is being evaluated, and that no mandatory BIBOB screening will be imposed, leaving this to municipalities' discretion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Strien over het artikel 'Hoe Rick Engelkes coronamiljoenen incasseerde voor een spookmusical'

MPs Aartsen and Van Strien asked about a newspaper report that a producer received corona compensation for a ghost musical that was not scheduled in the corona period and had no tickets sold. The State Secretary explains the provisional allocation under Compensatieregeling 3, the Fonds Podiumkunsten's assessment, the later accountability and clawback process, and that no other signals of misuse have been received.
The Fonds Podiumkunsten assesses the accountability and can set the subsidy lower and recover funds.
Het Fonds Podiumkunsten beoordeelt de verantwoording en kan de subsidie lager vaststellen en middelen terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het laatste IPCC-rapport en het besparingsplan aardgas van de NVDE

An MP asked the Minister about the IPCC report on fossil infrastructure emissions, the NVDE's gas-saving plan, and whether new North Sea gas extraction fits with climate goals. The Minister replied that gas extraction from small fields is still needed for supply security and that the NVDE's measures are largely already in place or being pursued through existing policy, without committing to a specific new extraction halt.
The cabinet continues to prefer extracting gas from small Dutch fields onshore and offshore, for as long and to the extent this is needed for Dutch gas demand.
Het kabinet blijft er de voorkeur aan geven gas te winnen uit de Nederlandse kleine velden op land en op zee, zolang en voor zover dit nodig is voor de Nederlandse gasvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boucke over de aangenomen motie-Hagen c.s., het artikel ‘Kankerverwekkende stof chroom-6 aangetroffen in grond Tata Steel’ en de intentieverklaring ‘Afspraken met Tata Steel Neder

MPs Hagen and Boucke (D66) asked the government about the timeline, binding nature, monitoring, financing and emissions targets of the Expression of Principles with Tata Steel Nederland, and about carcinogenic chromium-6 found in soil at the site. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding but guides negotiations toward a binding agreement, that no public funds are yet attached, that further investigation into chromium-6 has been commissioned by the regional environmental service, and that some answers depend on ongoing procedures or are the responsibility of other bodies.
First an attempt will be made to reach more concrete and binding agreements between the parties.
Eerst zal geprobeerd worden om te komen tot concretere en bindende afspraken tussen partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Chroom 6 aangetroffen in grondwater bij Tata Steel’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reported chromium-6 contamination of groundwater at Tata Steel, the lack of health protection, the implementation of a motion on health gains, the smoke incident, the timeline for sustainability agreements, and subsidies. The government answered that the GGD sees no health risk because there is no exposure, that the environmental service has ordered follow-up research and tightened permits, and that binding maatwerk agreements depend on a complete business case, so no firm timeline is given.
However, I will not make concessions on a careful assessment of the business case; I will not take irresponsible risks with taxpayers' money.
Ik ga echter geen concessies doen aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van de business case, ik ga geen onverantwoorde risico's nemen met belastinggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat PostNL een nieuwe digitale kloof creëert door afschaffing van papieren 'niet-thuisberichtjes'

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether replacing paper 'not at home' notices with digital ones by PostNL creates a digital divide and whether the government will act on it, including a motion on offline options. The minister answered that paper notices remain for universal postal service parcels and registered or medical post, that PostNL accepts responsibility to support non-digital users, and that the government sees no need to talk to PostNL itself.
I therefore see no need to hold a conversation with PostNL myself on this subject.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om nu zelf een gesprek met PostNL te voeren over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het bericht 'Vertrek DSM is signaal voor politiek'

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the ministers about reports that the DSM headquarters move signals a wider political problem for large multinationals, including their contribution to society, job numbers and what the government will do about the investment climate. The minister defends the contribution of multinationals, admits concern about the investment climate and promises a second investment-climate letter before the EZK budget debate, while saying the DSM-Firmenich dual headquarters decision was taken by the companies without government involvement.
DSM is a listed company and legally may not share this information before it is made public.
DSM is een beursgenoteerde onderneming en mag wettelijk gezien deze informatie niet voorbeurs delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Romke de Jong en Kröger over het bericht ‘Sociaal ondernemen groeit (te) langzaam naar volwassenheid’

Three MPs asked the economy minister about a news report saying social enterprises grow too slowly, covering macro-economic weight, financing, local government procurement, scale-up barriers and the planned social-enterprise company form (BVm). The minister answered that data on their economic contribution is limited, financing is generally available, PIANOo and the City Deal support local governments, and the BVm bill will likely go to consultation end 2022 or early 2023 and reach parliament during 2023.
This means the bill can only be sent to the House for consideration in the course of 2023 at the earliest.
Dit betekent dat niet eerder dan in de loop van 2023 het wetsvoorstel voor behandeling naar de Kamer zal kunnen worden gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

Leijten (SP) asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs what measures her ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, against laws and procedures that cause hardship, and about its information management, including chat message retention and FOI/WOO requests. The minister, on behalf of the cabinet, answered that departmental inventories of harsh regulations are under way, pointed to separate reports and letters, and described the chat-message retention rules for officials.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘Slachting onder bedrijven dreigt: 200.000 ondernemers op rand faillissement’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that around 200,000 entrepreneurs face bankruptcy, the state's role in supporting them, and whether firms hit by energy prices and the Ukraine war should be supported. The minister said the government is providing a range of debt and financing instruments, bankruptcies remain low, and it monitors the situation but does not plan generic new compensation for energy costs.
The cabinet further keeps a close watch and remains in dialogue with the business community.
Het kabinet houdt verder de vinger aan de pols en blijft in gesprek met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het risico op een overval op tabaksspeciaalzaken

An MP asks the government about a robbery at a tobacco shop, whether NVWA rules force shopkeepers to cover windows, and whether this endangers small retailers given the high robbery risk. The State Secretary answers that NVWA does not require covering windows, only that tobacco products not be visible from outside, that the choice of measures is up to the shop, and that the Centre for Crime Prevention will advise shops on compliance with visibility.
The NVWA does not require shopkeepers to fully cover their windows and front door.
De NVWA eist niet van winkeliers dat zij hun ramen en voordeur volledig afplakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Postchaos in ’s-Heer Arendskerke nog niet voorbij: 'Het is nu tijd om verdere stappen te nemen''

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether she knew of ongoing postal delivery failures in 's-Heer Arendskerke and whether she would work with PostNL and the municipality on a structural fix. The minister said delivery problems are caused by labour shortages and similar factors, that PostNL is recruiting and in direct contact with residents, and that ACM supervises and can enforce.
It is up to ACM to supervise this and to take enforcement action where necessary.
Het is aan ACM om hier toezicht op te houden en om zo nodig handhavend op te treden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over natuurlijke personen die zijn opgenomen in het curatele- en bewindsregister maar desondanks zonder toestemming van de bewindvoerder een bedrijf kunnen starten bij de Kamer van K

An MP asked the ministers whether it is undesirable that persons under guardianship or administration can start a business at the Chamber of Commerce without the administrator's approval, and whether the KvK should check the central register before registration. The minister agreed it is undesirable, and said the KvK and ministries will explore a systematic check by autumn, without committing to a concrete change.
It is not desirable that natural persons under guardianship or administration can carry out such acts without the required approval of their guardian or administrator.
Het is niet wenselijk dat natuurlijke personen die onder curatele of bewind staan dergelijke handelingen kunnen verrichten zonder de (vereiste) goedkeuring van hun curator of bewindvoerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote belangstelling voor de regeling ‘Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the oversubscription of the Impulse programme for shopping areas, whether funds from the fourth tranche could be moved forward, and how the programme would inspire others and tackle vacancy. The minister said no acceleration is planned for now, that 16 projects requesting 38 million against 22 million available are being assessed and decisions follow in August, and that she will work with partners on knowledge sharing and transformation.
I see no reason to do so at this moment.
Daarvoor zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over de mobiele netwerkdekking in Kattendijke

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Kattendijke, including a 2016 death where emergency messages reportedly failed. The minister acknowledges patchy coverage, says mobile coverage cannot be guaranteed 100% and recommends fixed lines in some cases, and reports contact with the municipality and operators plus a coverage requirement on 700 MHz licences.
At the same time, it is necessary to acknowledge that it is impossible to guarantee 100% mobile network coverage.
Tegelijkertijd is het noodzakelijk om te erkennen dat het onmogelijk is om 100% mobiele netwerkdekking te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de mobiele netwerkdekking in Termunten (Groningen)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about poor mobile coverage in Termunten, the state of the KPN-municipality dispute, the Ministry's role, and the status of a motion on unconnected areas. The Minister answers that the municipality is steering operators toward a shared mast near Baamsum, that the Ministry's role is to ensure fixed and mobile connectivity and encourage local antenna policy, and that 112 remains reachable and the motion has been reported on in a separate letter.
I have recently informed your House about this in my letter on the motions Inge van Dijk et al. and Inge van Dijk-Rajkowski.
Ik heb uw Kamer hier recent over geïnformeerd in mijn brief over de moties Inge van Dijk c.s. en Inge van Dijk-Rajkowski.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel Chinese bedrijven azen op het Europese stroomnet

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether Dutch policy adequately guards the energy grid against undesirable influence from Chinese and other non-European firms, and what tools exist. The minister answered that existing investment screening (Vifo, sectoral tests, public ownership of grid operators) and procurement rules apply, while a new Energy Act will add security-based procurement options and the government will review arrangements with TenneT and monitor the situation.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate will, among other things, review the current arrangements and frameworks with TenneT and make adjustments where necessary.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en klimaat zal onder meer de huidige afspraken en kaders met TenneT tegen het licht houden en zal daar waar nodig aanpassingen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Tata Steel betaalt alleen 'belasting' aan Tata Steel'

MP Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tata Steel Netherlands paying no profit tax, subsidies for greening, reliability of its figures, tax constructions, and whether subsidies should be withheld. The Minister repeatedly declined to discuss the company's tax position citing confidentiality under Article 67 AWR, stated the accounts were audited and compliant, listed meetings with the company and subsidies received, and said subsidies consider the company's financial capacity.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake Rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op het lid Romke de Jong over het bericht ‘Bedrijven doen te weinig aan maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen’

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how to help businesses, especially the more than a quarter who feel their firm does too little on corporate social responsibility (MVO), take first steps, and how to strengthen CSR awareness, reduce its threshold, and support businesses' long-term viability. The minister answers by listing existing national and international CSR and due-diligence policies, information channels (RVO, MVO Nederland), transparency benchmarks, planned IMVO legislation and a planned IMVO support point, while stating that it is hard to say whether all businesses will have CSR targets within five years.
The cabinet wants all Dutch companies doing business at home and abroad to do so responsibly.
Het kabinet wil dat alle Nederlandse bedrijven die zakendoen in zowel binnen- als buitenland, dit verantwoord doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over verkoop van levensgevaarlijk speelgoed op Bol.com

An MP asked the minister whether Bol.com bears moral and legal responsibility for dangerous toys sold by third-party sellers on its platform, and whether stricter notice-and-takedown or liability rules and tougher NVWA enforcement are warranted. The minister answered that marketplaces must take responsibility, pointed to the Product Safety Pledge, the 2019 NVWA-Bol.com protocol, the DSA, and pending EU product safety and market surveillance regulations, and saw no reason for additional legislation or stronger enforcement now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de start en het effect van handhaving van de Wet DBA

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about signals that clients were already suspending or cancelling contracts with self-employed workers ahead of Wet DBA enforcement, and about the need for clearer criteria and a separate legal status for freelancers. The minister acknowledged the signals, said enforcement continues within existing frameworks and a labour market package including the position of freelancers is being prepared, and promised a letter before summer and engagement with freelancer representatives.
I will send your House a letter of main lines before the summer on the elaboration of the labour market package.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer een hoofdlijnenbrief sturen over de uitwerking van het arbeidsmarktpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het bericht “Schandalen PostNL bij ons niet minder erg dan in België”

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked ministers whether the abuses at PostNL in Belgium are a scandal, whether Dutch oversight of parcel delivery fails, what will be done to end such practices, what they think of Belgian plans to require firms to employ many couriers directly, and why Dutch postal workers still generate scandals. The minister declined to address the ongoing Belgian case, described Arbeidsinspectie and ILT enforcement and a multi-year strategy with large clients, said generic measures are preferred but sector-specific ones may be warranted, and noted the 80% employment rule applies only to letter delivery, not parcels.
I cannot go into an ongoing legal procedure such as the case in the article in your question, which moreover took place in a neighbouring country.
Op een lopende juridische procedure zoals de casus in het artikel uit uw vraag, die zich bovendien in een buurland heeft voorgedaan, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het artikel 'Knip open voor Europese chips'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the prospects for Dutch semiconductor firms, the Chips Act, a possible state contribution to a European chip plant, and IPCEI funding. The minister answered that the government stays in contact with industry but does not discuss individual firms, gave no hard forecasts, described the Chips Act alignment and IPCEI status, and withheld details on subsidies citing confidentiality.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van Strien en Erkens over de publicatie “EU Solar Energy Strategy” van de Europese Commissie

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the European Commission's EU Solar Energy Strategy and its implications for solar-powered vehicles, including Dutch support for the solar mobility cluster. The minister described the EU initiatives and existing fiscal support for solar cars, said further assessment would follow via a BNC procedure, and did not yet commit to new funding.
I am getting to work on this; through a BNC procedure I will go further into the Dutch cabinet's assessment of the EU strategy for solar energy.
Ik ga hiermee aan de slag; middels een BNC-traject zal ik nader ingaan op de beoordeling van het Nederlandse kabinet van de EU-strategie voor zonne-energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een artikel in Trouw over mogelijke betalingen aan IS, corruptie en fraude door Ericsson in Irak

An MP asked ministers about a Trouw report on alleged payments to IS, corruption and fraud by Ericsson in Iraq, including the role of IMVO due diligence rules and alternatives to Huawei and Ericsson for 5G. The minister said terrorism financing is unacceptable and already criminal, that KPN and Ericsson are handling the matter, and that the government has no plans to contact the Swedish government.
Financing terrorism is worrying, unacceptable and punishable.
Het financieren van terrorisme is zorgelijk, onaanvaardbaar en strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouwend Nederland: trage betalingen Rijk kosten bouwsector miljarden'

MPs Rahimi and De Groot asked the Minister about reports that the central government pays construction SMEs only after about 75 days, far beyond the legal 30-day term, and what this means for project delays and supplier exits. The Minister answered that the 75 days includes time before invoices are submitted, that over 95% of central government invoices are paid within 30 days, and that no link to project delays or supplier withdrawal has been found, while promising to inventory payment bottlenecks and inform the House before summer.

That is why I have committed to inventorying, with the relevant ministers of Finance, Interior and Kingdom Relations, and Infrastructure and Water Management, where problems arise in the process regarding late payment and how we can speed this up.

Daarom heb ik toegezegd om met de betrokken bewindspersonen van Financiën, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Infrastructuur en Waterstaat te inventariseren waar in het proces problemen ontstaan met betrekking tot late betaling en hoe we dat kunnen versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht topman Air France-KLM pakt 3 miljoen aan bonus

Heinen (VVD) asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a reported 3 million euro bonus for the Air France-KLM chief executive despite state aid and staff wage concessions, and what the government did after its earlier motion to tighten the EU temporary state aid framework on bonuses. The ministers say they pressed the European Commission to tighten bonus rules, which the Commission did not change, and that they will keep opposing the bonus at the shareholder meeting while the state holds 9.3% of shares.
I, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, have argued that in addition to paying out bonuses, it should also not be possible to promise bonuses as long as the state aid has not been repaid.

Ik, de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, heb ervoor gepleit dat naast het uitbetalen van bonussen het ook niet mogelijk moet zijn om bonussen toe te zeggen zolang de staatssteun niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de toekomst van de zeilende beroepsvaart

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a 2022 report on financing the future of the sailing commercial fleet (bruine vloot) as maritime heritage, and whether they would consult sector and government partners and answer before the tourism debate. The answer is only a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter on tourism.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'Reaction to committee request on supplementary main lines on tourism' (Parliamentary paper 26 419, no. 96).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «Reactie op verzoek commissie over aanvullende hoofdlijnen inzake toerisme» (Kamerstuk 26 419, nr. 96 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over investeringen bij Tata naar aanleiding van het plan Groen Staal van FNV en andere plannen voor waterstof

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about meetings with Tata Steel executives, plans discussed for decarbonisation (including hydrogen), subsidies, and the conditions attached to any public support for the IJmuiden steelworks. The minister answered in detail: no specific subsidy commitments were made, support is under study with binding conditions on health, environment and climate, but no amount has been allocated yet, and the answers to individual questions were delivered late.
