Over the coming period this will be discussed confidentially with TSN by RVO and EZK.
Hierover zal de komende periode bedrijfsvertrouwelijk gesproken worden met TSN door RVO en EZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Intel kiest voor Duitsland als vestigingsplaats voor Europese megafabriek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Intel choosing Germany for a European mega-fab and why the Netherlands got no role in its investment plan. The minister called it a positive signal for Europe, said the government does not discuss individual company talks but works closely with industry via NFIA, and listed Dutch chip-sector initiatives and opportunities.
The cabinet does not go into individual conversations with companies.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gesprekken met bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht 'Online criminelen bestoken de wereld met cyberaanvallen vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice, Economic Affairs and the State Secretary for Interior about reports that criminals use Dutch servers and hosting resellers for cyberattacks, asking about scale, enforcement, cooperation and hosting-sector responsibility. The government answered that ransomware is a growing threat with low reporting rates, that enforcement is complicated by foreign perpetrators and anonymity, and that it supports EU measures and sector codes while pointing to ongoing coalition agreement work.
If your House requests a technical briefing, this can be provided.
Indien uw Kamer verzoekt om een technische briefing kan daarin worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de gevolgen van de zware sancties voor Nederlandse ondernemers die naar Rusland exporteren

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she knows that Dutch exporters dependent on Russia are badly hit by sanctions, including payment problems, and what she will do to help them. The minister confirmed the impact and pointed to existing RVO support instruments such as state-backed loans, guarantees, trade finance and energy-transition subsidies, without announcing new measures.
For entrepreneurs in need, such as the senders of the open letter the MP enclosed, I would like to point to the existing support we offer through RVO.
Ondernemers in nood, zoals de verzenders van de brandbrief die het lid Van Houwelingen heeft meegestuurd, zou ik graag willen wijzen op de bestaande ondersteuning die wij aanbieden via RVO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Olie, gas, graan en geld - Oekraïne laat zien hoe de wereld werkt'

An MP from BBB asked ministers in 19 numbered questions about the effects of the war in Ukraine on food supply, input prices, farm viability and the EU's dependence on imports, and whether the Green Deal transition should be postponed. The minister answered mostly on substance, noting no structural food shortage is expected in the EU, commitments to monitor and share a Wageningen study, and rejected postponing the sustainability transition.
I monitor the situation closely and am also in close contact with the European Commission and the agriculture ministers of the EU member states on this.
Ik monitor de situatie nauwlettend en heb hieromtrent ook nauw contact met de Europese Commissie en de landbouwministers van de EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Project Panda: hoe 'kroonjuweel' High Tech Campus toch in buitenlandse handen kwam'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the government did not prevent the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to foreign owners, whether a state stake or Dutch counteroffer was considered, and how campuses can be protected from unwanted takeovers. The minister replied that the ministry checked for national security risks, found none, saw no reason to intervene in a market transaction, rejected a state stake, and judged the investment screening law disproportionate for property deals, pointing to other instruments.
Under the motion by Amhaouch and Inge van Dijk, I am exploring the desirability and feasibility of applying the investment screening bill to real estate transactions involving high-tech campuses.

In het kader van de motie-Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk verken ik de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheid van toepassing van het wetsvoorstel Veiligheidstoets investeringen, fusies en overnames op vastgoedtransacties
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het onafhankelijk worden van Russisch gas

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about the EU's independence from Russian gas, including energy-saving scenarios, the Nationaal Isolatieprogramma, enforcement of existing energy-saving duties, SDE++ subsidies, and Gazprom's activities and contracts in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports ambitious EU energy-saving targets, announced a campagne and insulation programme, gave limited commitments on new duties while rejecting some proposals, and explained the sanctions framework that limits action against Gazprom entities.
It is undesirable that we as European countries contribute in this way to the Russian state coffers.
Het is onwenselijk dat we als Europese landen op deze manier bijdragen aan de Russische staatskas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over problemen in de glastuinbouwsector als gevolg van de aanhoudend hoge energieprijzen

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about financial distress in greenhouse horticulture caused by high energy prices, including SDE++ subsidies falling with gas prices and possible project shutdowns. The ministers acknowledged the problems, said they are in talks with the sector and banks, explained the SDE++ design, declined to intervene in the subsidy scheme, and promised a letter to parliament in April.
We have no information that would allow us to assess how many projects this concerns.
Wij hebben geen informatie waardoor wij kunnen beoordelen om hoeveel projecten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat energiemaatschappij Vattenfall tussentijds de prijzen voor gas en elektra verhoogt en daarmee de verlaging van de btw in haar eigen zak probeert te steken

MP Omtzigt asked the minister whether Vattenfall's mid-contract price increase on 1 April 2022 for variable-contract customers, which coincides with the planned VAT cut on energy, is acceptable and what steps the government will take. The minister replied that the compensation is meant for households not suppliers, called the timing and communication unfortunate, said the government is talking with suppliers and that the ACM supervises tariffs, but did not commit to blocking such increases.
It has not proven possible to answer these questions within the requested time limit.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om binnen de gevraagde termijn deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Ondernemers sneller in problemen door uitzondering in faillissementswet’

MPs Ellian and Rahimi asked whether the WHOA out-of-court insolvency settlement scheme works in practice, and what the Supreme Court ruling that pension premiums fall under the employee exception means for restructurings. The minister reported about 200 declarations and 23 homologation decisions so far, said an evaluation is planned by end 2023, and promised to discuss the consultation results with the insolvency sector and social partners before summer and inform the House in autumn.
How often a WHOA process has led to a settlement before the court became involved is not known, because the vast majority of these processes take place in confidentiality.
Hoe vaak een WHOA-traject heeft geresulteerd in een akkoord nog voordat de rechter daarbij aan te pas kwam, is niet bekend omdat veruit de meeste van deze trajecten in beslotenheid plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over AirTags

An MP asks whether AirTags pose stalking and privacy risks, whether the Wet Belaging is adequate given that stalking is a complaint offence, and how the GDPR and anti-stalking policy apply. The minister answers that the existing legal framework is sufficient, that Apple has added anti-misuse safeguards, that the GDPR's household exemption applies and enforcement is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and points to ongoing stalking-prevention and victim-support efforts.
Of course, the cabinet is closely monitoring developments.
Uiteraard houdt het kabinet de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het tegengaan criminele activiteiten via de verzending van postpakketten

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about rising drug trafficking through parcel post, the Customs and police interception results, the Sensing project, screening rates, and whether senders should be required to identify themselves. The minister reported intensified Customs controls and seizures, planned a Multidisciplinary Post Team, and rejected a sender identification requirement as ineffective and disproportionate, while committing to examine ways to lift sender anonymity.
It is not possible to state how many parcels or postal items are checked in this way, as this is not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel pakketten of poststukken op deze wijzen gecontroleerd worden, dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het artikel van Constantijn van Oranje in het Financieel Dagblad met als titel ‘We hadden de ster van Europa kunnen zijn’

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the minister about a newspaper article claiming the Netherlands missed chances to become Europe's startup star, and about startup policy, venture capital, the Growth Fund and the tax bill on stock option rules. The minister rejected the claim that the Netherlands is lagging, described existing policy instruments and knowledge gaps, and gave a status update on the delayed stock option bill with no firm new timeline.
I agree with the envoy that we must remain alert to new opportunities and keep working to solve bottlenecks in our startup climate.
Ik ben het eens met de envoy dat we alert moeten zijn op nieuwe kansen en ons moeten blijven inzetten voor het oplossen van knelpunten in ons startup klimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de winkelsluiting in ons land heeft geleid tot wel 300% meer omzet in België

An MP from the PVV asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that Dutch shops closed during lockdown boosted Antwerp sales, and whether this undermines the lockdown measures, including requests for mobility data, the scientific basis for closing shops, and the losses to Dutch retailers. The government answered that residents were not encouraged to shop in Belgium but were not barred, that compliance remained high, that the OMT advice underpinning the closures is available to parliament, and that the total lost retail revenue cannot be determined.
Breakdown of turnover figures for the lockdown period is not available.
Opgesplitste omzetcijfers voor de lockdownperiode zijn niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe ‘Carnivoor? Geef het door!’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ministry would join the national week without meat and dairy and adopt a 'carnivore? pass it on' principle making plant-based food the default in ministry catering. The minister answered that the ministry's business catering participates in the week, and that the ministry follows a government-wide circular catering vision with plant-based food as an important element, but did not commit to making plant-based the default, and the answers were not provided on time.
Concretely, this means that in all new catering tenders the protein transition is an important aspect.
Concreet betekent dit dat bij alle nieuwe aanbestedingen voor de catering de eiwittransitie een belangrijk aspect is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rahimi over het bericht 'Mkb’er kiest voor lening om aan eisen banken te voldoen'

Rep. Rahimi asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she is talking with banks and entrepreneurs about SMEs being pushed into costlier financing and whether she will act on the resulting funding gap. The Minister says her ministry consults banks and entrepreneurs regularly, points to existing guarantees and funds (BMKB, Qredits, DACI, a planned SME equity fund) and promises a reply to the Comité voor Ondernemerschap advice in spring.
In the spring I will send a response to this advice to your House.
Ik zal in het voorjaar een reactie op dit advies aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over de garantieregeling voor evenementen

MP Romke de Jong asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for events cancelled due to government restrictions, including the move from 100% to 80% guarantee cover, the timing of cancellation decisions, organisers' contracts with artists and suppliers, the economic viability of capacity limits, and accountant-protocol clarity. The minister answered that a phased own-risk share is being introduced (90% in Q1 2022, 80% in Q2 and Q3), that organisers may cancel from three weeks before an event during a ban, that contracts with suppliers are a private matter enforceable in court, that a suppletieregeling existed for 2021, and that a control protocol for accountants is now ready.
The cabinet regrets that it took a long time before there was clarity about the control protocol for the TRSEC.
Het kabinet betreurt dat het lang duurde voordat er duidelijkheid was omtrent het controleprotocol voor de TRSEC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 6 januari 2022 'Mogelijke verhoging gaswinning Groningenveld gasjaar 2021-2022'

An MP asked whether extra Groningen gas extraction for 2021-2022 is legally and ethically permissible given the delayed nitrogen plant, the earlier decision to phase out extraction, and export obligations, and whether new advice should be sought. The government answered that the Mijnbouwwet allows annual and in-year adjustments, that appeals remain open, that the phase-out aim stands, that export contracts are a matter for the parties involved, and that it will inform parliament and decide on the extraction level before 1 April 2022.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a final decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'PostNL laat het afweten: honderden Hagenaars krijgen al drie weken geen post meer'

MP Grinwis asked the minister about reports of prolonged, large-scale non-delivery of mail by PostNL in The Hague and other municipalities, including questions on monitoring, the 95% delivery norm, liability and redress, and a request for talks with PostNL. The minister answered that the ACM supervises delivery quality, that PostNL exceeded the norm only through force majeure claims rejected by the ACM for 2019, that liability is limited by law, and that she had contacted PostNL, which has taken back delivery in the affected area.
I do not have this information.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Europese Rekenkamer: uitrol 5G te traag en te versnipperd'

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Rajkowski (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the European Court of Auditors' report on slow, fragmented 5G rollout, including the digital divide, cybersecurity coordination, rollout pace, EU funding, data protection, compensation for replacement costs and local licence holders. The minister largely endorsed the report's conclusions but rejected a common EU quality standard, said the rollout is on track, and promised an advisory report by 1 May 2022 and to inform parliament, while deferring some EU matters to the Commission and noting national security competence.
As soon as I have received the advice, I will inform your House about the advice and the next steps and further planning.
Ik zal zodra ik het advies heb ontvangen, uw Kamer over het advies en over de vervolgstappen en nadere planning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Familiebedrijf Balk Shipyard in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported takeover of family shipyard Balk Shipyard by a Chinese investment group, including fit with industrial policy, financing instruments, screening under the investment screening law, and whether the firm will stay on Urk. The minister answered that the takeover is welcomed for enabling growth, that no screening obligation appears to apply, and that no reason exists to expect the firm to leave, while giving only generic information about the investor and no commitments on local agreements.
The cabinet does not collect information on business locations, corporate or ownership structures of companies unless required by laws and regulations.
Het kabinet verzamelt geen informatie over vestigingslocaties, bedrijfs- en/of eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven zolang dit niet is vereist voor wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Boris Johnson wil VDL Nedcar aftroeven: Britse premier zet zich persoonlijk in voor komst Rivian naar Engeland'

CDA MP Amhaouch asked whether the Dutch government is actively working to attract Rivian's European plant to VDL Nedcar in Born, including whether the Prime Minister is personally involved, and how it responds to Johnson's competing offer. The minister confirms active support via NFIA and ongoing contact, but declines to disclose the stage of decision-making, contacts with prospective clients, or the content of Johnson's offer citing confidentiality.
Because of commercial confidentiality and because premature disclosure could harm the process, the cabinet is generally reticent about giving information on developments in current corporate cases.

Omwille van de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid en omdat voortijdige mededelingen het proces kunnen schaden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van informatie over ontwikkelingen rond actuele bedrijfscasussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat de CCS-installatie bij een waterstofproject van Shell meer broeikasgassen uitstoot dan het afvangt

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked whether the Scotford hydrogen CCS plant emits more CO2 than it captures, whether CCS is a sound use of public subsidy, and related questions on risks, leakage and subsidy recovery. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, says the plant captures more than it emits after correcting for energy use, defends subsidies for hard-to-abate industry under the ETS and a cost-correction mechanism, and rejects stopping or reclaiming CCS funding.
No, that is not correct. The article refers to a specific project in which the CO2 released in hydrogen production is captured.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het artikel refereert aan een specifiek project, waarbij de CO 2 die vrijkomt bij de productie van waterstof wordt afgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de uitzending van de Keuringsdienst van Waarde over 'Bij-vriendelijke planten'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast showing pesticide residues on plants sold as bee-friendly was true, whether this misleads consumers and harms insects, and whether labelling warnings should be required. The minister answered that pesticides are approved only after risk assessment including insects, that misleading claims are for the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie to judge, and that warning labels are not needed.

Pesticides are only authorised in the Netherlands if a scientific risk assessment by the College for the Authorisation of Plant Protection Products and Biocides shows that they are safe for humans, animals and the environment when used according to the rules.

Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden in Nederland alleen toegelaten als uit een wetenschappelijke risicobeoordeling van het College voor de Toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en Biociden blijkt dat ze volgens de voorschriften veilig zijn voor mens, dier en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het verder opendraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether raising Groningen gas extraction and exporting Groningen gas to Germany breaks the government's promise to close the field, and why 30,000 damage claims remain open. The state secretary answered that a decision on the extraction level will be taken before 1 April 2022, that claims are being handled with a six-month target, and that export cannot stop immediately because export contracts and household demand abroad constrain it.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a definitive decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel ‘SABIC overweegt sluiting naftakraker op Chemelot’

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether SABIC is considering closing a naphtha cracker at Chemelot, what it would mean for workers and neighbouring firms, and how the government will secure decarbonisation investment and grid and pipeline infrastructure at the site. The minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the government and the province are monitoring talks with SABIC, that individual maatwerk agreements with large emitters including SABIC and OCI are being prepared, and that infrastructure needs are addressed in the MIEK.
The Ministry of EZK and the province of Limburg are following the outcomes of these talks to monitor the consequences for the entire site.
Het Ministerie van EZK en de provincie Limburg volgen de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken om de gevolgen voor de gehele site te monitoren.
